quest:100.text: Call of Water. At Silverpine's coast, you finish the Call of Water at the Brazier of Everfount. The rite clears nearby corruption, and a spirit of pure water appears. At the Brazier of Everfount, your final words summon a burst of light. It scatters the minor spirits threatening the spring, and the shore falls quiet. Once the spirits are gone, a Minor Manifestation of Water appears beside the brazier. The spirit thanks you for the rite and says the taint here has ebbed. Yet life across Silverpine's decaying lands continues to wane, so the Horde's shamans must stay watchful to preserve it.

quest:1007.text: The Ancient Statuette. Near Zoram Strand, Talen searches for the statuette lost in the naga attack. The elf has made camp on Ashenvale’s northwestern coast and needs you to recover the relic he dropped in the surf. Naga attacked Talen as he guided a small vessel through the shallows near Zoram’s sunken ruins. He reached shore with only bare provisions and made camp in haste. In his flight, he dropped the ancient statuette he had found among the ruins into the sand. Talen braved the naga at Zoram Strand to seek the ancient statuette. When you return it, he tells you the drowned city holds centuries of forgotten mysteries. He believes the delicate carving may unlock what remains hidden beneath the tides.

quest:1009.text:
Ruuzel. On the Zoram Strand, Talen seeks a ring that may open an ancient statuette. The naga have taken it to their island sanctuary. Talen believes the Ring of Zoram can open an ancient statuette found on the coast. Before the Great Sundering broke Kalimdor and sank its coastal cities, powerful night elven nobles ruled Zoram. The ring belonged among their regalia.

After the cataclysm, the ring vanished beneath the waves for millennia. The secrets of sunken relics remained hidden from curious eyes. Naga have recently come to the Zoram Strand and begun searching the ruins of their former homeland. Ruuzel leads the local brood. She found the Ring of Zoram and took it to her sanctuary on an island to the north.

Talen, a night elf, asks Alliance travelers to hunt Ruuzel and reclaim the heirloom. He hopes to use it to open the statuette recovered from the shallows.

quest:101.text: The Totem of Infliction. In Darkshire, Madame Eva offers travelers a ward against Duskwood's dangers. She needs ghoul fangs, skeleton fingers, and spider venom to enchant a charm that strikes back at attackers. Madame Eva reads fortunes in her candle-lit home in Darkshire. She sees danger and violence ahead, then offers practical sorcery beside her divinations. To ward against Duskwood's predators, she needs ten ghoul fangs, ten skeleton fingers, and five vials of spider venom from the haunted woods. Madame Eva binds ghoul fangs, fingers from restless skeletons, and spider venom with enchantments. When its bearer faces mortal peril, the totem gives off a magical aura. It reflects cruelty and harms anyone who strikes its bearer.

quest:1010.text: Bathran's Hair. At Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale, Orendil Broadleaf seeks Bathran's Hair for a sick child in Astranaar. He believes the illness afflicts the child's spirit, so he sends you north to ancient ruins where the uncommon restorative herb was gathered in the past. At Maestra's Post, Orendil Broadleaf faces a troubling illness. He is a night elf herbalist, and the post lies just south of the Darkshore border. A young child in Astranaar is gravely ill, and ordinary remedies have failed. Orendil believes the sickness touches the child's spirit as well as the flesh. So he seeks Bathran's Hair, an uncommon restorative herb gathered in the ancient elven ruins to the north.

quest:1011.text: Forsaken Diseases. Kayneth Stillwind watches the Forsaken draw nearer in eastern Ashenvale. He fears they are brewing blights to ravage sacred elven lands, so he sends Alliance champions to a camp near Dor'Danil Barrow Den to seize a sample. Ashenvale's night elves have long contended with satyrs, raging elementals, and orcish logging crews. Now the Forsaken bring a darker danger. The undead arm of the Horde is taking root near ancient ruins and sacred barrow dens. Their presence brings war and fear that alchemical plague may spread through Kaldorei groves. South of Forest Song, near Dor'Danil Barrow Den, Forsaken apothecaries and scouts have fortified a camp. They bottle untested toxins among brewing caldrons and foul reagents. Kayneth Stillwind sends scouts inside to recover an intact Bottle of Disease. Its volatile contents can then be studied before the Forsaken unleash it across the forest.

quest:1012.text: Insane Druids. In eastern Ashenvale, Kayneth Stillwind learns of a slaughter through a vision. The night elf sentinel is battling Forsaken toxins when the spirits of Dor'Danil Barrow Den's druids cry out in torment. While fighting the effects of Forsaken toxins in eastern Ashenvale, Kayneth Stillwind sees a massacre in a waking vision. Beneath the mounds of Dor'Danil Barrow Den, undead infiltrators poisoned the druids in their sleep and slaughtered them. The venom tore their souls from their bodies, leaving wild spirits shrieking in torment. Kayneth Stillwind asks you to quiet the suffering beneath Dor'Danil Barrow Den. The druids' phantoms were driven mad by their deaths and cannot find release in the underground chambers. Three leaders of their circle remain among the restless dead: Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall, and Mavoris Cloudsbreak. Lay them to rest, and the den may begin to heal from its defilement.

quest:1013.text: The Book of Ur. Keeper Bel'dugur sends Horde champions into Shadowfang Keep to find Ur's book. In the Undercity's Apothecarium, he seeks the work of Ur, a dead mage of Dalaran, for the Forsaken to use its research into other planes. Before the Third War destroyed Dalaran, the brilliant human wizard Ur devoted his scholarship to realms beyond Azeroth. The Kirin Tor governed conjuration and contact with outer planes closely, but Ur studied beings from other dimensions, including the savage worgen. He hesitated to wield their alien powers, judging them dangerously uncontrollable. So his written work became a prize for those with fewer scruples. Archmage Arugal took Ur's treatise and used its research before settling in Shadowfang Keep. Without Ur's reservations, Arugal summoned bloodthirsty worgen into Silverpine. Their curse consumed Pyrewood and the surrounding valleys. Now the volume lies neglected in the keep's towers, watched by Arugal's feral pets.

quest:1014.text: Arugal Must Die. At the Sepulcher, Dalar Dawnweaver calls champions to face Arugal. The rogue archmage rules Shadowfang Keep, and his worgen threaten the Forsaken’s hold on Silverpine Forest. Shadowfang Keep rises above the woods, and Archmage Arugal commands the worgen within. The Forsaken have made the Sepulcher their base, yet Silverpine Forest remains dangerous and fiercely contested. Guilt and dark sorcery drove Arugal mad. He unleashed the feral worgen upon Lordaeron, and now his ravenous beasts roam the forest paths, hindering Lady Sylvanas Windrunner’s effort to secure the region. Dalar Dawnweaver knows that hunting worgen across the forest will not end the danger. Their source lies within Shadowfang Keep. You must breach the old stronghold, fight through Arugal’s worgen brood, and confront the mad wizard in his aerie. His severed head proves his death, and his defeat can break his hold over the region.

quest:1016.text: Elemental Bracers. At Silverwind Refuge, Sentinel Velene Starstrike seeks the hand behind the tainted waters. She asks you to gather intact bracers from hostile elementals so a divining scroll can reveal who summoned them. Rogue water elementals trouble Ashenvale’s sacred waters. Unlike the wild spirits that belong to the world, these creatures bear signs of conjuration. Their sudden arrival at Silverwind Refuge warns the Sentinels that outside corruption is reaching deeper into the forest’s waterways. Sentinel Velene Starstrike believes someone bound and unleashed the elementals. She gives you a magical divining scroll to identify the culprit. The spell needs intact bracers taken from the spirits before they dissipate. Their lingering arcane signature can lead the scroll to whoever called the elementals into being.

quest:1017.text: Mage Summoner. At Silverwind Refuge, Sentinel Velene Starstrike sends a strike south after water elementals near Mystral Lake are corrupted. The Sentinels send adventurers across the border to kill the undead mage Sarilus Foulborne atop Dreadmist Peak. Night elves rarely send scouts south into the Barrens without grave cause. Sentinel Velene Starstrike traced unnatural disturbances among the water elementals around Mystral Lake to Sarilus Foulborne, a Forsaken conjurer practicing his arts just across the border. For the Sentinels at Silverwind Refuge, an enemy sorcerer defiling nature so close to home cannot be tolerated. Sarilus Foulborne has made his lair high on Dreadmist Peak, a craggy mountain crawling with Burning Blade cultists. From there, he summons ranks of water elementals and bends them to his will, defying night elf authority from Horde lands. Reaching him means braving enemy territory and cutting through his summoned forces. The Sentinels demand his severed head as proof that their vengeance reaches beyond the forest line.

quest:1020.text: Orendil's Cure. In Ashenvale, a child in Astranaar waits for Orendil's Cure. Orendil Broadleaf sends you with a remedy made from rare flora. Pelturas Whitemoon watches his daughter Relara waste away in Astranaar. A severe sickness has baffled those nearby. So he sought help from herbalists across Ashenvale before hope began to fade. Orendil Broadleaf brews a draught to halt Relara's affliction. It calls for several components, including Bathran's hair. He entrusts the cure to you and sends you south and east along the forest highway to Astranaar, where Relara waits.

quest:1021.text: Vile Satyr! Dryads in Danger!. In Ashenvale, Illiyana waits for word of her sisters, missing after setting out to recover a stolen relic. She asks passing Alliance travelers to find them in Xavian’s corrupted ruins. Dryad Illiyana waits in Ashenvale, fearing for her sisters. They went into the corrupted northern reaches of the forest to recover the Branch of Cenarius, a holy relic stolen by satyrs. They promised to return swiftly, but two days have passed without word. So Illiyana asks passing Alliance travelers to find them before it is too late.

quest:1022.text: The Howling Vale. Worgen have overrun a ruined shrine at the Howling Vale near Felwood. Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow seeks the cause of their arrival in Ashenvale. Worgen cries echo from a ruined shrine in northern Ashenvale. Beyond a cavern path near the Felwood border, the shrine of Mel'Thandris lies overrun. Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow fears the worgen may bring another disaster to the woodland realm. Night elf sentinels already spend great effort holding back demonic corruption from Felwood.

quest:1023.text: Raene's Cleansing. At Lake Falathim, Raene Wolfrunner's search for Teronis has become a search for what he left behind. You are to bring his journal and a glowing gem held by the murlocs back to her in Astranaar. Raene Wolfrunner sent you to Lake Falathim to find Teronis, a night elf sentinel. You find him dead beside the water. His journal is intact, with an account of his assignment and what he learned about Ashenvale's strange disturbances. Teronis traced a rare, glowing stone to Lake Falathim. Now the lake's aggressive murlocs hold it. Recover the gem and Teronis' journal, and his work can continue.

quest:1024.text: Raene's Cleansing. In Ashenvale, Raene Wolfrunner seeks a way to restore Dartol's ancient rod. A Glowing Gem has brought her to Shael'dryn, a dryad east of Iris Lake. Raene Wolfrunner studies the field notes of Teronis, the sentinel who died investigating Ashenvale's troubled furbolgs. His work points to an ancient rod made by a night elf named Dartol. Raene has found a Glowing Gem, yet her skill as a huntress cannot explain the relic's arcane and natural mysteries. Raene sends you northeast toward Iris Lake to find Shael'dryn, a dryad who lives beside a moonwell. As one of the Daughters of Cenarius, Shael'dryn understands the forest and its ancient relics. Bring her the Glowing Gem, and she may tell you what else is needed to restore Dartol's Rod.

quest:1025.text: An Aggressive Defense. In Ashenvale, Raene Wolfrunner sends Alliance defenders against the Foulweald furbolgs. Corruption has made the tribe dangerous along the road east of Astranaar. Furbolgs attack travelers on the road east from Astranaar toward the Falfarren River. Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner sends capable defenders to strike the Foulweald camps just south of the highway. Their attacks have made this vital road through Ashenvale dangerous for all who travel it. The Foulweald were once friends and allies of the night elves. For ages, the kaldorei and furbolgs shared reverence for nature and the wild gods. The Burning Legion's invasion left a taint that shattered many furbolg minds. Peaceful neighbors became violent reavers, and innocent travelers now face their attacks.

quest:1026.text: Raene's Cleansing. In Ashenvale, Raene's Cleansing brings Dartol's Rod closer to wholeness. Shael'dryn knows where its iron shaft lies, in a chest near the Felwood border. The search leads toward treants changed by corruption. Raene Wolfrunner sends you to Shael'dryn, a keeper who watches over a moonwell deep in Ashenvale. Shael'dryn knows where Dartol's Rod's iron shaft lies. To reach it, you must face the taint spreading through the northern woods. The shaft rests in an old chest in a quiet glade near the Felwood border. A wooden key will open the chest, and Crazed and Withered Ancients carry it. These treants wander the mountain road north toward Felwood. Corruption from the demonic wastes spreads south and has shattered their natural harmony. Once guardians of the wild, they are now tormented and hostile. The key lies with them.

quest:1027.text: Raene's Cleansing. In Ashenvale, Raene Wolfrunner and Shael'dryn seek the last piece of Dartol's Rod. They hope the relic can cleanse the forest and slow the furbolg attacks on its night elves. At Dor'Danil barrow den, night elf druids guarded the iron pommel of Dartol's Rod. Disaster struck, and the druids were slain. Their refuge fell, and the pommel's hiding place was lost. Now scavengers and wandering oozes consume what remains in the ruins east of the southern road. Dartol was an evil wizard, and he has died. Yet the rod he made holds powers that can transform. Raene Wolfrunner and Shael'dryn seek to reassemble it, hoping it can slow the furbolg attacks on Ashenvale's night elves. The iron pommel is the last piece Shael'dryn needs before she can try to mend the broken rod at the moonwell.

quest:1028.text: Raene's Cleansing. At Shael'dryn's direction, you climb toward a mountain shrine in southeastern Ashenvale. The basin there holds the magic to restore the rebuilt Rod of Dartol. Shael'dryn sends you from her moonwell into Ashenvale's wild southeastern slopes. There, ancient shrines often stood high among mountain crags, far from roads and hidden beneath dense forest canopies. You cross unmarked ground along rock faces and climb winding trails known mostly to Sentinels and woodland hermits. A stone basin waits in a quiet forest alcove. Though dormant, the shrine holds protective magic placed there by night elves long ago. Rest the rebuilt Rod of Dartol in the basin, and the shrine's sleeping power awakens. Its magic flows into the rod and restores its enchantment, so it can cleanse the land.

quest:1029.text: Raene's Cleansing. At Iris Lake, Shael'dryn entrusts you with a restored rod for Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar. You carry it back to report success and honor Teronis, the fallen scout. Dartol's Rod of Transformation has been reforged from components and ancient gem fragments gathered in corrupted reaches of Ashenvale. Near Iris Lake, the dryad Shael'dryn renews its magic. Then she sends you along the forest roads to Astranaar, where Raene Wolfrunner awaits the restored rod.

quest:1030.text: Raene's Cleansing. In Ashenvale, Raene Wolfrunner seeks a way to speak with an uncorrupted furbolg. Southeast of Mystral Lake, Krolg reveals the resentment some surviving furbolgs hold toward the night elves. Raene Wolfrunner believes the late night elf meant to approach the furbolgs using Dartol’s restored Rod of Transformation. Ashenvale’s woods have grown perilous, and madness spreads through the tribes. There is no path to direct diplomacy. The rod gives you a furbolg’s shape, so you can try to pass their territorial rage and find someone willing to speak.

quest:1031.text: The Branch of Cenarius. In eastern Ashenvale, Anilia's final plea sends you to recover the Branch of Cenarius. Geltharis has taken the sacred relic, and Illiyana awaits its return. Near death, Anilia lies where you search eastern Ashenvale for missing dryads. Cenarius's wounded daughter points north toward the satyr ruins. With her last breaths, she names Geltharis as the one who took the Branch of Cenarius. She begs you to bring it back. Geltharis hides among the ancient elven ruins of Xavian. The satyrs are ancient servants of the Burning Legion. They prize relics tied to Cenarius as trophies, to defile and mock. Taking the branch from Geltharis answers Anilia's plea and helps defend Ashenvale's sacred plants from the corruption these servants spread.

quest:1032.text: Satyr Slaying!. At the Shrine of Aessina, Illiyana calls Alliance champions against Ashenvale's satyrs. She grieves for her sister Anilia and asks you to bring back satyr horns as proof. Anilia's death has left Illiyana grieving at the Shrine of Aessina. Dryads are forest spirits bound to nature, often playful and serene, yet elusive to mortals. Anilia's brutal slaying shattered that calm. Now Illiyana calls on Alliance travelers to strike down the demonic beasts responsible. Once night elves, the satyrs were corrupted by demonic energy during the War of the Ancients. They lurk in defiled groves across Ashenvale and prey on the woods' inhabitants as servants of the Burning Legion. Their horns prove vengeance to Illiyana and mark a strike against the fel presence encroaching on eastern Ashenvale.

quest:1033.text: Elune's Tear. In Astranaar, Pelturas Whitemoon seeks a cure for his ailing daughter, Relara. A brew made from Bathran's hair slowed her sickness, but did not cleanse it. Now Pelturas asks you to bring Elune's Tear from Iris Lake, hoping its sacred power can drive the corruption from her. Pelturas Whitemoon's young daughter, Relara, lies gravely ill in Astranaar. Orendil Broadleaf's brew, made from Bathran's hair, slowed her sickness but did not clear it from her body. Ordinary remedies have failed. So Pelturas turns to the old traditions of his people and seeks a cure touched by divine cleansing light. Orendil Broadleaf named a stronger remedy in case the herbal brew failed: Elune's Tear, a sacred stone found on an island in Iris Lake, east of Astranaar. Night elves believe the stone bears the Moon Goddess's blessing and can purge corruption from the living. Troubled water elementals patrol the lake's shallows and banks, guarding its waters.

quest:1034.text: The Ruins of Stardust. In Astranaar, Pelturas Whitemoon searches for a way to save his daughter, Relara. Elune's Tear eased her nightmares, yet a fierce fever still grips her. Orendil Broadleaf sends him south to find cooling stardust among the ancient night elven stones. Pelturas Whitemoon keeps watch beside his daughter, Relara, as a malignant illness burns through her. Elune's Tear eased her nightmares, but the sickness remains. A fierce fever still racks her, beyond the reach of ordinary medicines. With the temple healers stretched thin, Pelturas turns to remedies drawn from nature and hopes to save her life. Orendil Broadleaf, an elder herbalist, points Pelturas south across the river from Astranaar to the Ruins of Stardust. Frosted, shimmering dust gathers on plants among the fallen marble columns and archways of this ancient kaldorei sanctuary. Called stardust, the powder is naturally cold enough to draw out unnatural heat. Pelturas hopes to grind it into a poultice and ease Relara's fever. Water elementals and wildlife make gathering the frosted dust dangerous among the flooded stones. Corrupted or stirred by changes in Ashenvale's balance, the elementals surge around sunken plazas where the bushes grow thickest. You wade through shallows that look calm and watch for ambushes from the murky depths. The sparkling bushes must yield enough clean dust to carry back to Astranaar.

quest:1035.text: Fallen Sky Lake. At Fallen Sky Lake, a moonstone may restore Relara before her strength is gone. Her father, Pelturas Whitemoon, sends you southeast of Astranaar to find one among the fallen stones. For days, Pelturas Whitemoon has watched his young daughter, Relara, draw closer to death. Remedies made from Bathran's hair and stardust broke her fever, but left her weak and frail. He fears she has only a few breaths left before her spirit fades into the night. Pelturas turns to moonstones to restore Relara's strength. These fragments fell into Fallen Sky Lake, southeast of Astranaar, and night elves gathered them for their healing power. Aggressive elementals or corrupted bark now claim the stones. You must face danger with blade and spell to gather one.

quest:1037.text: Velinde Starsong. In Ashenvale, Melyria Frostshadow seeks word of the commander who came before her. Velinde Starsong vanished while fighting the corruption spreading from Felwood, and Melyria sends you to Darnassus for answers. Melyria Frostshadow keeps watch in Ashenvale, following the path Velinde Starsong once held. Velinde was a priestess charged with containing the demonic corruption spreading south from Felwood. Early reports said she had the danger under control, but her campaign faltered with time. Then she vanished without warning or formal relief, leaving the fight unfinished and her fate unknown.

quest:1038.text: Velinde's Effects. In Darnassus, the Sentinels are searching into Velinde's disappearance. Sentinel Velinde Starsong vanished after many years of service, and Thyn'tel Bladeweaver asks you to retrieve her journal from the Sentinels' quarters. Priestess Velinde Starsong served the night elves for many years and won their deep trust. When she quietly left her duties, the Sentinels thought she had personal reasons and expected her to return. Outsiders later found clues connected to the Tome of Mel'Thandris. Only then did Sentinel leaders permit a search of Velinde's private belongings.

quest:1039.text: The Barrens Port. Thyn'tel Bladeweaver sends you south to Ratchet in search of Velinde Starsong. The Sentinels believe she sailed across the Great Sea to the Eastern Kingdoms, and her trail runs through dangerous Horde lands. Clues among Velinde Starsong's personal effects point to passage across the sea toward the Eastern Kingdoms. Ratchet is the Barrens' only working harbor. There, travelers from northern Kalimdor can find passage south or east without sailing from night elf lands. Thyn'tel Bladeweaver sends you to search the harbor master's ledgers for Velinde's name. The road to Ratchet crosses the heart of Horde lands. South of Ashenvale, orc outriders and Tauren patrols range over the Mor'shan Rampart and the dry Barrens. Neutral goblins of the Steamwheedle Cartel govern Ratchet, putting trade ahead of faction rivalries. At the docks, Wharfmaster Dizzywig records each passenger and cargo crate.

quest:104.text: The Coastal Menace. On Westfall's rocky shore, Captain Grayson's ghost calls travelers to face The Coastal Menace. His ship broke on the rocks after murlocs drove the lighthouse keeper's family from their post. The family returned, but Old Murk-Eye led another attack and killed them. Now Grayson seeks the chieftain's death and justice for the shore. The Westfall Lighthouse once guided ships through the jagged shallows along the southern coast. After murlocs frightened the lighthouse keeper's family from their post, Captain Grayson's ship struck the rocks in the dark. The family returned and lit the flame again, but danger still stalked the shore. Old Murk-Eye rallied the weaker-minded murlocs along the coast and led them against the lighthouse. In that second attack, the keeper's family died while Captain Grayson watched, helpless. Now the ghostly captain calls for Murk-Eye's death and asks for a scale as proof. He hopes to bring peace to the dead and protect sailors on the Great Sea.

quest:1040.text: Passage to Booty Bay. In Booty Bay, the trail for Velinde Starsong leads from Ratchet to Caravaneer Ruzzgot. Alliance travelers now seek the goblin caravan driver. Wharfmaster Dizzywig’s records carry the search for Velinde Starsong from Ashenvale to the sea. The night elf Sentinel booked passage on the Black Osprey in Ratchet. Old shipping manifests show the vessel was bound for Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale. A goblin ferry carries travelers across the Great Sea from Ratchet to the southern tip of the Eastern Kingdoms. In Booty Bay, the trail leads to Caravaneer Ruzzgot, the goblin transport master Dizzywig recommended to Velinde. She had asked about dangerous overland journeys through the southern wilderness.

quest:1041.text: The Caravan Road. In Booty Bay, the search for Velinde Starsong turns north toward Darkshire. Caravaneer Ruzzgot recalls carrying the missing night elf priestess through Stranglethorn Vale. Caravaneer Ruzzgot remembers Velinde Starsong as a passenger on his caravan. Your search for the missing night elf priestess has brought you from Ashenvale to Booty Bay, at the southern edge of Stranglethorn Vale. She traveled with his caravan through the jungle, an unusual path for a night elf priestess. Ruzzgot says he and Velinde parted ways as they traveled north through Stranglethorn Vale. She set out for Duskwood, and her trail leads to Darkshire. Clerk Daltry keeps the town's records, including the names of unfamiliar travelers who enter. His ledger may hold the next clue to Velinde's whereabouts.

quest:1042.text: The Carevin Family. In Darkshire, the search for Velinde Starsong draws strangers to the Carevin family. Clerk Daltry hears of wolf-men in Ashenvale and sends them to the hunters. The search for Velinde Starsong leads from Kalimdor’s ancient forests to Duskwood. In Darkshire, Clerk Daltry finds no town record of an elven priestess staying there. But when he hears of savage wolf-men in Ashenvale, he listens closely. Beasts like those have begun terrorizing the woods around town. The Carevin family hunts the horrors troubling Duskwood. Locals know them for tracking demons, undead, and other monsters, and they have already faced the wolf-men. Their tracker, Calor, recently hauled a grisly string of severed wolf-men heads through Darkshire’s streets. So Clerk Daltry sends you to Jonathan Carevin, the stern head of the household, to learn what the hunters know about the worgen.

quest:1043.text: The Scythe of Elune. In Darkshire, the search for the Scythe of Elune turns toward the worgen hunt. Jonathan Carevin sends you to Roland's Doom, where the beasts first appeared, linking an ancient night elf relic in Kalimdor to the worgen troubling Duskwood. You have traced Priestess Velinde Starsong across Kalimdor and spoken with the Carevin household in Darkshire. Now you and Jonathan Carevin share a purpose. Nightbane worgen have overrun southern Duskwood, driven miners out and threatened what remains of the township. Carevin does not understand their supernatural origin, but he knows a willing hunter is valuable. He points you toward Roland's Doom, where the fiends were first sighted.

quest:1044.text: Answered Questions. The search for Velinde Starsong carries you from Ashenvale to Darnassus, where a report awaits.

quest:1045.text: Raene's Cleansing. At Lake Mystral, Krolg asks you to kill Ran Bloodtooth. Disguised by Dartol's Rod of Transformation, you can earn the uncorrupted furbolgs' trust. Krolg resents the night elves and fears the rot among his people. He wants the furbolgs to answer for their own. Near Lake Mystral, Krolg lives apart from the others, displaced and weary. He blames the night elves' ancient pride for the ruin brought upon Kalimdor and the dark rot spreading through Ashenvale. Dartol's Rod of Transformation lets you approach the furbolgs in disguise. Krolg hates the kaldorei, yet he calls for neither slaughter nor the deaths of innocents. Krolg believes his people must answer for their own deeds instead of yielding to the demonic taint gripping the tribes. The corruption did not give them their flaws; it magnified their worst impulses. Ran Bloodtooth shows the danger. Ruthless and hungry for power even before the taint, the chieftain embraced the darkness. Now he threatens elves and innocent beasts alike. Krolg will not let one furbolg speak for them all.

quest:1046.text: Raene's Cleansing. In Astranaar, you bring Raene's Cleansing to its end with Ran Bloodtooth's skull. The search began with Teronis, and Ashenvale's furbolg threat is now diminished. Krolg sends you back to Astranaar after Ran Bloodtooth falls. You carry the chieftain's severed skull to Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner. It proves that the threat prowling the forest depths has been struck down.

quest:1050.text: Mythology of the Titans. In Ironforge, Librarian Mae Paledust seeks Mythology of the Titans, a book said to have rested in Tirisfal's old Monastery. Its study may show what the past can teach about the unknown ahead. Before trouble came to Lordaeron, the old Monastery in Tirisfal Glades kept a library of knowledge. Mae asks you to bring her a book called Mythology of the Titans. It is said to be there, and she hopes its study will uncover secrets of the past.

quest:1054.text: Culling the Threat. Astranaar fears an attack from the Thistlefur furbolgs gathering to the north. Raene Wolfrunner asks you to kill their chieftain, Dal Bloodclaw, before they strike. Astranaar lies in the heart of Ashenvale, with danger close on every side. The Thistlefur furbolgs live just north of town. Once peaceful forest dwellers, they have fallen to madness and aggression, as have many of their kin. Sentinel scouts have watched their numbers grow over recent months. Now they fear the tribe will attack Astranaar as one. Raene Wolfrunner calls on travelers to strike before the Thistlefur overrun Astranaar's palisades. Dal Bloodclaw leads the tribe and gives its members order and courage. The Sentinels ask you to bring his skull back to Astranaar. They hope his death will break the furbolgs' unity and buy the beleaguered town precious time.

quest:1055.text: Raene's Cleansing. At the hidden shrine in Ashenvale, you have restored the Rod of Transformation. Now you must carry it back to Shael'dryn at her moonwell sanctuary. You have restored the Rod of Transformation at the hidden shrine in Ashenvale. Its shaft, pommel, and glowing gem are joined, and its magic has been renewed. Shael'dryn needs the rod for Raene's investigation of the furbolg attacks. Shael'dryn waits beside the forest moonwell where she guided the rod's restoration. You bring her the finished relic and confirm its magic has returned. Then the Sentinel defenders can take their next steps to protect their besieged homeland.

quest:1057.text: Reclaiming the Charred Vale. Keeper Albagorm sends Alliance fighters from Stonetalon Peak to drive Bloodfury harpies from the ruined Charred Vale. Their removal will clear the way for druids and caretakers to heal the scorched land. South of Stonetalon Peak, the Charred Vale lies in ash and smoldering ruins. A lush alpine haven once stood there. A mechanized logging and mining army stripped the trees and let fires rage unchecked. For the guardians of Stonetalon, the woodland's loss to industrial greed is a wound they cannot ignore. Bloodfury harpies claimed the ashes left by the mechanical fires. They swarm the smoking lowlands, nest there, and ambush anyone who approaches. Keeper Albagorm and his allies cannot cross the soil to sow seeds of renewal. The harpies bar every outsider's way. The Bloodfury roosts must be broken before restoration can begin. Keeper Albagorm sends seasoned Alliance fighters deep among the tribe to slay its hunters, ambushers, and roguefeathers. Their numbers must fall before the land can be reclaimed for nature and the forest spirits can breathe freely again.

quest:1058.text: Jin'Zil's Forest Magic. In Malaka'jin, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil holds three night elven scouts in crude iron cages. He sends Horde travelers north to gather reagents for a grim forest magic. Witch Doctor Jin'Zil practices his craft in Malaka'jin's red-rock defile, under the Horde's watch. When three night elf captives fall into his hands, he chooses a mocking ritual for his woodland foes instead of ordinary butchery. He sends you north into the peaks for thick tree sap, feline whiskers from predatory twilight runners, a shimmering fey dragon scale, and scores of eyes from local forest coursers.

quest:1059.text: Reclaiming the Charred Vale. Far to the south, Keeper Albagorm looks for help to restore the Charred Vale. The Bloodfury harpies have been driven back for now, but force alone cannot heal the wounded land. Ash covers the Charred Vale in southern Stonetalon Mountains, where terrible destruction has scarred the land. Alliance forces under Keeper Albagorm drove the Bloodfury harpies from their nests in the ruins, but the harpies may return. Force can only hold them back. The ravaged earth must heal before they come back to claim the Vale. The grove tenders cannot restore the scorched land alone. So Keeper Albagorm sends you south, past the salt flats and canyons of Thousand Needles, to Thalanaar on the border of Feralas. Falfindel Waywarder waits there. The night elf druid is known for a rare gift: calling ancient forest spirits to bring life back to dead soil.

quest:106.text: Young Lovers. Maybell Maclure loves Tommy Joe Stonefield, though their families are bitter rivals. She asks you to carry her letter to him by the river. The Stonefields and the Maclures have held their grudge for years in southern Elwynn's farm country. Maybell cannot visit Tommy Joe without stirring her family's anger. So she trusts travelers to carry her letters across the line between the two farms. Tommy Joe stays beyond his relatives' sight on the quiet riverbank just west of Stonefield Farm. A letter from Maybell brings relief and fresh longing. Being apart grows more than he can bear, and the pair begin seeking ways to meet in secret.

quest:1060.text: Letter to Jin'Zil. Darsok Swiftdagger sends you into Stonetalon Mountains with news for his old friend, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil. Serena Bloodfeather has fallen, and Darsok wants Jin'Zil to hear of her death. After Serena Bloodfeather falls, Darsok Swiftdagger sends you into Stonetalon Mountains. The Witchwing and Bloodfeather broods came from the rugged ridges northwest of the northern Barrens, not the scrublands. You have defeated Serena, and Darsok asks you to carry news of her death to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil, an old acquaintance. Jin'Zil lives at Malaka'jin, a troll settlement in the dangerous mountain peaks.

quest:1066.text: Blood of Innocents. In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon prepares a remedy for the Venture Company in Stonetalon Mountains. The Royal Apothecary Society turns to blood taken by local bandits to pacify the company. Horde leaders in Kalimdor have turned to the Royal Apothecary Society for help against the Venture Company. The company ravages the wilderness and harms its people, so Apothecary Lydon proposes alchemy instead of sending armies to blunt their axes. He means to brew an agent that will paralyze and pacify the mercenaries, leaving them weak and docile. Apothecary Lydon needs a rare and troubling ingredient: innocent blood. He will not send Horde agents to kill innocents, so he turns to the Syndicate's crimes. Fallen nobles and cutthroats occupy Durnholde Keep, where rogue shadow mages harvest innocent blood for profane rituals. Lydon targets those mages for alchemical supplies.

quest:1067.text: Return to Thunder Bluff. In Thunder Bluff, Zamah awaits the toxin Lydon made. She needs its formula to build a device that can spread it against the Venture Company. Apothecary Lydon made the toxin from ingredients gathered in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He wants to test it on living subjects, but first it needs a way to spread. You carry the vial across the Great Sea to Mulgore, where Apothecary Zamah waits.

quest:1068.text: Shredding Machines. In Windshear Crag, Venture Company shredders wound the spirits of Stonetalon. Seereth Stonebreak hears their cries as XT:4 and XT:9 cut through the forest. Orc shaman Seereth Stonebreak keeps watch along the dusty border between the Barrens and the Stonetalon Mountains. She listens to the unseen realm, but chaos drowns much of Stonetalon’s spiritual voice. One vision came through clear: man-shaped contraptions tearing through ancient woods at unnatural speed. Marked XT:4 and XT:9, the goblin-engineered shredders cut Windshear Crag’s timberlands and send waves of distress through the surrounding nature spirits. The Venture Company works in Windshear Crag, northwest of Greatwood Vale. To curb the damage, Horde champions go there and hunt down the logging constructs. Wrecking XT:4 and XT:9 strikes at the mountains’ commercial deforestation and quiets the wounded tree spirits’ immediate cries. Seereth warns that unless the Venture Company leaves Stonetalon entirely, far darker atrocities await the land.

quest:1069.text: Deepmoss Spider Eggs. In Ratchet, Mebok Mizzyrix sees a chance to sell Deepmoss Spider Eggs to Booty Bay. Spider egg omelettes have become a craze there, so he sends travelers into the Stonetalon Mountains to gather fresh clutches for trade across the sea. Wealthy patrons and eccentric pirates in Booty Bay have taken to spider egg omelettes. Their taste has driven demand for rare ingredients across the Great Sea. Ratchet merchant Mebok Mizzyrix sees a chance to make a fortune by supplying the southern port. The Eastern Kingdoms have no spiders that provide these eggs, so Mebok looks to Kalimdor’s wilderness. Deepmoss spider eggs lie in the Stonetalon Mountains, where the Venture Company has cut timber. Find clutches beneath the trees still standing at Windshear Crag, or farther in, among the web-covered depths of Sishir Canyon. Gathering them means facing venomous bites and thick infestations. Even seasoned scavengers may find the swarms hard to stomach. Fresh eggs must cross the sea before they spoil or hatch. Mebok works with Ratchet’s Wharfmaster Dizzywig to book freight aboard goblin merchant ships bound for the docks of Stranglethorn Vale. Once the eggs are packed into crates, Mebok earns a tidy profit from the high seas trade in fine food.

quest:107.text: Note to William. In southern Elwynn, Mildred asks William Pestle to help two young lovers. Her note travels to the apothecary in Goldshire, where she hopes he can help Maybell and Tommy Joe unite despite their families’ feud. Tommy Joe Stonefield and Maybell Maclure hide their love from their feuding families. The Stonefields and Maclures have lived as neighbors in southern Elwynn Forest for years. Yet their bitter rivalry makes even ordinary relations difficult. Gramma Mildred Stonefield pities the young lovers and seeks another way to bring them together. Mildred sends a courier north to the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, where William Pestle works as an alchemist and apothecary. She has known him for many years, and believes persuasion alone cannot sway the feuding families. Her message asks for his help. When William receives it, Maybell and Tommy Joe's plight moves him, and he resolves to use his alchemical knowledge on their behalf.

quest:1070.text: On Guard in Stonetalon. In Ashenvale, Sentinel Thenysil asks travelers to check on Kaela Shadowspear. Kaela went into Stonetalon to watch Venture Company incursions alongside a gnome mage, but no word has come from her. In Astranaar, Sentinel Thenysil watches for threats near the ancient forest. Her friend Kaela Shadowspear entered the Stonetalon Mountains at Sentinel Wolfrunner’s order, to survey trouble in the heights. Thenysil asks passing Alliance champions to find Kaela. No word has come, and she fears for her friend’s safety. A gnome mage assigned by Alliance leaders accompanies Kaela. The night elves joined the Grand Alliance for strategic reasons, yet many Sentinels distrust arcane practitioners and gnome tinkers in the wilderness. Kaela keeps an outpost on the bluffs above Windshear Crag. From there, she watches the Venture Company’s widespread devastation.

quest:1071.text: A Gnome's Respite. At Windshear Crag, the Venture Company presses into the forest while Gaxim Rustfizzle struggles to slow its advance. He asks travelers to drive back its workers so he can prepare new defenses. Gaxim Rustfizzle represents the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences. In Stonetalon's ancient groves, he hopes to show the nature-worshipping night elves that gnomish invention can defend their threatened lands. He joins magic, chemical brews and mechanics, yet the Venture Company's relentless pace leaves him little time to build defenses. At Windshear Crag, Gaxim sends travelers into the smoking works to turn back the Venture Co. Loggers and Deforesters. If they retreat, he will have time to organize his workshop and devise his next defense: controlled, strategic high explosives.

quest:1072.text: An Old Colleague. In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle seeks fuel for a powerful device. He sends you across the sea to Ironforge, where his old acquaintance Lomac Gearstrip can make the hazardous explosive Nitromirglyceronium. Gaxim Rustfizzle is planning his boldest engineering work yet in the Stonetalon Mountains. A mechanism of that scale needs fuel stronger than ordinary gunpowder or crude oil. He needs Nitromirglyceronium, also called NG-5. It is an explosive mix potent enough to ensure destruction if all goes according to plan. Lomac Gearstrip is the only person Gaxim knows who can refine NG-5. His old acquaintance lives far to the east in Tinker Town, the gnome quarter deep inside Ironforge. You make the long journey as Gaxim's courier. Lomac greets you with suspicion and paranoid questions.

quest:1073.text: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun. In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle seeks a powerful answer to the Venture Company. He asks you to travel across the sea to Ironforge, where Lomac Gearstrip will brew Nitromirglyceronium if you bring the needed alchemical reagents. Gaxim Rustfizzle needs powerful explosives for his finest device against the Venture Company. He is stationed high in the craggy passes of the Stonetalon Mountains, far from his former colleague Lomac Gearstrip in Ironforge. Lomac created Nitromirglyceronium, a brew so unstable and destructive that he laughs at the thought of anyone using it, whoever gets blown apart. Lomac wants to see goblin machinery blown to pieces, and perhaps you too. But his Ironforge workshop has run out of Nitromirglyceronium. Before he brews another batch, he asks you for Minor Mana Potions and Elixirs of Minor Fortitude. These draughts provide the raw reagents for his mixture, and gathering them lets Lomac judge whether you have any respect for alchemy.

quest:1074.text: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun. In the Stonetalon Mountains, Lomac Gearstrip sends volatile NG-5 to Gaxim Rustfizzle. The chemical can ignite wagons packed with dynamite, drawing enemies away while Alliance forces pursue their goals in the disputed crags. Lomac Gearstrip gives you Nitromirglyceronium, or NG-5, an unstable compound made through gnomish engineering. He warns you to handle it with care. Mishandled, it could blow you to pieces on the road back to Gaxim Rustfizzle.

quest:1075.text: A Scroll from Mauren. Gaxim Rustfizzle seeks a spell from Collin Mauren in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. He needs arcane help to trigger his NG-5 explosives from afar. Mechanical fuses cannot give Gaxim the control he needs. He wants to ignite the charges with one button while he stays beyond the blast. Arcane magic may carry a command from his hand to the explosives. Collin Mauren is a human spellcaster with practical knowledge of the arcane. He considers how to bind an explosive ignition to a distant command. Then he begins the incantation Gaxim needs for his dangerous project.

quest:1076.text: Devils in Westfall. Dust devils roam Westfall, and Collin Mauren needs their remains for a spell. The Mage Quarter wizard is helping Gaxim Rustfizzle with an unusual experiment. Their work calls for a messaging scroll, and the dust holds what Mauren needs to enchant it. Collin Mauren is preparing a messaging scroll for Gaxim Rustfizzle. The wizard is helping the tinkerer with an unusual venture, but the spell needs more than ink and vellum. Dust devils roam Westfall with elemental magic swirling within them. Their remains provide the volatile medium Mauren needs to bind Gaxim's spell to parchment. Westfall was once Stormwind's fertile breadbasket. Drought, banditry, and neglect have left its fields arid and wild. Dust devils roam there, threatening travelers and lone homesteaders. Their residue holds the focused elemental essence Mauren needs to complete the enchantment.

quest:1077.text: Special Delivery for Gaxim. Gaxim Rustfizzle waits in Stonetalon for an enchanted scroll from Stormwind. Its magic may let him set off an explosive from afar and hinder the Venture Company's deforestation. Gaxim Rustfizzle is trying to hinder the Venture Company's destructive work in the Stonetalon Mountains. He has made an explosive compound called NG-5, but has no sure way to set it off from afar. So he sought help across the Great Sea. In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Collin Mauren has made an enchanted Scroll of Messaging for him.

quest:1078.text: Retrieval for Mauren. In Stormwind, Collin Mauren asks travelers bound for Kalimdor to bring rare basilisk scales. He wants scales from the Charred Vale in Stonetalon, ground to dust for his spellcraft. In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, wizard Collin Mauren listens to tales from wandering adventurers. He has heard that travelers venture deep into Kalimdor, where Stonetalon draws those seeking wild wyverns, unruly elementals, or dealings and clashes with the Venture Company. Mauren seeks neither riches nor glory. He wants to learn what rare natural wonders survive in the region's harshest corners. Deep in Stonetalon, the Charred Vale is an ash-choked basin scarred by the Venture Company's devastation. Mauren's studies say a peculiar breed of basilisk once lived there. Ground to fine powder, their scales can catalyze specialized arcane spells he has devised. Mauren does not know whether the basilisks survived the Vale's harsh transformation. So he asks explorers to bring back fresh crystallised scales and learn whether the breed endures.

quest:1079.text: Covert Ops - Alpha. Alliance agents move against the Venture Company in the Stonetalon Mountains. Under Gaxim Rustfizzle, they enter the lumber mill in Windshear Crag to recover its engineering schematics. From Windshear Crag, Gaxim Rustfizzle directs a covert effort against the Venture Company's aggressive logging. Goblin loggers cut timber south of Cragpool Lake. Destruction alone cannot stop them, so Plan Alpha sends agents past the loggers and overseers to take the mill's technical schematics. The Venture Company's schematics interest gnomes for more than the night elves' forests. They reveal how goblin loggers, mechanical cutters and mechanized transports work. Alliance engineers can study their structural flaws to break up future operations. They can also adapt goblin designs for their own projects in Ironforge.

quest:1080.text: Covert Ops - Beta. In Stonetalon, Gaxim Rustfizzle sends an agent into the Venture Company’s mine. Explosives draw the goblins away while the agent takes letters that reveal company plans and help defend Sentinel lands. After the first blows against the Venture Company’s logging at Windshear Crag, Gaxim Rustfizzle turns to its supply heart. As before, explosives will scatter goblin workers and mercenaries. Then an agent searches the mine for written orders and records. At the eastern edge of Windshear Crag, Windshear Mine is the Venture Company’s base beneath the mountain. Goblins dig for rock and cut timber there, keeping records of supply routes and orders from their leaders. An agent slips inside, sets Gaxim’s explosive packs, and takes the Venture Co. Letters. The blast disrupts the mine’s guard, and the letters reveal more of the company’s plans in Kalimdor. Gaxim takes pleasure in clever devices and explosions. His work also matters to the night elves. In Stonetalon, the Sentinels face the Horde and the companies cutting and digging through their lands. Letters from the mine give commanders such as Kaela Shadowspear information to anticipate threats to the sacred woods.

quest:1081.text: Reception from Tyrande. At the Temple of the Moon, Tyrande Whisperwind receives you after your aid in Stonetalon. Sentinel Thenysil sends you from Astranaar to Darnassus for an audience with the High Priestess. The Venture Company presses the night elf outposts across the Stonetalon Mountains. Sentinel Thenysil directs their defense from Astranaar, but the distant bases are difficult to supply. Supplies and intelligence help the Sentinels hold an Alliance presence in Kalimdor's interior. Your aid strengthens their position. After your aid bolsters the Sentinels in Stonetalon, Sentinel Thenysil sends you back to Teldrassil. Tyrande Whisperwind, the High Priestess, receives you at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She recognizes your deeds across Kalimdor and welcomes you as an ally fighting beside the kaldorei.

quest:1082.text: Update for Sentinel Thenysil. In Astranaar, Sentinel Tara Thenysil awaits word from Stonetalon. After helping Kaela Shadowspear and Gaxim Rustfizzle against the Venture Company, you carry news that their outpost still holds. Stonetalon's jagged passes leave the night elf frontier isolated and exposed. The Venture Company cuts into the crags and pollutes the waterways, threatening the outpost where Kaela Shadowspear and the gnome tinkerer Gaxim Rustfizzle serve. With the immediate danger blunted, Kaela sends you northeast across the border into Ashenvale. You are to report that they remain safe. In Astranaar, Sentinel Tara Thenysil watches Ashenvale's interior roads and worries over scouts sent into harsher lands. News that Kaela and her engineering partner are alive and working to heal the land brings relief. Though their forces dwindle and threats press on several fronts, cooperation with Alliance allies can slow the destruction.

quest:1083.text: Enraged Spirits. In the Charred Vale, Enraged Spirits overrun the burned basin. Fire and heavy machinery laid waste to the land, and the freed elementals now rage there. Alliance champions are asked to quell them so the wounded land may heal under Elune’s grace. The Charred Vale was once a lush haven in Stonetalon. The Venture Company’s greed turned it to ash as goblins sought to log the forest and strip its resources. They used incendiary devices and heavy machinery, setting the canopy ablaze. The trees fell, and the fragile elemental balance beneath the earth was shattered. The Venture Company’s work stirred ancient spirits of fire, stone, and fury from the depths. The elementals’ fury fell upon the goblins, driving them back as the spirits claimed the smoldering crater. Kaela Shadowspear says nature cannot begin to recover while these chaotic elementals remain.

quest:1084.text: Wounded Ancients. Goblin weapons may be poisoning the treants in the Stonetalon Mountains. Kaela Shadowspear asks you to gather shrapnel from the maddened guardians for Gaxim Rustfizzle to study. The treants once guarded Stonetalon's groves, fierce in defense and bound to the land's health. When the Venture Company came with buzzsaws, explosives, and strip-mining, the forest fought back. The treants drove the invaders from parts of the vale, but they did not return to their peaceful watch. Now they are hostile and maddened. Kaela Shadowspear, an Alliance scout in the mountains, believes no natural sickness afflicts the treants. Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome engineer, suspects goblin weapons and chemicals harmed them during the Venture Company's chaotic retreat. He hopes corroded shrapnel from the wounded treants will show whether Venture Company ordnance is poisoning Stonetalon's ancient protectors.

quest:1085.text: On Guard in Stonetalon. At a camp near Windshear Crag, Kaela Shadowspear sends Alliance travelers to Gaxim Rustfizzle for aid against the Venture Company. Together, the cautious night elf sentinel and eccentric gnome tinkerer guard the mountain pass from the company's rampant despoilment. The Venture Company cuts into the wilderness of Stonetalon Mountains and fells its ancient trees. Kaela Shadowspear, a night elf sentinel, knows martial skill alone cannot stop such industrial pillaging. So she turns to gnome ingenuity, though night elves and gnomes seldom agree about technology or the natural world. Their alliance shows how precarious the struggle has become. Gaxim Rustfizzle brings the eccentric pragmatism of the Alliance's smaller allies. Night elf society turned from arcane excess millennia ago, but Gaxim believes rejecting magic and technical innovation leaves the night elves vulnerable. He hopes to show his Kaldorei hosts that practical science can defend nature alongside bow and glaive.

quest:1086.text: The Flying Machine Airport. Apothecary Zamah sends you to silence The Flying Machine Airport above Stonetalon. Carry her Toxic Fogger into the Venture Company’s logging grounds and strike at the cartel’s link to the outside world. Apothecary Zamah prepares Apothecary Lydon’s toxin for the Venture Company. The tauren want to protect Stonetalon from deforestation and ravaging machinery, while the Forsaken take another path. Zamah aims at the cartel’s connection beyond the mountains, not its foot soldiers or loggers. Rumor speaks of a copter pad carrying light cargo and messages between Stonetalon and distant corporate offices. The Venture Company’s copter pad lies high in the Cragpool Lake area, south of the great waterwheel. A small platform there serves lightweight flying machines, not massive zeppelins. You are sent to set off the Toxic Fogger, filling the pad with toxic vapor before a pilot, courier, or mechanic can alert the company’s commanders.

quest:1087.text: Cenarius' Legacy. Near Sun Rock Retreat, Cenarius' Legacy turns Braelyn Firehand's grievance into a call to arms. The blood elf mage says the night elves and Cenarius's children suppress the land's magic. She wants them culled at Stonetalon Peak so raw arcane power can flow freely, while their defeat weakens the Alliance presence in the mountains. Braelyn Firehand lives in the hills near Sun Rock Retreat, frustrated by Stonetalon's natural wards. She says the druids of the Cenarion Circle and the offspring of the demigod Cenarius choke the land's arcane currents. To Braelyn, channeling power here is like drawing water with a perforated bucket. She wants to strip away those defenses and let raw magical energy surge freely again. Braelyn sends Horde champions north to Stonetalon Peak to break the wardens' hold. Ancient kaldorei groves and temple grounds there are patrolled by Cenarion Botanists and the proud Sons and Daughters of Cenarius. Striking them down would weaken the wards that muffle Braelyn's spellcraft. It would also deal a bloody blow to the night elf enclave that threatens the Horde's foothold in the mountains.

quest:1088.text: Ordanus. At Sunrock Retreat, Braelyn Firehand hunts Keeper Ordanus, an elder son of Cenarius who fled Stonetalon Peak. She believes his people desecrated ancient Highborne ruins, so she sends Horde champions across the border into Ashenvale to take his head. Braelyn Firehand came to Stonetalon Mountains on her master's orders. She was sent to reclaim the sacred ruins of Azshara's ancient temples. At the peak, she found night elves treating relics of her Highborne forebears as wilderness to be contained. Keeper Ordanus escaped her and crossed into Ashenvale. Using arcane vision, Braelyn found him high in a wooden refuge at Raynewood Retreat, then enlisted the Horde to finish the hunt. Keeper Ordanus is counted among the eldest of Cenarius's sons, with deep ties to Kalimdor's wild magics. Night elf guardians moved him from Stonetalon Peak to Raynewood Retreat to shield him from arcane forces encroaching on sacred groves. Loyal Cenarion Vindicators and summoned woodland treants defend him. To Braelyn, Ordanus carries the forest demigod's ancient authority and stands in the way of her vengeance.

quest:1089.text: The Den. At the Talon Den, Braelyn Firehand sends Horde champions into hidden barrow chambers to take the druids' relics. Beneath Stonetalon Peak, they face defenses built to keep those treasures safe. The Talon Den lies high in the Stonetalon Mountains, where night elf druids shelter in halls carved deep into living stone. Its barrow chambers protect meditating guardians and sacred treasures. Braelyn Firehand knows what lies within, so she questions a captured druid to learn how the defenses work.

quest:1090.text: Gerenzo's Orders. At the Venture Company dig site in Stonetalon, Piznik works against his new boss, Gerenzo. The ousted goblin digs a sample to expose the ore operation while an ally guards him from patrols at the camp. At Windshear Crag, the Venture Company rewards ruthlessness over loyalty. Piznik once served as second-in-command at the excavation. Then Gerenzo seized power, fired supervisor Ziz Fizziks, and sent Piznik back to the mines with a pick. Yet Piznik stayed. At Ziz's instruction, he became an informant, watching Gerenzo's every move and waiting for a chance to strike back at the supervisor who displaced him. Gerenzo's takeover began with an obsession: strange gold-green ore in the Stonetalon rock. He believes the mineral is worth an extraordinary sum, and ordered miners to tear it from the earth in huge quantities. Ziz Fizziks now has a mysterious employer who may pay well for news of the venture. So Piznik risks discovery to dig out a sample. An ally holds off aggressive diggers, vermin, and overseers who police the operation.

quest:1091.text: Kaela's Update. Gaxim Rustfizzle sends you back to Kaela Shadowspear with letters taken from the Venture Company. Their contents help the Sentinels track the goblin cartel's work in Stonetalon. With his magic, Gaxim Rustfizzle hinders the Venture Company on the Sentinels' side. You helped the gnome mage uncover Venture Company movements, and he gathered correspondence about the cartel's operations. Kaela, a night elf Sentinel coordinator near Windshear Crag, is waiting for the letters. Gaxim also asks you to tell her how his magic helped the investigation. The Sentinels watch Stonetalon's crags with concern. Horde forces contest the lower trails, while the Venture Company cuts trees and mines the land. Its letters show Kaela how the cartel communicates, helping the Alliance plan defenses along the ridges.

quest:1092.text:
Gerenzo's Orders. At Windshear Crag, Piznik sends an ore sample from the Venture Company workings to Ziz Fizziks, his contact beyond the dig site. The delivery ends a dangerous act of espionage. Piznik's cover at Windshear Crag is blown, and he can no longer stay with the Venture Company crew. Management in Undermine punishes sabotage within its ranks, so the nervous goblin plans to slip away and find another employer.

Before he leaves, Piznik gives an outsider the Unidentified Ore mined under Gerenzo's orders. The sample must reach its destination without drawing suspicion to him.

quest:1093.text: Super Reaper 6000. At Windshear Crag, Ziz Fizziks hopes to win favor with his new boss, Sputtervalve. He wants the Venture Company’s plans for a great woodcutting machine designed by his rival, Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle. At Windshear Crag, the Venture Trading Company cuts into the Stonetalon Mountains to supply its logging operation. Ziz Fizziks, a goblin engineer cast out of the company, now works for Sputtervalve. He hopes to prove his worth by taking the plans for the company’s massive automated woodcutting machine, the Super Reaper 6000.

quest:1094.text: Further Instructions. Ziz Fizziks sends stolen Venture Company plans from Windshear Crag to Ratchet. They may give his rival Sputtervalve an edge. Ziz Fizziks carries the Venture Company’s secrets from Windshear Crag. The company cast him out of its logging operations, and he took sensitive documents with him. He sealed internal manuals and technical schematics in an envelope bound for Ratchet. Among them are blueprints for the experimental Super Reaper 6000. Bitter over his dismissal, Fizziks hopes to find a buyer or ally willing to use what he stole. In Ratchet, the neutral port in the Barrens, engineer Sputtervalve waits. He has little trust or affection for Fizziks, yet their common rival makes the offer hard to refuse. The Steamwheedle-aligned goblins seek ways to weaken the ruthless Venture Company. They eagerly reverse-engineer superior mechanical inventions they come across.

quest:1095.text: Further Instructions. In the Stonetalon Mountains, Sputtervalve carries an order from Undermine to Ziz Fizziks. Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, hired by Mogul Razdunk, must be eliminated. The Trade Princes have heard that Mogul Razdunk hired Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, and the news has stirred trouble in Undermine. Director Riddlevox tells Sputtervalve to intervene quietly. Believing the order comes from the highest trade authorities, Sputtervalve passes the work to Ziz Fizziks, the operative nearest the scene.

quest:1096.text: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle. Above Cragpool Lake, Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle awaits a bounty in the Stonetalon Mountains. The rogue gnome overseer has replaced much of his rotting flesh with gears, clockwork machinery, and artificial limbs. Ziz Fizziks wants his mechanical arm as proof of his death, hoping it will win him a promotion. Gerenzo’s body bears the marks of his transformations. Those who have seen him say his natural flesh rots beneath grafted gears, iron plating, and whirring clockwork limbs. Near the great water wheel above Cragpool Lake, he watches the operations. His failing flesh does not concern him. Ziz Fizziks works for Sputtervalve and hopes Gerenzo’s death will carry him out of Stonetalon. Ziz cannot climb the cliffs and defeat the augmented overseer alone, so he asks you to bring back Gerenzo’s mechanical arm. He hopes the arm will prove his worth and earn him a transfer to the Tinkers’ Union workshops in Gadgetzan or Undermine. Gerenzo’s mechanical arm reflects a sharp divide between gnome and goblin engineering. He cut away failing flesh to make room for complex prosthetics, a choice goblins find baffling. Ziz believes goblin ingenuity would keep the natural limb and add an explosive third arm beside it.

quest:1098.text: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang. At Shadowfang Keep, Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent are missing. High Executor Hadrec sends Horde champions inside to find the scouts and recover their reports. Their intelligence is needed before the Forsaken can strike at Archmage Arugal and his worgen packs. Silverpine Forest is still contested, and Archmage Arugal's worgen hold Shadowfang Keep. At the Sepulcher, the Forsaken seek to break his siege on their southern borders. High Executor Hadrec sent Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent into the fortress to chart its defenses. Days pass without word, and Hadrec grows desperate for their reports. So he sends Horde champions inside to find the agents and salvage the operation.

quest:1100.text: Lonebrow's Journal. At the Great Lift in Thousand Needles, Henrig Lonebrow lies dead with Lonebrow's Journal in his hand. Its pages trace his last journey and ask you to carry the book west to a night elf druid at the Feralas border. Henrig Lonebrow lies near the Great Lift, the huge machine that carries travelers from the Barrens to the floor of Thousand Needles. His journal remains in his hand, filled with notes from his travels through the canyon. Centaur and tauren hold this harsh country. His death shows the peril of traveling here alone. Henrig's journal records the route he meant to take and his final wish. He hoped his records would reach friendly hands instead of decaying in the canyon. Follow the road west across Thousand Needles and out of its dry gullies toward Thalanaar. The night elf outpost guards the Feralas border, where its druid, Falfindel Waywarder, awaits news from you.

quest:1101.text:
The Crone of the Kraul. At Thalanaar, between Feralas and the Thousand Needles, Falfindel Waywarder seeks help against Charlga Razorflank. Henrig Lonebrow's recovered journal warns of growing danger inside Razorfen Kraul. At secluded Thalanaar, the night elf outpost, Falfindel Waywarder mourns the druid Heralath and the dwarf Henrig Lonebrow. Lonebrow traveled with the Explorers' League before the quilboar captured him. He escaped Razorfen Kraul, but died on the road. His tattered journal tells of the growing menace within.

There is no time to send a runner to Darnassus for military aid. So Falfindel turns to passing adventurers, sending them into the thorned dens to face the danger at its heart. Charlga Razorflank is an ancient geomancer and ruthless matriarch. She has united the fractious Razorfen quilboar under her iron rule. From deep within the Kraul, she marshals a bristling army that threatens neighboring lands.

Thick thorn mazes, battlement walls and swarms of fanatical quilboar warriors guard the way to Charlga. Her medallion, taken from her lifeless body, will prove her downfall.

quest:1103.text: Call of Water. Along Silverpine Forest's coast, Tiev Mordune waits to help shamans whose spirit-sight fades too soon. A fresh Water Sapta lets them return to the shrine and speak with the purified water spirit. Shamans drink a Water Sapta to see spirits near the elemental shrines. If its magic fades before they speak with the Minor Manifestation of Water, they can no longer enter the spirit realm to finish the trial. On Silverpine Forest's fog-shrouded shore, fellow shaman Tiev Mordune helps those whose visions end too soon. Tiev Mordune has defeated the corrupt water spirit off the coast and waits with the ritual remnants he gathered. To show you are ready, bring a fresh Water Sapta from Islen Waterseer in the Barrens. Tiev casts his gathered bracers and droplets into the shrine's brazier. The pure manifestation appears again, so you can speak with it and seal your bond with the element.

quest:1104.text: Salt Flat Venom. At the Mirage Raceway, Fizzle Brassbolts seeks hotter fuel for his rocket car. He believes scorpid venom from the Shimmering Flats can give it the fierce burn he needs. At the Mirage Raceway, gnomish precision meets goblin audacity in contests of speed and invention. Fizzle Brassbolts wants more from fuel and clockwork parts. He seeks a mixture that burns hotter than common propellants and sends rocket cars racing across the dry salt lake at blistering speed. Scorpids in the Shimmering Flats may hold the key to Fizzle's new fuel. They endure an arid wasteland crusted with salt, and their venom carries an unusual amount of it. Fizzle sees a useful chemical payload in their deadly sting. He believes boiling and refining the venom, then treating it with exotic catalysts, can create the fierce combustion needed to leave the goblin pit crews behind.

quest:1105.text: Hardened Shells. At the Mirage Raceway, Wizzle Brassbolts fears his brother’s fuel will eat through their racer. He seeks tortoise shells to shield the tanks. At the Mirage Raceway, Wizzle Brassbolts and his brother race to outdo goblin engineers. Their custom rocket car runs on an experimental fuel mixture his brother has made. The mixture is so potent that Wizzle fears it will eat through the car’s usual chassis and tanks. He needs a container sturdy enough to hold it across the Shimmering Flats. Wizzle turns to the tortoises native to Thousand Needles. Their shells resist harsh elements and mechanical wear, so they may hold where refined metal fails. He hopes to gather the hardened shells and shape them into fuel tanks. They must contain the volatile mixture and keep the rocket car from blowing to pieces.

quest:1106.text: Martek the Exiled. At the Mirage Raceway, Fizzle Brassbolts seeks pistons strong enough for the engine he hopes will carry his car into the air. He sends you with a letter to Martek the Exiled, camped in the Badlands. After Salt Flat Venom, Fizzle tells you his new engine should make his car so fast it could fly. His trials have failed because he cannot forge pistons strong enough for the strain. He knows one smith who may help: Martek the Exiled, who knows more about metal than anyone. Martek camps far away in the Badlands with a goblin, and you carry Fizzle's letter to him.

quest:1107.text: Encrusted Tail Fins. At the Mirage Raceway, Wizzle Brassbolts fears the rocket car’s speed will tear it apart. Saltscale murloc tail fins from the Vile Reef off Stranglethorn Vale may protect it. Wizzle calls the rocket car the fastest thing on the Shimmering Flats. Yet friction may tear it apart. Its moving parts need a coating that is hard without being brittle and can resist salt corrosion. Otherwise, the flats will eat away at the car. The key ingredient is ten tail fins from the Saltscale murlocs at the Vile Reef off Stranglethorn Vale.

quest:1108.text: Indurium. In the Badlands, Martek the Exiled seeks metal samples for Fizzle's car. Indurium is said to endure heat and stress, and Stonevault troggs sometimes carry flakes. Martek the Exiled stays in the Badlands for more than solitude. He thinks indurium might suit Fizzle's car because it is said to endure heat and stress. He wants samples for a test, with the forge ready. True indurium ore lies deep in Uldaman, but Stonevault troggs in the Badlands sometimes carry flakes. Martek asks for ten. The troggs roam the south-east slope of a rocky clump at Agmond's End, just south of the Valley of Fangs.

quest:1110.text: Rocket Car Parts. At the Mirage Raceway, Rocket Car Parts lie scattered across the Shimmering Flats after racers crash. Kravel Koalbeard pays travelers to gather the wreckage and sell it back to rival crews. Goblin and gnomish engineers race to outdo one another across the Shimmering Flats. Their experimental rocket cars often fail at speed. Twisted gears, cylinders, and jagged metal scatter over the white desert. As pit crews build and tune their next machines, the salt flats gather what the racers leave behind. Kravel Koalbeard makes his profit as a middleman at the Mirage Raceway instead of competing on the track. Gnome and goblin mechanics use parts quickly and are always short of spare mechanisms for their vehicles. So Koalbeard pays travelers to gather thirty bundles of shattered debris. He turns each crash into stock he can sell back to the crews.

quest:1111.text: Wharfmaster Dizzywig. At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard sends you to Ratchet for parts the gnomes are waiting on. Kravel Koalbeard tends to the needs of the Mirage Raceway. A batch of parts reached Ratchet a week ago, and the gnomes are waiting. Since Kravel cannot make the journey himself, he asks you to carry his order. If you do, he promises more work with serious profit potential. Ratchet lies in the Barrens, where Kravel expects Wharfmaster Dizzywig to be at the docks. The goblin is the one you need to see. You carry Kravel's Parts Order there.

quest:1112.text: Parts for Kravel. At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard awaits the package you carry from Wharfmaster Dizzywig. Dizzywig sends a warning with it: Kravel must pay his tab before he can receive more special orders. Wharfmaster Dizzywig gives you a package for Kravel Koalbeard at the Mirage Raceway. The Raceway lies in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles. Dizzywig asks you to carry a warning with the package: Kravel must pay what he owes before he can receive more special orders.

quest:1114.text: Delivery to the Gnomes. Kravel Koalbeard sends Delicate Car Parts from the Mirage Raceway to Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats. Fizzle has waited a long time for them, and Kravel asks you to keep quiet about one small piece he removed. Kravel Koalbeard sends the parts to Fizzle Brassbolts, who has waited a long time for them. Kravel admits he removed one little piece from Fizzle's order. He says it is small and worthless, and that Fizzle will not miss it. Then he asks you to trust him and leave it unmentioned.

quest:1115.text: The Rumormonger. At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard now has a question about Nazz Steamboil. The goblin racer pilot once used another name, and Kravel wonders whether the secret could bring profit. He sends you to Krazek in Booty Bay, who may know. Kravel Koalbeard says the goblins are next in line for a favor. He has heard that Nazz Steamboil, the goblin racer pilot, once used another name. Why did it change? Might Nazz be keeping a secret? Kravel believes Krazek knows the truth. You can find Krazek at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay, at Stranglethorn's southern tip. Useful information might turn a profit.

quest:1116.text: Dream Dust in the Swamp. In the Swamp of Sorrows, Krazek asks you to gather ten specks of dream dust from dragon whelps. He contacts sources about Nazz while seeking dust for his snuff pouch. Bring it back to him for the information you seek. Krazek says that learning about Nazz is a considerable favor, and you have traveled a long way from the Shimmering Flats to ask. While he contacts sources, he asks you to gather ten specks of dream dust from dragon whelps in the Swamp of Sorrows. The dust is for his snuff pouch. Bring it back, and Krazek will give you the information you seek. Green dragons in the Swamp of Sorrows carry dream dust. Adolescent whelps and dreaming whelps can be found in the swamp’s south-western corner.

quest:1117.text: Rumors for Kravel. At last, Krazek has a letter about Nazz Steamboil for you to carry to Kravel Koalbeard at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats. Keep its origin secret. Krazek spent favors, a rare bottle of elven wine, and hours of deducing to learn about Nazz Steamboil. His letter holds very interesting bits about the goblin racer pilot. Krazek considers the letter too dangerous to use and leaves it to you, provided nobody learns where it came from. Carry it to Kravel Koalbeard on the Shimmering Flats.

quest:1130.text: Melor Sends Word. In the Barrens, Jorn Skyseer carries Melor Stonehoof's summons to promising hunters. Hunters who have proved their grit across Kalimdor are called to Hunter's Rise in Thunder Bluff for a harder trial. Jorn Skyseer watches the crossings and encampments of the Barrens. He carries word from the elders of Hunter's Rise to hunters and warriors who have shown promise in the surrounding lands. Melor Stonehoof, a revered tauren mentor, has marked out a path for them. At Hunter's Rise in Thunder Bluff, you meet Melor Stonehoof. The elder hunter asks whether you have the resolve to enter distant and perilous wilderness. His summons leads to trials far beyond Mulgore's safety, where hunters face the continent's fiercest predators.

quest:1131.text: Steelsnap. In Thousand Needles, Melor Stonehoof sends you after Steelsnap and his pack, which terrorize the wildlife. This hunt serves a different purpose from the usual reasons tauren take a life. Tauren hunters take life for food, honor, or wisdom from the Earthmother. Melor Stonehoof sends you after Steelsnap for another reason. The hyena threatens nature’s balance with senseless violence and fear, rather than keeping the cycle of life. Steelsnap roams the canyons of northern Thousand Needles, south of the centaur enclave at Camp E'thok. Fierce hyenas follow him, and together they attack the gentler wildlife on the canyon floor. Slay Steelsnap and bring back his rib to end his hold over the needles.

quest:1132.text: Fiora Longears. From Menethil Harbor, you sail west across the Great Sea to meet Fiora Longears in Theramore. Red Jack Flint sends you to his high elf contact at the town inn. Many humans, dwarves, and gnomes look upon the Eastern Kingdoms and see old conflicts and damaged earth. At Menethil Harbor, sailor Red Jack Flint urges travelers to board a ship across the Great Sea. He speaks of Kalimdor as an uncharted land of fortune and opportunity. Then he sends you to Theramore to meet his associate, the elf Fiora Longears. Your voyage ends at Theramore, an Alliance port on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh. Fiora Longears waits at the town inn for travelers sent by Flint. She trusts his judgment of character and welcomes the Alliance heroes who have just arrived. From there, she prepares to guide you inland toward Ashenvale's ancient forests.

quest:1133.text: Journey to Astranaar. From Theramore, Fiora Longears sends Alliance travelers north to Astranaar. There, they report to Shindrell Swiftfire as war and unrest trouble Ashenvale. Alliance travelers reach Dustwallow Marsh by ferry from Menethil Harbor, often seeking purpose in northern Kalimdor. At Theramore, Fiora Longears sends capable hands inland to Astranaar, Ashenvale's main night elven settlement. The road passes beneath ancient, shadowed canopies and enters a forest strained by war and unrest. Fiora asks travelers not to mention her name in Astranaar, because Shindrell Swiftfire does not know her. Fiora directs fresh Alliance talent to places where help is needed, and Shindrell welcomes able-bodied defenders when they arrive. Ashenvale remains breathtaking, though it is no longer the peaceful sanctuary it once was.

quest:1134.text:
Pridewings of Stonetalon. In the Stonetalon Mountains, Shindrell hears that pridewing venom may threaten the uneasy peace. Theramore reports an unconfirmed claim that orc assassins gather the poison for covert raids. Astranaar's Sentinels send scouts south to claim the venom sacs first. The Alliance and Horde have not declared open war across northern Kalimdor. Yet their peace is fragile. Skirmishes break out beneath the forest canopy, and quiet attacks take the place of full armies. In Astranaar, Sentinel commanders watch enemy movements. One careless moment could put their sanctuary at risk. Shindrell has heard an unconfirmed report from contacts in Theramore about activity in the crags of Stonetalon. Orcish stalkers are said to gather venom from wild pridewings around Mirkfallon Lake, then coat their blades for deadly ambushes against Alliance forces.

So Shindrell Swiftfire sends champions to kill the beasts and claim their venom sacs before Horde agents can reach them. Shindrell Swiftfire regrets ordering the deaths of native beasts. Night elves revere Kalimdor's wilderness, and these creatures had no part in choosing the war. Yet Astranaar's defenders cannot let an enemy gather poison for lethal attacks. The beasts pay for that defense with their lives.
