After the raptor hunt outside camp, Mosh'Ogg ogres at Mizjah Ruins keep attacking the caravans. Commander Aggro'gosh must keep supplies moving from Grom'gol through Stranglethorn Vale to Stonard, an outpost vital to the Horde. He did not come to fight every people of the Vale. Yet the Mosh'Ogg ogres have taken Mizjah Ruins southeast of camp, and warnings have not stopped their repeated attacks on Horde caravans. So Aggro'gosh orders a strike against the ogres and witch doctors holding the ruins.

quest:57.text: The Night Watch. Across Duskwood, restless dead rise from their graves, and The Night Watch struggles to hold them back. Commander Althea Ebonlocke sends travelers into the haunted barrows to defend Darkshire. Their fight may keep the town from falling to darkness. Duskwood’s graveyards stir beneath the forest’s twilight. Commander Althea Ebonlocke leads Darkshire’s volunteer militia, The Night Watch, against the rising dead. Stormwind sends no aid, and her forces are stretched thin. Skeletons and other horrors threaten the eastern settlements, so the militia calls on able travelers to enter the deadlands. Two places hold the militia’s attention: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, just south of town, and Raven Hill Graveyard, far to the west. Skeletons rise from forgotten tombs and shallow graves beside the roads, stirred by dark magic in the forest’s shadows. Cutting them down gives Darkshire’s beleaguered citizens room to breathe. Yet the battle against this entrenched evil never ends.

quest:570.text: Mok'thardin's Enchantment. At Grom'gol Base Camp, Far Seer Mok'thardin gathers the jungle's power for the Horde. His earlier rites have succeeded, and he seeks sharp claws and a pristine feline fang for an enchantment. At Grom'gol Base Camp, Far Seer Mok'thardin studies the wild's feral power. He seeks to bend it for the Horde. His first rites have succeeded, and he offers to shape an enchanted relic. Those willing must enter the thick underbrush and hunt the deadly predators nearby. Mok'thardin's rite calls for eight claws from shadowmaw panthers and a pristine fang from a tigress. The fierce cats roam across Stranglethorn Vale. Many prowl southeast of the Mizjah Ruins, just beyond the river.

quest:574.text:
Special Forces. At the Kurzen Compound, Sergeant Yohwa sets her sights on the colonel's elite troops. You enter the Stockpile cave to face the commandos and headshrinkers, then report to Lieutenant Doren. Sergeant Yohwa now targets the elite specialists at the Kurzen Compound. The Second Rebellion has weakened Kurzen's regular soldiers, and Yohwa knows many of his troops personally. She calls them skilled, loyal and cruel.

When they are not in the wilderness slaughtering rebel soldiers, the commandos and headshrinkers gather in the Stockpile cave at the back of the compound. To weaken Kurzen further, you enter and kill ten Kurzen Commandos and six Kurzen Headshrinkers. After the fight, Sergeant Yohwa sends you to her commanding officer, Lieutenant Doren, at the Rebel Camp. He will want to hear your account firsthand.

quest:5741.text: Sceptre of Light. At Thunder Axe Fortress, the Burning Blade has the Sceptre of Light, said to have come from the naga. Azore Aldamort fears it can sink whole cities beneath the great seas, so he asks you to bring it to Ethel Rethor. Word has spread that the Burning Blade at Thunder Axe Fortress holds the naga's Sceptre of Light. Legend says the sceptre can sink whole cities beneath the great seas. Azore Aldamort will not let the Burning Blade keep such power. A Burning Blade seer keeps the sceptre in a watchtower atop the fortress and studies it there. Azore asks you to take the sceptre from the seer and carry it back to the tower at Ethel Rethor.

quest:575.text: Supply and Demand. In Booty Bay, Drizzlik is preparing an order for Director Riddlevox, chief inventor of the Tinkers' Union. The leathercrafter claims to be the finest in the South Seas and beyond. Drizzlik calls his leatherwork exquisite and famed everywhere. Director Riddlevox has ordered twelve Excelsior-line boots, among Drizzlik's best sellers and the boots Riddlevox favors. To begin shaping them, Drizzlik needs skins from crocolisks by the northern Stranglethorn river. His equipment is ready, and leaving so important a customer unsatisfied would be a poor idea.

quest:5762.text: Hemet Nesingwary. A crate delayed on the road from Kalimdor reaches the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale by sea. At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard sends special supplies to Hemet Nesingwary, the renowned big-game hunter. At the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats, Kravel Koalbeard receives a long-overdue crate for one of his wealthy patrons. Hemet Nesingwary had already left Thousand Needles, but he paid to have the crate sent on to his hunting camp in Stranglethorn Vale. Kravel stays behind rather than face the arduous journey himself. So he hires passing adventurers to carry the crate across the sea. North of Grom'gol Base Camp, Hemet Nesingwary's expedition receives the heavy crate. It holds specialized heavy-gauge ammunition for bringing down the jungle's dangerous predators. Hemet recognizes the white salt crust on the courier's gear. His old dealings with Kravel have brought the firepower his safari needed.

quest:5763.text:
Hunting in Stranglethorn. You carry Roon Wildmane's token north of Grom'gol Base Camp to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn. The tauren and dwarf once hunted together in Desolace. Roon Wildmane remembers hunting beside Hemet, a dwarf who came to Desolace to hunt great beasts. Hemet wielded a rifle with uncanny skill. For many days, the two hunted together and set aside the old enmity between their peoples.

When Hemet left for Stranglethorn, Roon vowed to welcome him back for another hunt. Now Roon sends you with his kodo horn, a token Hemet will recognize. Find Hemet in Stranglethorn, north of Grom'gol Base Camp.

quest:577.text: Some Assembly Required. In Booty Bay, Drizzlik says the Excelsior boots are coming along, but the skins you brought will not cover their insides. He plans to use cheaper, thicker hides from crocolisks near Lake Nazferiti for those hidden layers. Drizzlik says the Excelsior boots are coming along nicely. The skins from Supply and Demand will not cover their insides. Since no one will see those layers, he plans to use thicker, cheaper hides from the crocolisks near Lake Nazferiti.

quest:578.text: The Stone of the Tides. Off Stranglethorn Vale, strange reports from an island reach Baron Revilgaz. He suspects an ancient troll relic has resurfaced and sends you to scout the shore, with a pass to study it in Stormwind's archives. Strange apparitions and water elementals haunt an island off Stranglethorn Vale. Baron Revilgaz rules Booty Bay and suspects Gazban, a goblin mage, has found the fabled Stone of the Tides. He sends you to find the island and learn whether the rumors are true. To aid your search, he gives you a library scrip for Stormwind's scholars.

quest:58.text: The Night Watch. In eastern Raven Hill, The Night Watch sends for help as Darkshire faces the undead. Commander Althea Ebonlocke calls on travelers to enter the crypts and destroy the plague spreaders while her guards defend the town. This is the last chapter in the guard’s direct fight against the undead overrun. Darkshire stands nearly alone, with no soldiers from Stormwind to rely on. Its civilian militia, The Night Watch, must hold the town. Commander Althea Ebonlocke has few guards to spare, and she uses them to protect the crossroads, the town’s edge, and the supply lines. As the restless dead multiply across Duskwood, she calls on wandering champions to carry the fight into Raven Hill’s depths. The eastern mausoleum in Raven Hill Cemetery holds one of the region’s largest concentrations of undead. Unlike the open barrows, its stone crypts teem with plague spreaders. These ghouls carry afflictions that can sicken the living. Destroying twenty gives The Night Watch room to breathe and helps keep Darkshire from facing a united undead surge from the west.

quest:581.text: Hunt for Yenniku. At Grom'gol Base Camp, Nimboya searches for Yenniku, the youngest son of his chieftain. He suspects the Bloodscalp tribe holds the boy and asks you to prove your strength by hunting their warriors and bringing back their tusks. At Grom'gol Base Camp, Nimboya fears a grim fate for Yenniku, the youngest son of the Darkspear chieftain. An old tribal custom placed the boy among the Gurubashi trolls of Zul'Gurub. When the Darkspear tribe left their homeland with the orc warchief Thrall, Yenniku was left behind and lost. Nimboya has returned from Orgrimmar to Stranglethorn Vale to find the chieftain's son and bring him to safety. Nimboya suspects the Bloodscalp tribe holds Yenniku. To prove you are strong enough to hunt them, he sends you north to gather nine tusks from Bloodscalp trolls. Bring the trophies back to Grom'gol Base Camp as proof of your strength in battle. Then the search for the chieftain's boy can continue with Headhunting.

quest:582.text:
Headhunting. At Grom'gol Base Camp, Nimboya seeks news of Yenniku, the Darkspear chieftain's son. He sends you to hunt Bloodscalp headhunters and bring back their shrunken heads, hoping to learn whether Yenniku is dead. Nimboya fears the Bloodscalp tribe may have killed Yenniku, the Darkspear chieftain's son. The search began with Hunt for Yenniku, and now he sends you after Bloodscalp Headhunters at the ruins of Zuuldaia and Zul'Kunda along Stranglethorn Vale's northern coast.

Bring back twenty shrunken heads. Nimboya will inspect them for signs that Yenniku met a violent end. If the youth is dead, Nimboya curses Gan'zulah, chief of the Bloodscalp.

quest:5821.text: Bodyguard for Hire. In Desolace, Cork Gizelton and Rigger stop their kodo caravan at the sound of centaur war drums. Cork asks you to guard it past the Kolkar village, with payment waiting down the road. Cork Gizelton and Rigger lead their kodo caravan past the Kolkar centaur. Then the war drums sound, and the caravan stops. Dead traders bring no profit, so Cork asks you to guard it a short distance past the Kolkar village and keep it safe. The caravan waits north of the Kolkar Village and southeast of Thunder Axe Fortress. Smeed Scrabblescrew waits with payment at Scrabblescrew's Camp, a little way down the road. Smeed does a little business with the Gizelton caravan.

quest:583.text: Welcome to the Jungle. In Stranglethorn Vale, Barnil Stonepot welcomes newcomers to the hunting camp and spots a seasoned wanderer. He offers to introduce you to Hemet Nesingwary, the expedition's leader. Barnil Stonepot greets newcomers at the camp in Stranglethorn Vale. He spots seasoned fighters and points out Hemet Nesingwary, an Alliance war hero and peerless tracker. Nesingwary keeps company with veterans who have proved themselves. Barnil thinks the old marksman may share his hunting wisdom with someone who has endured battle.

quest:5881.text: Calling in the Reserves. At Sun Rock Retreat, Maggran Earthbinder sends you south to relieve a weary sentry at the Great Lift. He gives you a letter for Grish Longrunner, who has stood watch far from home. Maggran Earthbinder keeps troop welfare and supplies in hand at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. Across Kalimdor, the Horde strains to keep its garrisons staffed, even after the Third War. Maggran knows that endless watch duty wears seasoned soldiers down. So he sends a reassignment letter south to the Great Lift, where Grish Longrunner has stood guard far from home. The Great Lift joins the southern Barrens to the canyons of Thousand Needles. With Maggran's letter in hand, Grish can leave his lonely watch over the lift mechanisms and return to his family. Fresh reserves can take his place.

quest:5925.text: Heeding the Call. Mathrengyl Bearwalker calls a young night elf druid to Darnassus to continue their training. As Archdruid Fandral Staghelm's direct assistant, he prepares the initiate for the trials of the bear. As your basic instruction among Teldrassil's boughs comes to an end, word arrives that Mathrengyl Bearwalker wishes to speak with you. He is the direct assistant to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm and one of the Cenarion Enclave's wisest elders. His summons calls you beyond basic wardenship and toward the deeper arts of nature. You travel to the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus and climb to the second floor of Archdruid Staghelm's great tree. Bearwalker welcomes you and reminds you that those who answer Cenarius' call must honor plants and beasts as companions and charges. To preserve nature's balance, you need more than quiet reflection. You must learn the ways of the wild bear and master strength of body and heart.

quest:5929.text: Great Bear Spirit. In Moonglade, druids are sent north to seek the Great Bear Spirit. Communion with this ancient guide teaches the bear’s nature and strength, a vital part of a druid’s spiritual and martial training. In northwestern Moonglade, the Great Bear Spirit dwells apart from Nighthaven’s quiet paths. This ancient and noble mentor teaches every initiate who seeks to understand the bear’s nature. Druids have long sought its blessing and wisdom as part of the path of the wild. Dendrite Starblaze guides young druids from Nighthaven into the hills to meet the spirit. Communion brings primal wisdom and an awareness of natural strength. When the druids return, Dendrite tests their focus. The encounter gives them raw strength and knowing intent, but they must learn to direct that power in their daily work.

quest:5943.text: Gizelton Caravan. At Mannoroc Coven, Rigger Gizelton asks you to guard his caravan. He and Cork set out to make a fortune, but trade has proved more dangerous than they expected. Rigger Gizelton and Cork began their caravan hoping to make a fortune. They did not know how risky turning a profit could be. Mannoroc Coven lies ahead, where demons usually leave the caravan alone. This time, the kodos are spooked. Rigger offers payment if you guard the caravan past the coven. Once it is safely through, Smeed will pay you at Scrabblescrew's Camp.

quest:596.text: Bloody Bone Necklaces. At Grom'gol Base Camp, Kin'weelay turns the Bloodscalp conflict into a private struggle. Kin'weelay came to Grom'gol Base Camp to help Nimboya, yet he has purposes of his own. The Bloodscalp trolls to the north are enemies of the Darkspears. Kin'weelay believes trophies taken from fallen foes grant spiritual power over them. So he asks travelers to hunt Bloodscalp warriors and take the bloody bone necklaces they wear.

quest:601.text: Water Elementals. On the island off the coast, Water Elementals may offer a clue to the Stone of the Tides' curse. Baron Revilgaz wants their bracers examined for a way to counter it. Baron Revilgaz suspects the Water Elementals' magical residue may help fight the Stone of the Tides' curse. The stone is said to make anyone who wields it drift in and out of reality. So he sends you back to the island off the coast to gather bracers for the scholarly mages of Dalaran to examine. Baron Revilgaz admits he lacks the skill to judge whether the bracers can help. He refuses to leave Booty Bay just to speak with tiresome old mages. So he sends you north to have a mage examine them.

quest:602.text: Magical Analysis. From Booty Bay, Baron Revilgaz sends you north to Dalaran with water elemental bracers. He hopes Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver can study the curse tied to the Stone of the Tides. Baron Revilgaz has the bracers in Booty Bay, but their secret lies beyond his reach. The town has no mage skilled enough to unravel the curse behind the Stone of the Tides, so he points you toward Dalaran. Its wizards are working to rebuild their broken kingdom. Revilgaz has dealt with Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver before and trusts his knowledge. He believes no mage can resist an intriguing puzzle.

quest:6027.text: Book of the Ancients. At the Ethel Rethor tower, Azore Aldamort entrusts you with the Gem of the Serpent. Set it on the Serpent Statue on Ranazjar Isle, northwest of the tower, and the guardian of the Book of the Ancients will appear. After Sceptre of Light, Azore Aldamort gives you the Gem of the Serpent. Ranazjar Isle lies northwest of the Ethel Rethor tower, and there the Serpent Statue waits. Set the gem on its hand to call forth the Book of the Ancients’ guardian. The naga have kept the book’s secrets for centuries, and Azore hopes it will teach much about their scaled foes.

quest:603.text: Ansirem's Key. An ancient troll dagger may weaken the magic empowering the Stone of the Tides. Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver found the blade in Stranglethorn, then gave it to his daughter Catelyn, who left home for the pirates of Booty Bay. Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver has found that an altar, or focal point, amplifies the Stone of the Tides. To overpower that magic, he needs an ancient troll dagger he uncovered while researching in Stranglethorn. He gave the blade to his daughter Catelyn long ago. Headstrong, she left home for the pirates of Booty Bay.

quest:605.text: Singing Blue Shards. In Stranglethorn Vale, buyers seek Singing Blue Shards. The Venture Company makes it hard for Crank Fizzlebub to gather raw Singing Crystals, so he offers you a cut of the profits for ten shards taken from basilisk hides. Crank Fizzlebub has buyers for Singing Crystals, found only in Stranglethorn Vale. The Venture Company makes gathering raw crystals hard for him. So he seeks another way to get them. Basilisks eat the crystals, and the mineral becomes part of their hardened hides. You can recover usable shards there. Basilisks across the jungle may yield crystal fragments. Fizzlebub points you to the gentler ones along the northern shores south of Zul'Kunda. Bring him ten shards so he can move ahead with his buyers. Then his attention turns to the Venture Company's operations.

quest:610.text: "Pretty Boy" Duncan. Catelyn the Blade has lost the dagger her father asked her to return. She wants it back from Pretty Boy Duncan before she helps you further. Catelyn the Blade has left the mages and their dusty tomes behind. Ansirem's Key led you to her, but she cannot give you the dagger her father asked her to return. A Bloodsail Buccaneer took it. Until her blade is recovered, Catelyn will hand over nothing else. Pretty Boy Duncan struck Catelyn unconscious and took the knife she carried in a fight. She relies on that weapon. Now she insists on getting that very blade back from the buccaneer before she helps you further.

quest:6132.text: Get Me Out of Here!. In the Valley of Spears, Melizza Brimbuzzle fears the Maraudines mean to eat her. She asks you to get her out, and her brother Hornizz promises good pay. Melizza Brimbuzzle came to the Valley of Spears hoping to strike a deal with the Maraudines. They would not talk, and now she fears they mean to eat her. Minutes ago, she overheard centaurs discussing wood for their cookpot. She wants to leave quickly. Hornizz Brimbuzzle waits at the family camp east of Melizza's present position. It lies beside the kodo graveyard. Melizza promises her brother will pay you well if you bring her out of the valley.

quest:6134.text: Ghost-o-plasm Round Up. Hornizz Brimbuzzle sends you into the Valley of Bones for ghost energy, hoping the Magram will pay well for it. Hornizz Brimbuzzle sends you southeast to the Valley of Bones, where Magram ghosts walk. The valley sounds frightening to him. Yet he thinks the spirits must frighten the Magram even more, and he is sure the centaurs would pay well for ghost energy captured there. Hornizz Brimbuzzle gives you a crate of ghost magnets. Set one between the two huge skeletons called the Dead Goliaths, and it draws the ghosts toward it. The spirits yield ghost-o-plasm, which Hornizz plans to sell to the Magram. He asks you to bring him eight ghost-o-plasms and the crate.

quest:6141.text: Brother Anton. In Nijel's Point, Brother Anton seeks help against the undead in Desolace. He came from distant lands after hearing of the threat. Rumors of undead in Desolace reached Brother Anton in far-off Kalimdor. He booked passage at once to seek them out and destroy them. Now he looks for people with courage and resolve. If your heart is true, Brother Crowley sends you to find him in Nijel's Point, the Alliance town in Desolace.

quest:6142.text: Clam Bait. At Shadowprey Village, Mai'Lahii trusts one bait above all others. He asks for ten pieces of soft-shelled clam meat from the wrecked ship north along the coast. Mai'Lahii asks you for bait fish cannot resist. He has fished all his life and trusts soft-shelled clam meat above all else. North of Shadowprey Village, a wrecked ship lies off the coast, and soft-shelled clams are scattered throughout the area. He wants ten pieces of the meat.

quest:6143.text: Other Fish to Fry. At Shadowprey Village, Drulzegar Skraghook asks you to strike back at the Slitherblade. Naga took the fishing crew near Ranazjar Isle, and Drulzegar alone returned. Drulzegar Skraghook and the crew often fished near Ranazjar Isle. The isle lies north of a wreck on the coast. One morning, the naga attacked and killed everyone but Drulzegar. Now revenge fills Drulzegar's thoughts, and guilt is too much to bear. Drulzegar asks you to slay seven Slitherblade Myrmidons, seven Slitherblade Naga and five Slitherblade Sorceresses. A bad knee keeps Drulzegar from joining you. The naga usually lurk far down among coral reefs beneath the waves, Drulzegar says. Your effort will be rewarded.

quest:616.text: The Haunted Isle. In Booty Bay, Krazek hears a tale of an isle haunted by a goblin ghost. He gathers unusual rumors for Baron Revilgaz, and this one recalls an old troll legend. Krazek gathers reports of strange happenings throughout Stranglethorn Vale for Baron Revilgaz. In a Booty Bay tavern, sailors tell him of an isle off the coast where water elementals dwell. They say the ghost of a raving goblin haunts it. Krazek gives little heed to spectral gossip, but this tale catches his attention. He asks you to carry it to the baron. Baron Revilgaz remembers an old troll legend from a book when he hears Krazek's report. The water elementals and goblin apparition make him suspect that the Stone of the Tides may be within his grasp. He hopes to add the ancient relic to his personal collection of artifacts.

quest:6161.text: Claim Rackmore's Treasure!. During Claim Rackmore's Treasure!, Rackmore's log tells of a ship attacked on its way to Feathermoon Stronghold. He hid his treasure chest on Ranazjar Isle to keep it from his enemies, but both keys to open it were lost. Rackmore's log tells of seafaring creatures attacking his ship on its way to Feathermoon Stronghold. He hid his treasure chest on Ranazjar Isle to keep it from his enemies. Both keys needed to open it were lost, one silver and one gold. Whoever finds the keys and the chest will find a treasure.

quest:622.text: Return to Corporal Kaleb. At the Rebel Camp, Corporal Kaleb waits for the pot Krazek repaired in Booty Bay. It has a second steam whistle and a chopper built into its base. Krazek has finished repairing the pot you brought him. He added another steam whistle and fitted a chopper to its base, sharp enough to cut through leg bones. He calls it a sure way to please the cook and expects its owner to be glad of the changes. Now it is ready to return to Corporal Kaleb at the Rebel Camp.

quest:627.text: Favor for Krazek. In Booty Bay, Krazek pauses his work on a broken crock pot to ask you for four loads of lesser bloodstone ore from the northern hills. He will return the cookware when you bring them. Krazek pauses his repair of the broken cookware in Booty Bay to offer a trade. He sends you far north to the Arathi Highlands. There, a cave in Drywhisker Gorge holds lesser bloodstone ore. The mineral is low grade, yet those who know its uses prize it. Krazek keeps working on the pot while you travel north. He expects four loads of bloodstone and promises payment if you bring back enough. The ore must be mined. If you lack the skill, you need someone who can extract it.

quest:628.text:
Excelsior. In Booty Bay, Drizzlik is ready for the last piece of the Excelsior boots. He needs an elder saltwater crocolisk skin for their outer layer. Drizzlik has finished the boots’ inner layer. For the outside, he uses the finest elder crocolisk skins. They are tougher and give the Excelsior designs and accents a better surface. Only an elder saltwater crocolisk skin fits his plan.

Finding one is difficult. Elders come out only to guard other saltwater crocolisks. Drizzlik has also read that saltwater crocolisk numbers are dwindling, which worries him for his business.

quest:6282.text: Harpies Threaten. In the Charred Vale, Bloodfury harpies threaten the roads west of Sun Rock Retreat. Maggran Earthbinder calls Horde warriors to thin their growing ranks and keep travel through Stonetalon open. Tauren at Sun Rock Retreat guard Stonetalon and its peaceful travelers. Maggran Earthbinder, the retreat’s elder leader, has watched the harpy ranks grow. The Bloodfury coven has spread through the scorched Charred Vale, harrying beasts and blocking routes. If the flocks grow further, Sun Rock Retreat could be cut off. West of Sun Rock Retreat, the Charred Vale is a wasteland of ash, scorched earth, and smoldering trees left by catastrophic fires. Bloodfury harpies nest high in the charred remains of ancient woods, and the vale is their stronghold. Maggran sends Horde warriors into the hostile caldera to cull dozens of harpies: Bloodfury ambushers, slayers, and roguefeathers. Thinning their ranks weakens the coven’s grip on the vale and clears the way to confront its matriarchal lineage.

quest:6283.text: Bloodfury Bloodline. Maggran Earthbinder sends you into the Charred Vale to break the harpies’ hold and bring back proof. Harpies from the edge of the Charred Vale threaten Sun Rock Retreat. Maggran Earthbinder believes their attacks will end only when Bloodfury Ripper, their matriarch, is dead. The flock treats her like a queen. Under her lead, they move as one and grow bold along the craggy western ridge. Maggran asks you to bring back Bloodfury Ripper’s remains as proof. Without their brood queen, the harpies lose their order and become easier to keep at bay. Sun Rock Retreat faces less danger, and Maggran can set aside his anger and constant watchfulness. Then he is free to seek the harmony and balance the tauren value.

quest:6284.text: Arachnophobia. A Horde bounty sends you west of Windshear Crag after Besseleth, the ancient spider haunting southern Stonetalon Mountains. Bring her fang to Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat, and travelers may find the mountain roads safer after dark. A weathered wanted poster warns travelers on the main road south of Windshear Crag to beware the lands west of it. Sishir Canyon and Webwinder Path swarm with spiders. Besseleth, an unusually large orange spider, commands her brood. After sunset, she ambushes anyone who strays from the path. Maggran Earthbinder, a tauren at Sun Rock Retreat, has posted the bounty on Besseleth. In an earlier encounter, her massive two-foot fang struck him and nearly killed him. Maggran fought her off and limped to safety, but the wound still reminds him of the danger in the canyon shadows. He hopes you will bring him Besseleth's Fang and secure the passes, so trade and travel to Sun Rock Retreat can continue without fear.

quest:629.text:
The Vile Reef. Beneath the Savage Coast, Kin'weelay seeks a shard from the sunken troll city. He hopes to carry Gri'lek's story to Orgrimmar, where the Darkspear can preserve it. Northwest of Grom'gol Base Camp, the Savage Coast hides an ancient troll city beneath the water. A violent earthquake shattered the land long ago and sank the city. Now called the Vile Reef, its flooded ruins are home to hostile murlocs who attack anyone who ventures near.

On the sea floor rests a massive stone tablet carved with the story of Gri'lek. He was a legendary troll hero, and the Darkspear still hold his memory sacred. The monument is too massive to carry from the depths, so Kin'weelay asks you to break off a shard. He plans to take the fragment to Orgrimmar and enshrine it in a sacred place. There, the Darkspear can keep Gri'lek's strength and honor in their memory.

quest:63.text: Call of Water. Across the sea, Call of Water sends Barrens shamans to a blighted shore in Silverpine Forest. There, an initiate faces the sickness at an ancient shrine to earn communion with water spirits. You gather pure water with help from the hermit Brine, then return to Islen Waterseer on the Barrens coast. She sends you across the sea with the purified essence to Silverpine Forest's haunted shore. The shrine lies just west of the Forsaken refuge called the Sepulcher.

quest:6301.text: Cycle of Rebirth. At Sun Rock Retreat, Tammra Windfield seeks Gaea seeds to heal Stonetalon. She asks the Horde to gather them from Mirkfallon Lake, so she can bless them and restore the mountain’s damaged soil. Logging and clashes between rival factions have scarred Stonetalon’s peaks. Forests have been scorched, cut down, or reduced to ash. For the tauren at Sun Rock Retreat, the swift ruin of the natural world is a grievous wound. Shamans such as Tammra Windfield turn to the Earthmother’s renewing cycle as they work to mend the land. Tammra seeks rare Gaea seeds along Mirkfallon Lake, north of Sun Rock Retreat. Sturdy seed pods grow on the banks by the water, holding a resilience found only in Stonetalon. Once gathered, Tammra gives each kernel an ancestral shamanistic blessing. The blessing awakens its power and hastens its growth.

quest:631.text: The Thandol Span. At the Thandol Span, Rhag Garmason seeks a missing dwarf scout after a blast destroys the northern crossing. The Dark Iron clan has attacked Dun Modr, cutting off word and leaving its defenders without reinforcements. Ol' Rustlocke may know what caused the blast. A blast has torn through the bridge between Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands. Bronzebeard soldiers at the border were caught in the destruction when Dark Iron dwarves attacked Dun Modr. Their ranks are thin, and their strongholds are under siege. Longbraid the Grim leads the survivors as they hold their ground against the attackers. Longbraid sent veteran scout Ebenezer Rustlocke to inspect the eastern span. He was to learn whether a crossing or northern route remained usable. Days have passed without word from him. Dun Modr is under siege, and Rhag Garmason and the garrison have too few soldiers to search the enemy-held rubble.

quest:632.text: The Thandol Span. At the Thandol Span, Rhag Garmason waits for word from a missing scout. He sent adventurers to check on Ol' Ebenezer Rustlocke after the dwarf stopped reporting from the great stone crossing. The search beneath its arches may reveal a threat to northern supply lines. Longbraid the Grim sent Ebenezer Rustlocke to watch over the Thandol Span's structure and security. When the scout stopped reporting, foul play was feared.

quest:633.text: The Thandol Span. On the Thandol Span, a murder puts Ironforge’s northern road at risk. Ebenezer Rustlocke is dead, and Rhag Garmason has found explosives hidden by Kam Deepfury. A recovered document lays bare the crime beneath the Thandol Span. Ebenezer Rustlocke was murdered in the bridge’s substructure. The papers reveal more: Kam Deepfury, the Dark Iron agitator who first destroyed part of the bridge, has not stopped. His network planted another cache of heavy munitions just across the northern border in the Arathi Highlands, ready to finish the destruction.

quest:634.text: Plea To The Alliance. At the shattered Thandol Span, Plea To The Alliance carries Dun Modr's desperate call for aid. Dark Iron infiltrators slaughtered the garrison, and its dwarven survivors appeal to human forces at Refuge Pointe, though the Alliance is stretched thin. Dun Modr lies in ruins, and Dark Iron dwarves have sabotaged the Thandol Span. The survivors cling to a foothold on the Wetlands' northern rim. Ironforge's main reserves have not arrived, so Rhag Garmason and Longbraid the Grim look north to the Arathi Highlands. There they learn that Alliance forces have camped at Refuge Pointe. Garmason sends an emissary across the shattered bridge to ask Captain Nials for urgent military aid. At Refuge Pointe, Captain Nials offers sympathy to Longbraid's soldiers but cannot spare a single fighter. Stromgarde has fallen into ruin, overrun by Syndicate rogues, Boulderfist ogres and Witherbark trolls. Its surviving defenders are committed to reclaiming their ancestral capital. Bound by honor and pressed by their own desperate struggle, Nials sends word that the dwarves at the Span must stand alone.

quest:635.text: Crystal in the Mountains. In Arathi's northern mountains, a vision draws you toward a gleaming crystal. The Pendant of Myzrael pulses in your hand as a plea for help reaches you. The Pendant of Myzrael pulses in your hand, carrying a plea from someone in need of help. Then a vision shows a gleaming crystal thrusting from the ground in the mountains north of Arathi. You feel drawn there.

quest:637.text: Sully Balloo's Letter. At the Thandol Span, Sully Balloo's Letter carries a dwarf's last words to his wife in Ironforge. Found beneath the bridge, it tells where he died. Beneath the stone pilings of the Thandol Span, the land bridge between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands, a drowned skeleton still clutches an envelope. Its water-damaged pages begin, “My dear Sara,” and preserve the tenderness of Sully Balloo's careful writing. Alliance forces and their enemies have fought fiercely for the Thandol Span. Dark Iron saboteurs and warbands contesting the borderlands have threatened the crossing. Sully Balloo was among the dwarven soldiers sent north to defend it. His family in the mountains knew nothing of his fate until a diver brought his farewell letter up from beneath the waves.

quest:638.text: Trollbane. At Hammerfall, the Darkspear prepare for battles against Zul'Gurub's jungle trolls. Vol'jin has sent them to recover Trol'kalar from ruined Stromgarde, where the blade rested in human hands. After King Thoras Trollbane fell, Stromgarde became a ruin. Chieftain Vol'jin then ordered the Darkspear to spirit Trol'kalar away. The storied sword had long rested in human hands. Now the tribe seeks it for the battles ahead against Zul'Gurub's jungle trolls. Vol'jin sent Zengu, a seasoned hunter, to Hammerfall in the northeastern Arathi Highlands. From Stranglethorn Vale, Nimboya directs travelers to find Zengu and help secure the legendary sword.

quest:6381.text: New Life. Tammra Windfield sends travelers west from Sun Rock Retreat to begin healing the Charred Vale. She hopes Gaea seeds can help the scorched land recover. Tammra Windfield asks you to enter the Charred Vale, where soot, fire elementals, and harpies haunt the ruined ground. She trusts the Earth Mother's resilience. Find the Gaea Dirt Mounds, where fertile soil survived the fire. Gaea seeds can take root despite the lingering elemental corruption. Their roots hold back decay and give plants a place to return to the valley. Tammra hopes new growth will calm the fire spirits and drive the harpies from their desolate roost. She also hopes the Venture Company's logging will eventually be driven out.

quest:6382.text: The Ashenvale Hunt. In Ashenvale, the Horde's proven hunters face a new test beneath ancient trees. Jorn Skyseer sends you north from Camp Taurajo to Splintertree Post, where Senani Thunderheart awaits. After proving yourself in the Barrens, you are sent toward Ashenvale. Jorn Skyseer sees when a hunter has outgrown the local game and points the way north. For the young Horde, these old forests offer resources and mark a political and spiritual frontier to understand and claim. The road north passes the Mor'shan Rampart before reaching Splintertree Post, a fortified Horde camp deep among the trees. Senani Thunderheart, a tauren huntress, welcomes experienced hunters seeking harder tests of survival. The Horde needs skilled trackers to face Ashenvale's native predators and the forest's watchful defenders.

quest:6383.text: The Ashenvale Hunt. In Ashenvale, Horde hunters face three great predators in Senani Thunderheart's trial at Splintertree Post. Track Ursangous, Shadumbra, and Sharptalon to prove your skill. Senani Thunderheart gives the Horde's presence in Ashenvale a different kind of test. While Orcs gather lumber, she sends hunters into the shadowed forest to face its strongest predators. Strength alone will not serve; hunters need cunning and respect for the wilderness. They must learn what they can endure. Three solitary beasts test those who take up the hunt. Ursangous, an immense elder bear, roams near the Talondeep Path. Shadumbra, a cunning nightsaber, stalks the eastern borders near Raynewood Retreat and the Laughing Sisters. South of Splintertree Post, Sharptalon, a fierce hippogryph, wheels above the forest canopy.

quest:639.text: Sigil of Strom. At Hammerfall, Zengu seeks the sigils that guard Trol'kalar, Lord Ignaeus Trollbane's sword. The Syndicate took the Sigil of Strom, and one of its agents in Stromgarde likely carries it. Long ago, Lord Ignaeus of Strom, called Trollbane, was the Arathorian Empire's ablest foe in its war against the trolls. He wielded Trol'kalar in battle. In the trolls' old tongue, its name means troll slayer. Now Trollbane's sons are weakened, and their stronghold lies in ruins. Several sigils guard Trol'kalar, and Stromgarde's survivors each took some. Zengu says they must all be recovered. The Syndicate seized the first, the Sigil of Strom. Zengu believes one of its agents in Stromgarde holds it. Bring the sigil back to Zengu at Hammerfall.

quest:6393.text: Elemental War. In Stonetalon Mountains, Tsunaman sends you against fire elementals in Neptulon’s name. The water envoy at Sun Rock Retreat asks you to enter the Charred Vale and gather Incendrite cores from the blazing elementals you destroy. Their struggle reaches beyond mortal borders, bound to the ancient rivalry between elemental forces. At Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains, Tsunaman speaks for the Tribunal of the Tides. You carry out Neptulon the Tidehunter’s will against the fiery kin of his water elementals. Their enmity reaches far beyond mortal borders. It is an ancient struggle between the primal forces of Azeroth. Southern Stonetalon Mountains hold the Charred Vale, where ash and smoke mark the land. Fire elementals gather there and threaten the surrounding regions. Tsunaman sends you to destroy them and gather the Incendrites they leave behind. These blazing cores prove to the Tribunal that the elementals are gone.

quest:6394.text: Thazz'ril's Pick. Foreman Thazz'ril needs his enchanted pick back from the northern cavern. Beasts now prowl the Burning Blade Coven, where the glowing tool lies. Foreman Thazz'ril directs work in the Valley of Trials. He entered the northern cavern to search for mineral veins and left his favorite pick behind. When he returned, vicious beasts and hostile inhabitants had taken over. Now he seeks capable hands to bring back the tool. Thazz'ril enchanted his favorite pick to glow in the dark, making it easier to use in dim caverns. Its light marks the tool in a waterfall chamber inside the Burning Blade Coven. Dangerous creatures prowl the shadows. Thazz'ril hopes to put the pick back to work and find new mining prospects across the valley.

quest:642.text: The Princess Trapped. Across the Arathi Highlands, an iridescent shard carries Myzrael’s plea from deep underground. She calls herself a princess of the earth, imprisoned by giants, and asks travelers to strengthen a crystal cluster in Drywhisker Gorge. Strange shards lie scattered across the Arathi Highlands, humming with distant power. Near them, Myzrael’s voice rises from deep beneath the ground. She calls herself a princess of the earth, cast down and bound underground by ancient giants. Cut off from the lands above, she uses the crystals to carry her plea to anyone willing to listen. Myzrael directs you east to Drywhisker Gorge, where she asks you to strengthen your contact with her. Drywhisker kobolds infest the gorge, and she calls them allies of the giants who hold her captive. They carry Motes of Myzrael and guard a cluster of iridescent shards. Take the motes from the kobolds and use their energy on the formation. That will strengthen the crystal cluster and deepen your communication with the trapped princess.

quest:647.text: MacKreel's Moonshine. Foggy MacKreel needs his moonshine carried from the broken Thandol Span to Southshore. He drank too much while on watch and now has little time to deliver a fresh batch to Brewmeister Bilger and settle his debt. On the shattered Thandol Span, Foggy MacKreel keeps watch through wet, cold, and dull hours. He drinks his homemade moonshine to bear the damp chill. The brew hits hard enough that he compares its aftereffects to siege engines pounding across his skull. One drink too many leaves him asleep through his shift. Longbraid the Grim commands the dwarves defending the Span, and Foggy cannot afford another lapse in discipline. Foggy owes Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore a longstanding debt. He promised a batch of his personal brew to settle the account, but his hangover and watch duties have left him minutes from missing the deadline. You race across the Arathi Highlands with the jug, by gryphon and swift feet. Reach Southshore before Bilger decides Foggy has skipped out on his tab again.

quest:6481.text: Earthen Arise. In Boulderslide Ravine, Mor'rogal finds Goggeroc asleep inside a Resonite cask. The tauren shaman fears the ancient Earthen could threaten all Kalimdor, so he sends a champion to break the cask and slay Goggeroc before its strength returns. Scouts searching Boulderslide Ravine for vermin found a strange relic among the kobolds. A Resonite cask held unearthly force. Mor'rogal, a tauren shaman in the Stonetalon Mountains, knew it was both prison and sanctuary for Goggeroc, a dormant Earthen. These ancient beings of stone can outmatch mortal warriors, and Goggeroc's freedom could endanger the whole region.

quest:6503.text:
Ashenvale Outrunners. In Ashenvale, Kuray'bin sends the Horde against night elf scouts slipping out from Silverwing Outpost. They are gathering word of Horde encampments and defenses before they can report back. Night elf scouts from Silverwing Outpost move through the woods east of their base and south of nearby Horde holdings. They watch the paths and ridges, mapping fortifications and tracking troop movements.

Kuray'bin has learned that these scouts, called Ashenvale Outrunners, have slipped into the wilderness to gather intelligence. The Horde strikes at enemy scouts before they can return to Silverwing Outpost. Hunting down the outrunners keeps their commanders from learning the Horde's troop strength and outpost defenses.

Without their forward eyes, the night elves are disoriented and less willing to risk aggressive moves through the contested woods.

quest:6504.text: The Lost Pages. A gust has scattered The Lost Pages across Ashenvale, leaving Gurda Ragescar stranded near Splintertree Post. She cannot run the shredder she is carrying from Ratchet to the Warsong Lumber Camp without its manual. The Warsong Clan buys steam-powered shredders in Ratchet to clear lumber across Ashenvale. Their delicate workings can be hard for an orc warrior to master. As Gurda Ragescar carried a newly bought shredder north, a sudden gust tore the instruction booklet from her hands. Twelve parchment leaves scattered across the forest floor. The wind carried the manual pages across Ashenvale. Wandering creatures, cultists, and forest denizens have taken them. The shredder cannot run without all three chapters. Gurda is stranded on the road to Splintertree Post, unable to report for logging duty.

quest:651.text: Stones of Binding. In Arathi, four Stones of Binding hold Myzrael beneath the ground. A voice from the iridescent shards says the strongest stone needs keys from the other three. Across Arathi, four stones keep Myzrael beneath the ground, a voice says. The Stone of Inner Binding is strongest, and keys from the Stones of West, East and Outer Binding can unlock it. Gather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key. Guardians watch the stones, though someone clever or lucky may find a way to banish them. Carry the keys to the Stone of Inner Binding.

quest:6546.text: Warsong Outrider Update. Along eastern Ashenvale, the Warsong Outrider Update carries word of danger closing in on the Horde. Its report names Alliance forces, satyr entrenched in the forest, and naga moving through neighboring Azshara. A lone Warsong Outrider watches Ashenvale’s contested eastern edge. Horde supply lines face constant harassment, so outriders track enemy movements before raiding parties can strike Mor'shan Rampart or Splintertree Post. Meet one on patrol and you know the forest is under watch. His report may decide whether a Horde fortification holds or falls to ambush. A Warsong Outrider’s report tells of danger across Kalimdor’s central forests. Night elves and the wider Alliance remain a threat, while cunning, demonic satyr haunt eastern Ashenvale. Scouts have also found a massive naga presence spreading through the ruined coastal lands of neighboring Azshara. The Horde faces hostile powers from nearly every direction.

quest:6547.text: Warsong Scout Update. Kadrak's orders reach Warsong Scout Update as scouts watch the contested woods. The Horde relies on their reports to guard its positions in Ashenvale from night elf attacks. Kadrak relies on scattered Warsong scouts to watch Ashenvale's border. Night elf sentinels use the forest for cover, and the scouts risk being cut off. Couriers carry written updates between them, keeping isolated outposts connected to Horde command and able to report what they see. Warsong scouts watch for night elf raids meant to reclaim the forest. The clan has paid in lives for every stretch of Ashenvale it cleared or occupied. Kadrak's orders keep forward scouts in touch with the Horde and let them report whether their defenses are holding against elven resistance.

quest:655.text: Hammerfall. At Hammerfall, the Horde holds a camp won at the cost of Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer's life. Gor'mul remembers the captives' escape and why the stronghold bears its name. In the Arathi Highlands, the Alliance once held orcs captive behind wood and steel. Young Thrall and Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer led an assault on the camp's enclosures and freed their kin. Many captives escaped as the defenses fell. Then a mounted lance struck Doomhammer from behind. He died where Hammerfall now stands. Gor'mul was among those who did not find freedom that day. In the battle's chaos and the earth's tremors, he watched the Warchief fall and lost the will to fight. His brethren fled, leaving him behind. For years, Gor'mul wandered the highlands in grief. The Horde has reclaimed the site as a fortified base, yet survivors still carry the memory of Doomhammer's death.

quest:65601.text: Love Hurts. Gan'rul sends you along Orgrimmar's main drag to find Magar. His longing for Krilge may reveal the object Gan'rul needs to lure an incubus into the world. East of the Cleft of Shadow, Magar longs for Krilge to return. He asks you to search for something precious. Bring that object to Gan'rul, who needs a token of love and devotion to summon an incubus.

quest:6561.text: Blackfathom Villainy. In Blackfathom Deeps, a wounded scout calls for help against the cult serving Aku'mai. Argent Dawn scout Thaelrid asks passing Horde champions to end Twilight Lord Kelris's blood sacrifices in the sunken ruins. Argent Dawn scout Thaelrid lies wounded in the underground temple along the Ashenvale coast. His reconnaissance uncovered horrors beyond the naga incursions, but he has spent his strength and cannot finish his mission alone. So he calls on passing Horde champions to strike at the cult's leaders in the sunken halls. Twilight Lord Kelris leads the Twilight's Hammer cultists in the ruined Temple of the Moon. Alongside the local naga, he performs dark rites over the defiled Moon Well. Captives are fed alive to Aku'mai, a ravenous hydra and beast of the Old Gods. Kelris seeks cosmic power and primordial chaos.

quest:65610.text: Wish You Were Here. A mooncloth maker in Ashenvale asks you to find Krilge, who vanished while guarding civilians. His comrades call him a deserter, but the maker believes he held his post. A mooncloth maker met Krilge while making mooncloth in Ashenvale. Krilge was stationed there to protect civilians, then disappeared. They often met at Fallen Sky Lake, until aggressive bog beasts overran it. The maker still hopes to learn what became of him. You are asked to search Fallen Sky Lake and report your findings to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar. Krilge's comrades have stopped looking for him. Perhaps the lake still holds a sign of what became of him.

quest:6562.text:
Trouble in the Deeps. From Stonetalon Mountains, Tsunaman sends Horde travelers to aid Je'neu Sancrea on Ashenvale's remote coast. The troll scholar waits at Zoram'gar Outpost, where danger gathers along the shore. Tsunaman hears troubling reports from the north and calls Horde travelers to aid Je'neu Sancrea. The troll scholar waits at Zoram'gar Outpost on Ashenvale's far western shore, along the Zoram Strand. Danger is growing there, and Je'neu needs help from beyond the outpost. The road to Ashenvale's western shore is dangerous for Horde travelers. You can pass through Windshear Crag, where goblins have stirred trouble, or travel north from the Barrens. Either way, you enter a forest watched by night elf sentinels.

Far beneath Ashenvale's dense canopy, Zoram'gar Outpost holds on along the storm-washed Zoram Strand. The outpost faces the shadowed waters.

quest:6563.text: The Essence of Aku'Mai. At Zoram'gar Outpost, Je'neu Sancrea asks Horde adventurers to stop the naga's sapphire harvest in Blackfathom Deeps. He fears they will misuse the gems' power. From the Zoram Strand, Je'neu Sancrea watches over the Kaldorei ruins. Naga now mine sapphire clusters in the submerged chambers of Blackfathom Deeps, where the gems grow along damp cavern walls. Sancrea senses the serpentine invaders mean to harness their power, so he seeks to stop the harvest before they can use it. The Sapphires of Aku'mai carry elemental water energy and hold clinging water spirits. Adept sorcerers could fuel dangerous arcane rituals with them or strengthen Aku'mai, the shadowy hydra whose presence fills the subterranean temple. Recovering the clusters keeps this potent reagent from the naga and helps guard the coastline against unchecked elemental magic.

quest:6564.text: Allegiance to the Old Gods. At Zoram'gar Outpost, you bring Je'neu Sancrea a naga message from Blackfathom Deeps. Its orders point to a ritual plot in the flooded ruins. Horde scouts find a damp, crumpled note while fighting the naga in Blackfathom Deeps. Its frantic words order naga priestesses to gather elemental water crystals. These crystals are meant to fuel the summonings of naga aquamancers. The aquamancers are gathering elemental forces for a darker purpose.

quest:6565.text: Allegiance to the Old Gods. At Zoram'gar, the Horde moves against the Twilight's Hammer cult in Blackfathom Deeps. Je'neu Sancrea sends champions after Lorgus Jett, hoping to disrupt cultists who seek to awaken ancient forces of destruction beneath Ashenvale's coast. From the Ashenvale shore, Zoram'gar Outpost watches Blackfathom Deeps. Naga, corrupted beasts, and Twilight's Hammer fanatics overrun its submerged temple complex. Je'neu Sancrea is an Earthen Ring seer stationed on the coast. He sees the cultists serving the Old Gods rather than the land's natural balance and spirits. These monstrous beings of chaos were defeated in ancient times, yet their malign touch lingers in Azeroth's forgotten places. Je'neu sends Horde champions into the underground ruins to hunt Lorgus Jett, an established leader among the cultists in Blackfathom Deeps. Lorgus works deep in the stone passages between Ghamoo-ra's chamber and Baron Aquanis's chamber. Je'neu is too frail to enter the damp darkness himself. Lorgus's defeat is vital to severing the dark rituals he sought to orchestrate beneath Ashenvale's waves.

quest:657.text: Hints of a New Plague?. Kinelory is bound for Go'Shek Farm, where Apothecary Jorell's deadly experiments continue. Quae has learned of them from a folder, but she is too hurt from a clash with orcs to go along. The folder shows that Jorell is conducting deadly experiments at Go'Shek Farm. Quae does not know what they mean for Hillsbrad. But Phin would not want them to continue. Some of Jorell's research has already reached Tarren Mill. Quae fought some orcs while you were away, and now she cannot help Kinelory. Kinelory plans to go to the farm and take the research Jorell has not yet sent to Tarren Mill. She needs your protection on the way.

quest:6571.text: Warsong Supplies. At Splintertree Post, Locke Okarr needs Warsong Supplies to keep the lumber camp working. Some wait in town, some in Booty Bay, and others lie in enemy hands across Ashenvale. From Splintertree Post, Locke Okarr works to keep the Warsong Lumber Camp supplied. The Warsong Clan needs a steady flow of heavy tools to harvest Ashenvale's ancient timber. Furbolg and satyr raids have scattered or seized local supplies, leaving the camp short of vital gear. You gather equipment from across Kalimdor and beyond. Pixel, the goblin courier at Splintertree Post, has circular saw blades. In Booty Bay, Wharfmaster Lozgil holds a crate of heavy axes. Foulweald and Thistlefur furbolgs have taken logging ropes, while satyrs at Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian stole barrels of Warsong machinery oil for their profane rites.

quest:658.text:
Hints of a New Plague?. At Go'Shek Farm, Quae and Kin have watched for days, and Kin saw a courier leave a small house to the south. They suspect she carries notes to Tarren Mill, so Quae asks you to track her and bring back the documents. Quae expected Phin Odelic to send you. He worries too much, in Quae's view. Quae and Kin have watched the farm for days, and Kin recently saw a courier leave a small house to the south. Kin talks often, but Quae trusts Kin's senses in dangerous places. Quae asks if you are a skilled tracker. The courier may carry notes bound for Tarren Mill, and the documents could shed light on what is happening in Hillsbrad. Find the Forsaken Courier and bring her Sealed Folder to Quae near Go'Shek Farm.

While you search, Kin spots an apothecary leaving that same house. Quae suspects the apothecary is up to no good, but needs proof before anyone acts rashly.

quest:6581.text: Warsong Saw Blades. At Splintertree Post, the Warsong loggers wait for blades brought from Ratchet. Their courier Pixel will trade the shipment for a weapon to guard herself on Ashenvale's dangerous roads. The blades keep the Horde's lumber camps at work. Pixel has brought heavy saw blades from Ratchet to Splintertree Post, but she will not give them away. In Ashenvale's wilds, safety matters more to her than coin. She asks to trade them for a Deadly Blunderbuss, so she can defend herself on the dangerous roads through hostile territory. The Horde needs Ashenvale timber to ease shortages across Durotar and the Barrens. Axes dull quickly against the ancient groves, so the Warsong loggers rely on goblin-forged blades. Pixel's shipment supplies the lumber camps, where the Horde cuts timber for outposts and war machines despite fierce resistance from the night elves.

quest:659.text: Hints of a New Plague?. In Hillsbrad, Phin Odelic's band searches for signs of trouble. Quae and Kinelory have been missing for days after traveling to Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands. Phin Odelic's cousin in Hillsbrad had to put down his dog, Stanley. The beast had mystically grown huge and attacked anyone who came near. Phin suspects the undead are behind these strange happenings. So his band searches for signs to prove it. Quae and Kinelory traveled to Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands. They have not checked in for days, and Phin fears for them. He asks you to find them near the farm.

quest:66.text: The Legend of Stalvan. Madame Eva's vision in Darkshire names Stalvan and warns of death for her granddaughter, Alyssa. She sends you to the Darkshire Town Hall to search the records. In Darkshire, Madame Eva reads cards and portents for troubled locals. A terrible disturbance jolts her awake, and she draws the Death card for her young granddaughter, Alyssa. Eva enters a deep trance to learn what the omen means. One clue comes to her: the name Stalvan. Fearing for her family and the town, she asks you to follow that name before tragedy strikes. Madame Eva sends you across the square to the Darkshire Town Hall. Search its records for Stalvan, and speak with Clerk Daltry, who keeps the town's ledgers and public archives. He can help determine whether Stalvan once lived in Darkshire, passed through as a traveler, or belongs to Duskwood's past.

quest:660.text: Hints of a New Plague?. Kinelory is ready to go down to the farm, and asks you to come with her. She fears the undead may harm Hillsbrad while they wait. You are needed to see her safely back. Kinelory is ready to act after the earlier steps of the investigation. She asks you to go with her down to the farm, then return safely to Quae. The people of Hillsbrad need her protected.

quest:661.text:
Hints of a New Plague?. In Arathi, Quae and Kinelory remain near the farm while you carry news to Southshore. Quae has the farm items, and Kinelory has returned safely. Quae is pleased with how you cared for Kinelory. She says Kinelory is in better shape than after a night at the tavern. The items from the farm should help Phin Odelic understand what is happening in Arathi.

Since the farm was attacked, Quae and Kinelory plan to stay there a little longer in case anyone retaliates. They ask you to return to Southshore and speak with Phin.

quest:6621.text: King of the Foulweald. At Zoram'gar Outpost, Karang Amakkar orders a strike against the Foulweald. Horde champions plant a war banner on the tribe’s sacred totem mound, drawing out Chief Murgut and killing him. Karang Amakkar sees the corrupted Foulweald as a danger to the Horde from his post at Zoram'gar Outpost. The tribe is smaller than the northern Thistlefur, but its members are fierce. So Karang orders a show of force to break their will before they can ambush Horde patrols. Greenpaw Village lies northeast of Mystral Lake. Karang prepares a tribal war banner for the center of the Foulweald totem mound, insulting the tribe’s ancestral spirits and pride. The defenders rush to tear it down, and Chief Murgut emerges to defend his honor in open combat. Taking his personal totem breaks the tribe’s leadership and establishes Horde supremacy in the area.

quest:6627.text: Test of Lore. At Braug Dimspirit’s perch in Stonetalon, you face a test of ancient history. Having retrieved the tome Legacy of the Aspects, you must show what its lessons taught you. A wrong answer sends you far across Kalimdor. Braug Dimspirit’s trial follows the tests Dorn Plainstalker began at the Weathered Nook. It calls for understanding, not martial survival or blind trust. Braug lives among the crags of the Stonetalon Mountains. He expects seekers to recover ancient texts and learn from their pages. The lesson concerns how the Dragon Aspects were created and divided, and the pact they made long before the Great Sundering. Braug asks what the tome says about the Earth Warder, Neltharion. His madness and betrayal reshaped Azeroth’s surface. You must understand this history before continuing along the path of wisdom.

quest:6628.text: Test of Lore. In the Undercity, initiates face a test of history with Parqual Fintallas. They have scoured the world for historical texts, and this examination is part of spiritual trials begun in Thousand Needles. The Test of Lore is one of the spiritual trials begun in Thousand Needles. Dorn Plainstalker set the trials at the Weathered Nook. This examination carries candidates from the wind-carved canyons of Thousand Needles to the Undercity, where Parqual Fintallas tests their knowledge of history and holds each seeker to a high standard.

quest:663.text:
Land Ho!. At Faldir's Cove, Lolo warns you that Captain O'Breen's brief stop may last far longer than planned. The Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden's Folly are lost, and Lolo directs you to the captain. Lolo greets you at Faldir's Cove and tells you what has gone wrong. Captain O'Breen promised the crew only a few hours ashore to gather treasure before sailing back to Booty Bay. Lolo doubts they will be away so briefly.

The Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden's Folly, two ships in the formation, now lie on the sea floor. If you mean to stay, Lolo says to speak with the captain.

quest:6661.text: Deeprun Rat Roundup. At the Deeprun Tram, Monty asks passing travelers to round up the rats. His flute’s charming melody draws the living Deeprun rats along. Monty keeps pests from overrunning the Deeprun Tram. He speaks in salty sea slang and treats the tramway like a ship’s deck. Vermin scurry through the underground station. So Monty asks travelers passing along the line to help gather them.

quest:6662.text: Me Brother, Nipsy. On the Deeprun Tram, Monty sends live rats to his brother Nipsy in Stormwind. Nipsy runs a rat kabob stall at the far terminal, while Monty's odd manner hints at Gnomeregan's tragedy. At the Ironforge station, Monty asks you to carry live rats through the Deeprun Tram to his brother Nipsy at the Stormwind depot. The short trip links the dwarven and human capitals beneath the mountains. Curious trades carry on along the way. The crate is labeled Carton of Mystery Meat, but inside are live Deeprun rats. Nipsy runs a rat kabob stall at the Stormwind terminal and needs the rats before they spoil. When the crate arrives intact and twitching, he is relieved to have food for travelers passing through the station.

quest:67.text: The Legend of Stalvan. In Darkshire, Clerk Daltry searches the town records for Stalvan Mistmantle. An old address points west to Moonbrook in Westfall, where the search for Stalvan’s past begins. After your inquiries in Darkshire, Clerk Daltry searches the town registry for Stalvan Mistmantle. The ledger has gone years without an update, and lists Stalvan’s last known home as the schoolhouse in Moonbrook, far to the west. Daltry takes the old address as routine record keeping. He asks you to investigate and bring back any records that could bring Darkshire’s archives up to date. The trail runs from Duskwood into Westfall, where the Defias Brotherhood holds Moonbrook. Once a thriving farming settlement, the town is now under outlaw control. Near its center stands the abandoned schoolhouse. Inside, an old footlocker holds the first clear clues to Stalvan’s former life as an educator. A sorrow still lingers around the chest.

quest:671.text: Foul Magics. In the Arathi Highlands, Tor'gan follows a demonic presence to Northfold Manor. From Hammerfall, he seeks help recovering bloodstone amulets from the summoners. Demonic energy stirs in the Arathi Highlands, and Tor'gan feels it from his post at Hammerfall. The pull draws the orc west toward Northfold Manor. There, he finds signs of demonic summoning, but the lingering corruption makes his blood boil and stirs an involuntary rage tied to the blood curse's history. He retreats before the influence overwhelms his senses, then seeks help from others. At Northfold Manor, Tor'gan found a bloodstone amulet on the ground. It showed that dark rituals were being performed there. Such charms help channel and steady demonic summonings, but the amulet he recovered had lost its magic. It held too little power for a thorough study. Tor'gan asks Horde travelers to retrieve ten intact amulets from the manor's practitioners, so he can examine the rituals and learn what entities were summoned.

quest:672.text: Raising Spirits. Tor'gan seeks a way to lift Gor'mul's spirits at Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. Tales of Orgrimmar and Warchief Thrall have brought no comfort, so Tor'gan turns to the Horde's newly rediscovered shamanic traditions. At Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands, Gor'mul has fallen into deep melancholy. His companions have told him of Kalimdor, the mighty city of Orgrimmar, and Warchief Thrall's leadership. Yet none of these tales has eased his gloom or given him hope. Tor'gan turns to the Horde's revived spiritual traditions to help Gor'mul. He gathers the eyes of highland raptors roaming Arathi and makes an amulet blessed with their spirits. Through this rite, he hopes the predators' vital force will awaken Gor'mul's will to live.

quest:674.text: Raising Spirits. A Horde emissary hopes Raising Spirits will help Gor'mul find his fighting spirit again. The Raptor Talon Amulet is meant to rekindle it, but Gor'mul remains bitter and doubts any trinket can restore the Horde's former glory. An emissary brings Gor'mul a Raptor Talon Amulet, hoping its power will reach him. The talisman channels the wild strength and ferocity of raptors. It is meant to rekindle the flame that once burned fiercely within the orc warrior.

quest:675.text: Raising Spirits. Tor'gan hopes ancestral magic can restore Gor'mul's pride and will to live. The shaman seeks to lift an old orc veteran from despair. Gor'mul grieves that he survived when his fallen Warchief did not. Many orc veterans bear the weight of past wars, but Gor'mul believes fate denied him an honorable death beside his leader. Tor'gan, a shaman, hopes to ease that sorrow by recalling his people's spiritual strength. He prepares an enchanted amulet and trusts ancestral power to rekindle the old warrior's pride.

quest:676.text: The Hammer May Fall. Tallow sends fighters from Tarren Mill through the mountains to relieve Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. Before reporting to Drum Fel, you prove your strength against Boulderfist ogres near the ruins of Stromgarde. In Tarren Mill, Tallow has little patience for fighters who have not proved themselves. While recruits stand idle, allies face attack far away. He sends capable fighters east through Thoradin's Wall into the Arathi Highlands, where Hammerfall is besieged from several sides. First, they must prove their worth against a strong foe. Only then will Tallow send them to the outpost. Tallow demands a show of strength at the ogre mound northeast of the ruins of Stromgarde. Boulderfist ogres and their enforcers hold much of Arathi and threaten travelers on the highland trails. Fighting them thins the hostile forces flanking the road. It also proves you can face the danger before reaching Hammerfall.

quest:677.text: Call to Arms. Drum Fel calls the Horde to strike from Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. The Witherbark have joined the Boulderfist ogres, and the Horde means to hold its foothold there. At Hammerfall, Drum Fel rallies the Horde from its fortified outpost in the Arathi Highlands. Old human ruins and hostile powers surround the settlement. The Witherbark forest trolls and Boulderfist ogres have made a pact, putting the Horde's foothold at risk. Drum Fel calls on champions to strike first and keep their enemies from deciding the struggle's course. South of Hammerfall, the Horde's first strikes reach Witherbark territory. The forest trolls have rejected diplomacy and joined the Boulderfist ogres in trying to drive the Horde from the highlands. Hammerfall targets their axe throwers, headhunters and witch doctors to weaken their leaders and show that the Horde intends to stay.

quest:678.text: Call to Arms. At Hammerfall, Drum Fel sends proven warriors against the Boulderfist ogres. Their attacks threaten the Horde's foothold in Arathi. At Hammerfall, Drum Fel calls on travelers who have aided the outpost to face a real threat. Boulderfist ogres have harassed the Horde expedition and tested its defenders. Fel sends warriors against these foes, not minor skirmishers. He expects them to return alive or with honor, and promises praise for their tenacity in battle. Southwest of Hammerfall, the Boulderfist clan has dug in near the dwarven bridge between Arathi and the Wetlands. Brutes fight alongside cunning magi, bringing crushing strength and deadly magic. Their aggression threatens Horde supply lines and control of the region. Drum Fel orders warriors to defeat ten Boulderfist brutes and four magi. Their defeat will weaken the clan and show that Hammerfall will not yield ground or tolerate rivals in Arathi.

quest:68.text: The Legend of Stalvan. In Moonbrook, The Legend of Stalvan leads you back to Darkshire's records. A dusty, unsent letter from an old footlocker proves Stalvan Mistmantle stayed there before his trail went cold. You find a dusty, unsent letter in an old footlocker while tracing Stalvan Mistmantle's past. Moonbrook was once an agricultural settlement, but now lies in ruin, crowded with outlaws and restless specters. Few remember his brief stay, yet the letter places him in the hamlet. You carry the letter across the border to Darkshire, where Clerk Daltry keeps the town records. He finds it strange that the letter was never mailed, but the evidence confirms Stalvan's connection to Moonbrook. The records can now point toward where Stalvan fled next.

quest:681.text: Northfold Manor. At Refuge Pointe, Captain Nials seeks your help against the Syndicate at Northfold Manor. Their hold between Stromgarde's defenders and Southshore slows supplies. Ogres, the Syndicate and the Alliance divide Stromgarde, and the factions fight to a bloody stalemate. The Alliance's forces dwindle as their enemies grow. The defenders need help from Southshore, but supplies arrive slowly. The Syndicate holds the ground between the defenders and Southshore. Captain Nials asks you to go to Northfold Manor, the Syndicate's base, and cut down their highwaymen and mercenaries. He hopes easing their pressure will let more supply trains through.

quest:682.text: Stromgarde Badges. In Stromgarde, the Syndicate pays for militia badges taken from the fallen. At Refuge Pointe, Captain Nials wants them brought back. The Syndicate fights a contingent of militia in Stromgarde. Its leaders offer gold for every badge taken from a slain militiaman, hoping to turn their followers against the better-trained soldiers. Captain Nials calls the Syndicate cutthroats and refuses to let them keep trophies from the brave fallen. You enter the part of Stromgarde they hold and bring the badges back to Refuge Pointe. Nials wants them to learn they cannot profit from the dead.

quest:683.text: Sara Balloo's Plea. In Ironforge, Sara Balloo grieves for Sully and asks you to carry her plea to King Magni Bronzebeard. Sara has received Sully’s final letter, recovered from the waters of the Thandol Span. She wants the king to remember his sacrifice, so she writes him a plea. Grief keeps her from appearing before the throne herself. She entrusts the sealed letter to you, a champion of the Alliance, to carry to King Magni Bronzebeard.

quest:684.text: WANTED: Marez Cowl. At Stromgarde, Marez Cowl advises Syndicate leaders and traffics with demons. Her influence threatens Alliance forces in the Arathi Highlands. At Refuge Pointe, Alliance commanders offer a bounty on a high-ranking Syndicate leader. Marez Cowl advises the Syndicate and directs its work in Stromgarde’s ruins as a field operative. The bounty aims to break the group’s local command. Marez Cowl is a warlock among the Syndicate’s brigands and dispossessed nobles. She deals openly with demonic powers to enforce her will and defend Syndicate territory. To reach her lair in Stromgarde, you must face armed criminals and the demons she commands.

quest:685.text: WANTED: Otto and Falconcrest. In the Arathi Highlands, the Stromgarde Militia has marked Lord Falconcrest and Otto for death. Falconcrest leads the local Syndicate forces, and Otto guards him with deadly skill. Their deaths would weaken the Syndicate's hold in the region. Proof must reach Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe. From Refuge Pointe, Stromgarde's defenders seek to break the Syndicate's hold over their ancestral lands. The militia has placed a bounty on Lord Falconcrest and Otto, his bodyguard. Bring both targets' heads to Captain Nials to claim the reward. Lord Falconcrest directs the Syndicate's push into the Arathi Highlands. His death would disrupt the criminal network's work in the region. Otto is a brutally effective bodyguard. His blades have killed dozens of Stromgarde's remaining militia soldiers.

quest:686.text: A King's Tribute. King Magni Bronzebeard answers Sara Balloo with a lasting tribute to her fallen husband, Sully. He sends you across Ironforge with a royal commission for Grand Mason Marblesten. Sara Balloo's plea weighs on King Magni Bronzebeard. War's harsh needs can be hard for common folk to understand, yet every soldier beneath the Alliance banner weighs on his conscience. He cannot undo a death on the front lines. He can see that Sully Balloo's sacrifice is remembered. King Magni chooses a stone memorial for Sully, not empty words. He entrusts you with his royal commission and sends you across Ironforge to Grand Mason Marblesten. The master stonemason receives the king's personal charge and prepares to carve the fallen defender's memory into stone.

quest:689.text: A King's Tribute. King Magni Bronzebeard has ordered a memorial for Sully Balloo, who died defending the Thandol Span. Grand Mason Marblesten sends you north to Hillsbrad for stone worthy of the fallen soldier. Grand Mason Marblesten carries King Magni Bronzebeard’s commission to honor Sully Balloo. Sully died in the disaster at the Thandol Span. Dark Iron saboteurs have attacked the span, a vital artery between the dwarven lands and the northern kingdoms. Marblesten will shape a sculpture to withstand time and war, so the Great Forge remembers the dwarven sacrifice. For Sully Balloo’s likeness, Marblesten requires Alterac Granite. Its dense, resilient stone and clean texture make it prized by masons. The finest deposits lie around Darrow Hill in Hillsbrad’s contested foothills. The journey into the troubled north is dangerous, but Marblesten seeks stone worthy of the heroism it will honor.

quest:69.text: The Legend of Stalvan. In Darkshire, a scratched registry entry sends the search for Stalvan Mistmantle toward Goldshire. Clerk Daltry finds another destination beneath Stalvan Mistmantle's earlier entry in Darkshire's town registry. The hurried note is partly scratched out. Someone meant to hide the route or changed their mind. It points northwest toward the Lion's Pride Inn in Elwynn Forest. You leave Duskwood's shadowed groves for Goldshire's sunny roads, where Stalvan's trail reaches too. The Lion's Pride Inn stands at Elwynn Forest's crossroads, where travelers, merchants, and soldiers gather. Innkeeper Farley runs the busy taproom and may know of an educated wanderer looking for a room.

quest:690.text: Malin's Request. In Stormwind, Archmage Malin asks for help recovering relics from fallen Stromgarde. He sends seasoned Alliance adventurers north to Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands, where an expedition seeks the magical relics left behind when Stromgarde fell. Archmage Malin serves in Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum and acts for his former mentor, Archmage Trelane. When Stromgarde fell into chaos, Trelane made a desperate stand at the Tower of Arathor. As hostile forces took the city, he had to abandon his post and leave powerful enchanted possessions behind. Malin fears those relics may fall into hostile hands. He sends capable mercenaries north to strengthen his agents in the field and reclaim Trelane's lost belongings. Refuge Pointe lies on the road to Trelane's relics, in the central Arathi Highlands. The outpost is a hard-pressed refuge for Stromgarde loyalists, and Malin's chief contact there is the dwarf Skuerto. Syndicate outlaws, Witherbark trolls, and Boulderfist ogres press the outpost from every side. When you arrive, Skuerto and the garrison are stretched too thin to welcome you warmly without immediate help.

quest:691.text: Worth Its Weight in Gold. At Refuge Pointe, Apprentice Kryten needs reagents for Archmage Malin. He asks you to gather tusks, medicine pouches and a shadow hunter's knife from the Witherbark trolls of southeastern Arathi. Archmage Malin sent Kryten and Skuerto to Arathi for reagents. Kryten was unsure how to gather them until you arrived. He needs ten Witherbark tusks, four medicine pouches and one shadow hunter knife. The Witherbark trolls live in southeastern Arathi. Kryten's research says every Witherbark troll should have tusks. The witch doctors carry medicine pouches. The knife belongs to the mightiest shadow hunters, who receive it after completing their rites of passage. Only battle will show which one carries it.

quest:6921.text: Amongst the Ruins. At Zoram'gar Outpost, Je'neu Sancrea sends Horde champions beneath the waters of Blackfathom Deeps. The Earthen Ring hopes a fathom core will show what the Twilight's Hammer is doing to the elements. The Twilight's Hammer has seized Blackfathom Deeps, an ancient night elven temple once sacred to Elune. Its cultists now command the submerged passages. At Zoram'gar Outpost on Ashenvale's shore, Darkspear shaman Je'neu Sancrea watches the corruption spread. He fears the cult will turn the local elements against the land and its defenders. Je'neu Sancrea sends Horde champions to recover a fathom core from the fathom stone beneath the waters of the Moonshrine Ruins. Shamans who can read the core will find a detailed record of elemental currents and disturbances. The Earthen Ring hopes that record will reveal the Twilight's Hammer's work and help guard the region against elemental disaster.

quest:6922.text: Baron Aquanis. Beneath Ashenvale, Baron Aquanis leaves a strange globe filled with tainted fluid. Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring suspects the Twilight's Hammer cultists in the submerged ruins and hopes the globe will reveal what corrupted the elemental. In Blackfathom Deeps, foul sorcery has twisted Baron Aquanis into a water spirit. When the elemental is destroyed, a Strange Water Globe remains. The impervious orb holds putrid fluid that seems to have sustained and warped Aquanis's natural essence. Physical force cannot harm it. Its energies unsettle those attuned to the balance of the elements.

quest:693.text: Wand over Fist. At Refuge Pointe, Skuerto has found where Trelane's first item went. Kor'gresh holds Trelane's Wand of Invocation in Boulderfist Hall, and Skuerto wants it back. After your work for Apprentice Kryten, Skuerto has traced Trelane's first item to Kor'gresh. The ogre holds the wand in Boulderfist Hall and uses blasts of ice to keep his kin in line. Skuerto fears Kor'gresh is close to discovering all its powers. Boulderfist Hall lies south of Refuge Pointe, then east of Thandol Span.

quest:694.text: Trelane's Defenses. Ogres now ring the Tower of Arathor, and Skuerto needs its defenses working. An azure agate from the Boulderfist shaman can become a key after Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe enchants it. In Stromgarde, ogres ring the Tower of Arathor.
