With fine metal scarce after the wars, he sends adventurers to Jasperlode Mine for picks whose steel can be reused. After the wars that battered the human kingdoms, good steel grows scarce in Elwynn Forest. At Eastvale Logging Camp, woodcutters rely on sturdy axes, saws, and other tools. Constant use and poor metal have worn them down. Without steady shipments from Stormwind's foundries, craftsman Hagar Lowe must keep the camp working with what he can find. North of Eastvale Logging Camp, Jasperlode Mine lies abandoned after its fall. Miners once worked its rich veins with finely made picks, forged when steel was plentiful and expertly tempered. Hagar sends adventurers into the infested tunnels to bring those picks back to Eastvale. Their sound metal can be melted down and made into tools for the camp's lumberjacks.

quest:91733.text: Downstream. Near Eastvale Logging Camp, Ormin Pelford's wagon has overturned, and the river has carried his woodworking tools downstream. Murlocs and wolves guard the banks where they lie. Laborer Ormin Pelford was bringing a shipment back from a local trading post when his wagon tipped near Eastvale Logging Camp. Its gear spilled into the river, and the current swept it downstream before he could secure it. Without the woodworking tools, the loggers face delays in their timber work. Ormin Pelford's lost cargo lies along banks where murlocs and wolves roam. Aggressive murlocs claim the muddy shoals downstream, while predatory wolves prowl the surrounding woods. Ormin cannot face those dangers alone. He needs hardy travelers to search the riverbanks, recover the submerged saw, axe, and toolbox, and bring them back safely.

quest:91736.text: Applejack Still. At the Applejack Still, cider becomes a clear, potent spirit. Apple vapor rises as the coils turn it into liquor. Fermented cider passes through the still and emerges as strong spirit. Near the apparatus, apple vapor stings the nostrils. Pipes and coils draw the fruit's essence and condense it into liquor. Alcohol vapor condenses inside the still and becomes a clear spirit. Applejack flows from the outlet into a waiting bottle, ready to drink or store. Even in rough field conditions, the apparatus produces a clear, potent brew.

quest:91740.text:
Croaky's Head. At Ridgepoint Tower, Croaky's death brings grim relief to a grieving Stormwind garrison. The murloc leader terrorized eastern Elwynn's roads. Proof of his death gives the guards hope as they struggle to secure the waterways. Murlocs along Elwynn Forest's rivers and streams have grown bolder. They ambush travelers and threaten trade routes. Croaky was a particularly aggressive chieftain who rallied other murlocs to attack near local roads. Merchants, farmers, and travelers between Elwynn and Redridge now face deadly roads. Croaky's death ends his ambushes and removes a threat to Stormwind's hold on the eastern woodland outskirts. Ridgepoint Tower guards Elwynn Forest's eastern edge and the strategic crossing into the Redridge Mountains. Officer Merell Ross leads the guards, though dangers around the outpost have stretched them thin. Murloc attacks recently killed two watchmen on patrol.

The deaths shook the garrison and exposed the vulnerable border. Bringing Croaky's severed head to Ross proves the chieftain is dead. Now the guards have reason to hope they can drive the raiders back from Elwynn's borders.

quest:91741.text: Nibbled-On Book. In Northshire Valley, Nibbled-On Book has been chewed by kobolds. Brother Paxton hopes to see it returned to Northshire Abbey's modest collection. Kobolds in Northshire Valley scavenge what they find left unguarded. You recover a chewed tome from a slain kobold, its cover torn and its parchment marked by teeth. The book came from the library shelves of nearby Northshire Abbey. Valley kobolds have been taking volumes from there. Brother Paxton tends the small library inside Northshire Abbey, where the Brotherhood of Northshire reads and studies. Kobolds from the valley slip inside and snatch books from the shelves. Paxton is grateful to have this nibbled volume back. Yet he worries about the rest of his collection still missing in kobold hands.

quest:91743.text: Rascally Rodents. Kobolds are carrying books away from Brother Paxton’s library in Northshire Valley. He fears they are devouring the abbey’s collection. Brother Paxton fears the kobolds that have spread from the hills and mines into Northshire Valley’s sacred grounds. He believes they are devouring books from his collection. With the library at risk, he asks young adventurers to hunt the kobolds and recover whatever volumes they can.

quest:91745.text: Mining Consultant. At Echo Ridge Mine, Kelsey Fargo watches the kobolds from her post outside the entrance. Their strange movements have drawn local attention. Kobold trouble at Echo Ridge Mine has taken an odd turn. The creatures defend their underground claims and gather candles, but now their coordinated disturbances have caught the authorities’ attention. You are sent to Kelsey Fargo, a mining apprentice stationed near the entrance. From her post outside the tunnels, she has watched the kobolds closely.

quest:91746.text: Elmpaw's Head. At Elmpaw's Head, the hunt is over, and a wealthy collector awaits its prize. The beast’s head goes to a handler who prepares and mounts trophies for affluent patrons. Elmpaw has fallen, and hunters prize the beast’s head as proof of victory. Trackers regard the hunt as an impressive feat, a hard-won end to the chase. A handler rewards you for Elmpaw’s severed head. Then the handler prepares and mounts it for wealthy patrons who want fierce wild trophies on their mantles.

quest:91751.text: Rough Wolf Pelts. Near Goldshire, Rough Wolf Pelts are needed for Helene Peltskinner's leather orders. Her husband is occupied near Northshire Abbey, so she asks for help skinning local wolves. Just outside Goldshire, Helene Peltskinner supplies travelers and residents with cured leather and furs. Her husband usually hunts Elwynn Forest's timber wolves for her. Now his duties near Northshire Abbey keep him away, while customer orders wait. So Helene asks passing apprentices to skin the local wolves. Timber wolves prowl Elwynn Forest's woodlands, farmlands, and roads. Skinning them gives novice skinners practice harvesting hides. Their pelts help Helene continue her leatherwork and keep trade moving through Goldshire. Hunters, too, sharpen their woodcraft.

quest:91752.text: The Big Picture. In Northshire Valley, kobolds carry stolen illustrated books into the mine for Shinyfinder Narf. The volumes are to be returned to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey. Kobolds in Northshire Valley have been seen fleeing with books and crying, “Picture for Narf!” Most gather candles and shiny trinkets, but Shinyfinder Narf seeks illustrated tomes. He has collected a sack of them in his hideout beneath the mine.

quest:91753.text: An Enchanting Lesson. At the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest, Kitta Firewind gives An Enchanting Lesson to apprentice enchanters. Kobold geomancers bind simple magic into crude wax effigies, showing why practice matters alongside arcane theory. Kitta Firewind, an enchanter at the Tower of Azora, challenges apprentice enchanters to look beyond polished libraries. She asks them to examine magic where it appears naturally. Even the uneducated kobolds beneath Elwynn Forest channel cantrips into everyday talismans, proof that magical instinct can thrive without formal schooling. Kobold geomancers shape Crude Wax Effigies with simple folk enchantments. Students obtain the effigies and carefully unravel their bound magic through disenchantment, extracting Luminous Residue. By taking these primitive charms apart, they learn how raw magic behaves in the field. Enchantment's fundamental threads are found through observation as well as in grimoires.

quest:91758.text: Follow That Kobold!. A kobold has fled Northshire's mines with Brother Paxton's books, and the abbey calls on Tordrin Sternblade to track it. Follow That Kobold! begins with a theft from the local mines. Kelsey saw a kobold flee the Northshire Abbey mine tunnels with a heavy sack of books. The workers and clerics thought the vermin in the mines were under control. The books belong to Brother Paxton, who needs them back in the abbey's collection. The kobold is a nimble scavenger from below ground. Tracking it through Northshire Abbey's wooded grounds calls for special skill. You are sent behind the abbey to the stables, where Tordrin Sternblade can be found. The dwarven Hunter trainer has newly arrived from Ironforge, and his wilderness knowledge can help pick up the kobold's scent.

quest:91772.text: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds. Kobolds are moving from Northshire Valley toward Elwynn Forest. You follow their trail with a tracking kit and report what you find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire. Kobolds have spread beyond Northshire Valley and the abbey grounds. With a tracking kit, you follow their trail to learn where they gather. Your report will help Goldshire prepare for threats across Elwynn Forest.

quest:91775.text: Book Return. In Elwynn, Marshal Dughan sends you to Fargodeep Mine for Brother Paxton’s lost books. One volume, “Fun with Elementals,” could place dangerous instructions in kobold hands. Marshal Dughan sends you into Fargodeep Mine for books belonging to Brother Paxton of Northshire Abbey. Kobolds have overrun the mine, and Paxton fears they might read “Fun with Elementals.” Its simple instructions could teach them to summon an elemental in the tunnels. Fargodeep Mine once brought gold to the kingdom of Stormwind. Now kobolds overrun its lower levels, while Elwynn’s defenders are stretched thin. The damp, dangerous caverns threaten the books. You carry the recovered volumes in a protective book bag, keeping Paxton’s records safe and arcane lessons beyond the kobolds’ reach.

quest:91777.text: Rare Books. In Northshire Valley, Rare Books sends you after two primers taken by kobolds. Brother Paxton needs them back at Northshire Abbey. Brother Paxton has lost two books from the library at Northshire Abbey. Kobolds carrying books and other things have taken them into Jasperlode Mine. The missing volumes are Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards and Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words. Both are primers on magic.

quest:91859.text: A Curious Pair. In the Sepulcher, Trevan Rol watches a rare pair travel through Silverpine Forest. The tauren and high elf carry the Earthen Ring's banner, and their presence draws the Forsaken's suspicion. Trevan Rol sees two travelers claiming to represent the Earthen Ring on the road by the Sepulcher. The outpost is a grim waystation where strangers receive close scrutiny, especially when they come on diplomatic business. A tauren beneath the shamanic order's banner draws little surprise. His cloaked companion is another matter. The scout recognizes an unmistakable high elf, a sight the Forsaken find exceedingly strange. A high elf openly traveling beside a member of the Horde's shamanic circles raises questions among the Forsaken sentries. The Earthen Ring attends to the balance of the elements, and high elves are rarely seen in Lordaeron, much less beside tauren envoys. To learn where the pair went and what brought them to the forest, you are directed to Deathguard Baldren at the edge of town.

quest:91899.text: A Sealed Crate. Trade handlers seek lost cargo as bandits disrupt the roads. You can recover sealed crates from the wilderness and outlaw camps to help keep supplies moving. Highway crime has risen of late. Organized bandits and rogue thieves prey on trade routes, ambushing wagons, pack trains, and lone couriers. Their cargo is scattered across wilderness roads or carried off to outlaw camps. These raids threaten the supply lines between settlements. Traders and cargo handlers rely on independent adventurers to recover lost freight and keep supplies moving. Sealed crates rescued from bandits or found abandoned in the brush can be brought to trade handlers. There, the goods help secure supplies, curb illicit trade, and restore safety to regional commerce.

quest:91900.text: A Sealed Crate. Bandits and thieves are raiding the roads, and lost shipments lie scattered across the wilds. Local merchants will pay you to bring a sealed crate back. Caravans and couriers now face ambushes along the old trade highways. Many leave wagons and crates behind when they flee, and the goods sit in the brush until someone finds them. Merchants and depot keepers depend on travelers to bring that cargo home. Carry a sealed crate to a receiving depot and you earn a bounty on the spot. Handlers sort the freight and send it on its way, so commerce keeps moving despite the brigands. While the roads stay contested, lost cargo remains steady work for any traveler passing through.

quest:91904.text: A Sealed Crate. Trade caravans lose sealed crates to thieves along the roads. Merchants seek the missing goods and pay to have them returned, restoring regional supplies. Bandits and thieves strike trade caravans on roads and shipping lanes. Haulers and couriers can lose their shipments in an ambush, leaving sealed crates beside wild roads and paths until someone finds them. Merchants and supply coordinators pay for merchandise returned safely. Bring recovered crates to regional collection points, and the goods can flow through disrupted supply lines again. You are paid for protecting trade.

quest:91905.text: A Sealed Crate. Trade recipients seek A Sealed Crate after bandits disrupt the roads. Recovered cargo helps keep local stores supplied and out of outlaw hands. Bandits and thieves have struck established trade routes, leaving merchant cargo scattered. Their ambushes put caravans and supply lines at risk. Across contested lands, lost shipments are a common sight. Recovering the crates helps local trade endure the lawlessness. Merchants and handlers rely on couriers to bring lost goods back to storage depots. Each returned crate adds to local stores and denies outlaws the gains of highway robbery. In return, salvage workers receive fair pay for facing dangerous roads.

quest:91920.text: Wild Eyes. In Silverpine Forest, Wild Eyes brings an ailing Forsaken scout to a desperate choice. Apothecary Renferrel's heart-based draughts have failed, and the scout seeks another way to stave off a second death. In Silverpine Forest, a Forsaken Deathstalker feels their body failing and faces a second death. Apothecary Renferrel's draughts have brought no relief. So the scout risks Renferrel's wrath and seeks another cure along the creature-ridden shores of Lake Lordamere.

quest:91921.text: Return to Quinn (Again). At the Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick needs a remedy before his affliction claims his mind and body. A courier brings him a mixture brewed from six hearts, restoring his strength for the travels ahead. North of the Sepulcher, Quinn Yorick rests at the Ivar Patch in Silverpine Forest. His affliction threatens both mind and body, so a special alchemical mixture brewed from six hearts is sent to his camp. For the Forsaken and their allies, bringing remedies to wandering kin can hold back rot and madness.

quest:92110.text: My First Real Potion. A child asks you to bring murloc eyes for My First Real Potion. She is eager to mix it herself. The child is glad to see the murloc eyes. While you were away, she gathered more herbs and found empty vials downstairs. Now she asks you to mix the ingredients as she watches. The potion turns sickly orange when the eyes go in.

quest:92401.text:
A Frightened Request. Edward Heartweaver’s wife waits in fear after he vanishes in the Ruins of Lordaeron. Since their son was lost when the capital fell, Edward has gone each week to search the graveyard for his remains. Now his usual journey has lasted several days. When the Scourge destroyed Lordaeron during the Third War, the Heartweavers lost their young son. His body was never found in the ruin. So Edward Heartweaver went each week to the capital’s graveyard, still hoping to find some trace of his child.

Grief and guilt kept Edward from letting go. The graveyard lay within the ruined capital, where the search was perilous. The surface ruins of Lordaeron are overrun by hostile creatures and lurking horrors. They are no place for ordinary citizens. Edward’s frightened wife warned him and begged him to stop going, but he kept to his weekly search.

Then Edward failed to return for several days. His wife turned to capable adventurers and asked them to brave the ruins and learn what had become of him.

quest:92415.text: Remember That I Love You. In the Ruins of Lordaeron, a stained letter calls for a missing child. Torn from parchment among the graves, it speaks of a child from the Heartweaver family. You carry it south to the orphanage in Stormwind City, hoping to learn what became of them. The ruined graveyard bears the marks of the Third War. Among grounds haunted by the undead, someone found a torn, blood-stained letter. It speaks of a missing child from the Heartweaver family. Prince Arthas and the Scourge swept through the kingdom and shattered their lives. Lordaeron fell, and the Undercity now fills the catacombs below. Refugees who escaped south scattered across the Alliance kingdoms. In Stormwind City, Orphan Matron Nightingale cares for children left without parents by the wars. You bring her the blood-stained letter, hoping she can identify a surviving Heartweaver child and give the family some closure.

quest:92421.text: Light's Justice. In the Undercity, Morbin Lightbane sends warriors above to gather what the Forsaken need. Intact limbs from the Scourge in the Ruins of Lordaeron help repair wounded Forsaken and sustain their ranks. Above the Undercity, Scourge remnants still prowl the ruined streets of Lordaeron's former capital. Though the Dark Lady has defeated the dreadlords and founded the Forsaken kingdom, clearing the surface remains costly work. The undead threaten the gateway below and drain the forces sent to reclaim the fallen kingdom. Forsaken bodies do not mend on their own. Rotting tissue and shattered sinew cannot knit again, so Morbin Lightbane sends warriors to gather intact limbs from destroyed Scourge in the ruins above. Those parts can repair wounded Forsaken and help them endure and fight again. Morbin Lightbane honors his late commander, Captain Garek Bandarion, by carrying on this work. Bandarion pledged to heal their people and free Lordaeron from Scourge occupation. To Morbin, destroying their mindless enemies and restoring their kin is justice in the service of the Banshee Queen.

quest:92422.text: The Wrath of Rath'mael. In the Ruins of Lordaeron, a fog hides Scourge movements above the Undercity. Rath'mael, a Scourge necromancer, has shrouded the ruined streets and graveyard. Deathguard Kristof in Brill calls for you to strike him down. Scout reports from Lordamere Overlook tell of a sinister presence in the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog now covers the ruined streets and nearby graveyard, hiding lingering Scourge forces. Rath'mael cast the shroud. His spells conceal the undead above the heart of Forsaken territory. Deathguard Kristof in Brill sends you to rally your allies and strike Rath'mael down. The Forsaken cannot let this menace take root unchecked. The Scourge may replace him, but his fall will disrupt their coordination, disperse the fog, and give Tirisfal Glades room to breathe.

quest:92432.text:
An Alarming Request. In Southshore, Emissary Jacques warns that Dalaran is in danger. Its ley lines are disrupted, and its constructs have turned erratic and destructive. Archmage Modera sent Jacques to seek outside aid. You are to find her image beside Lordamere Lake, near Dalaran. Emissary Jacques brings troubling news from Dalaran. The city's ley lines are disrupted, and its constructs have turned erratic and destructive. No one knows why.

The high council ordered the matter kept private to spare the order shame. But Jacques says the charade cannot last while the city is being overrun. Jacques was sent by Archmage Modera to seek outside aid. You are to find her image beside Lordamere Lake, near Dalaran.

quest:92434.text: Blood in the Streets. Turmoil grips Dalaran after its barrier comes down. Once the patrols are dealt with, Magus Wordeen Voidglare sees a chance for the Horde to enter and learn the mages' secrets. You carry a key from the internment camp to the sewers on the city's northern edge. With the patrols dealt with, Magus Wordeen Voidglare says turmoil grips Dalaran since its barrier came down. He urges the Horde to enter and learn the mages' secrets while they can. You carry the key from the internment camp to the sewers on Dalaran's northern edge, by Lordamere Lake. Perhaps the mages left that disagreeable entrance unwarded.

quest:92456.text: A Green Sample. In Stormwind City, Shylamiir seeks a living plant from Dalaran’s guarded garden. The cutting is wanted for study of mana-fed growth, but it brings back a darker surprise. Shylamiir in Stormwind City seeks a traveler willing to enter restricted lands. The Kirin Tor’s interest in botany has caught Shylamiir’s attention, and a living plant from Dalaran’s central garden is wanted for study. The secluded sorcerers keep their borders closed to outsiders. Reaching the garden calls for someone able to slip past their defenses.

quest:92457.text: Starving Arcane. Archmage Modera asks you to clear rogue elementals from the City of Dalaran. A breach has unsettled the city's enchantments and defenses, and the Kirin Tor needs room to tend its wards. The breach has disturbed factotums and enchantments across Dalaran. Some of those enchantments protect the city's defenses. Fragmented arcane energy has drawn Seeking Remnants, Saturated Remnants, and Mana Echoes. They gather to fill themselves with its free-flowing magic. Archmage Modera asks you to thin their numbers while the Kirin Tor tends the wards and other incidents.

quest:92458.text: Heart of Disruption. The Image of Archmage Modera needs help containing an arcane disruption in Dalaran. The Violet Citadel’s wards are under strain, and the Kirin Tor need time to bring the crisis under control. At the top of the Violet Citadel, a thunderous crash sounded from the parlors. The disturbance began there, and rampant arcane power now threatens the wards. The Kirin Tor are occupied inside, so you receive a key and are asked to find a less public way into the city before the disruption worsens. Modera asks you to collect an Arcane Mote. She does not ask what you saw in the citadel. Her concern is containing the mote and ending the disruption. The Kirin Tor must now take up that work while the wards hold.

quest:92459.text: Friend of the Kirin Tor. In Dalaran, Modera sends you to carry word that the city is calming and its wards may come down. The Image of Archmage Modera says the council may dislike the subterfuge, but the results are plain. Dalaran is calming, and its wards may now be lowered. She sends you with this good word to Archmage Celindra in the Violet Citadel. For the journey, she gives you an arcane mote.

quest:92466.text: Call of Earth. Initiates gather what their instructor asks of them in Call of Earth. Their effort shows whether they are ready to continue their training. An initiate faces a test of resolve when the instructor asks for particular materials. The gathering tests patience and endurance. By meeting the earth’s demands, the student shows the strength needed to commune with its enduring power. When the initiate returns with the requested offerings, the instructor sees their grit. The student has held firm through the trial and is ready for the next step in spiritual training.

quest:92467.text: Call of Earth. At the Rise of Spirits, you drink an Earth Sapta and meet an elemental guide. The earth's strength may help you seek the winds again. Shamans drink saptas to open their sight to the elemental world. Each brew attunes a mortal spirit to one realm and reveals spirits usually hidden from view. Only those with enough resolve can bear their power. Select practitioners guard the knowledge of these brews. You travel northeast through a pass to the Rise of Spirits, where initiates commune with the earth. Saptas are drunk only at sacred sites. On consecrated ground, the draught lets you pierce the veil and see what the spirits choose to reveal.

quest:92468.text: Call of Earth. An earth spirit sends you to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove with a shard of Rough Quartz. There, the shard becomes the heart of your first Earth Totem and begins your study of the elemental forces. An earth spirit gives you a shard of Rough Quartz as proof of your communion. It sends you to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove with the shard. Even the smallest fragment can endure. The spirits grant favor and respect to those who show patience, resilience, and wisdom. Windshaper Boros sets the Rough Quartz at the heart of your Earth Totem. He reminds you that the elemental path has four parts. You may long to hear and sing the songs of the wind. Yet mastery begins with understanding all four forces, starting with the unyielding ground beneath your feet.

quest:92479.text: A Scribbled Letter. At Northshire Abbey, adventurers receive a summons from Tordrin Stemblade after clashes with nearby kobolds. It calls promising recruits to seek his training as Stormwind faces growing dangers. After clashes with kobold camps in the valley, adventurers at Northshire Abbey receive a hasty letter sealed by Tordrin Stemblade. It asks them to give it prompt attention before taking up other business. The summons brings budding champions to formal mentorship within the abbey’s protective grounds. Tordrin Stemblade says times have changed. Unfamiliar folk now take up weapons to defend the realm. As the wilderness around Northshire grows more dangerous by the day, he offers travelers counsel day or night. He guides them as they master their skills and help Stormwind’s beleaguered people.

quest:92489.text: Power Overwhelming. High Sorcerer Andromath sends aid from Stormwind to Dalaran, where arcane power has turned dangerous. The Kirin Tor rebuild behind closed borders, and a Mana Elemental threatens their work. After Archimonde destroyed Dalaran in the Third War, the Kirin Tor drew inward. Scholars and sorcerers once came from across the world to its doors. Now the surviving magi keep outsiders away as they rebuild their ruined city behind closed borders. As the Kirin Tor restore Dalaran, arcane energy has grown dangerous. Volatile leaks surge out of control and take shape as beings of pure mana. High Sorcerer Andromath fears internal turmoil could undo the city’s recovery, or that Dalaran could abandon its old ties to the Alliance. So he sends champions from Stormwind to quell the Mana Elemental and remind the Kirin Tor that their allies still stand with them.

quest:92514.text: Welcome to Shen'dar Village. At Shen'dar Village, newcomers are sent to meet its elder and innkeeper. Local tensions share the frontier with a growing bandit threat. Newcomers in Shen'dar Village first meet the people who guide daily life there. Those touched by the spirits are directed to Elder Illaya Amberwind near the village square. Coriella Calmbreeze welcomes visitors at the village inn, where lodging and supplies are available. These introductions help travelers learn the village's customs before they take up arms. Disputes in Shen'dar Village stay civil, though the Windshapers and the High Order disagree. Their ideological friction runs through the region, but both groups know survival comes first. Bandits are pressing into the area. That danger gives the village reason to set smaller quarrels aside.

quest:92515.text: The Problem With Prideclaws. The Shen'dar Highlands village faces danger from prideclaws, bandits, and cultists. The beasts press toward the settlement, and culling them guards the people while providing useful pelts. Prideclaws are pressing toward the village in the Shen'dar Highlands. Bandits roam the hills, and unhinged cultists trouble the region. Villagers face danger from several sides. As the beasts grow bolder and their territory spreads, the settlement draws nearer to their reach. Villagers have organized a culling before the wandering predators can snatch pets or children. Driving prideclaws back from the borders helps guard the settlement. Their sturdy pelts also give village craftsmen material for useful goods.

quest:92516.text:
Hippogryph Harassment. Near Shen'dar Village, Hippogryph Harassment puts travelers in danger. A wild flock nests southeast of the village in the Shen'dar Highlands and attacks those on the nearby road. You are asked to cull its young, protectors, and matriarch so travelers can pass safely. Travelers near Shen'dar Village face danger from the skies. A wild flock nests southeast of the settlement, in the Shen'dar Highlands. Across Kalimdor, hippogryphs are known as noble beasts, and some are bonded to elven riders. Untamed flocks, though, fiercely guard their territory.

Wagons and lone travelers on the paths below have become targets of aerial ambushes. The attacks disrupt passage and could leave the village isolated if the creatures go unchecked. The flock's nesting grounds in the Shen'dar Highlands must be confronted to end the danger. To make the high roads safe, kill the young before they reach maturity and overcome the vigilant protectors guarding the perimeter.

The matriarch directs attacks on passersby. Travelers can use the roads safely again only when the nest is struck and she is felled.

quest:92517.text: The Criminal Element. The Highlands Bandits terrorize the Shen'dar Highlands from a cave behind a waterfall. A new cult has arrived, and local defenders are stretched thin. So outside help is needed against the gang's leader, "Badwind" Bennic. The Highlands Bandits have made their den in a hidden cave behind a northern waterfall in the Shen'dar Highlands. Their leader, "Badwind" Bennic, commands cutthroats who troubled the locals long before an enigmatic cult arrived. Since then, their lawlessness has grown into terror. Local defenders are stretched thin and cannot spare forces, so you are sent to break the gang and bring Bennic down.

quest:92519.text: Ward Restocking. At Hammerfall, Doctor Gregory Victor is short of remedies, antidotes, and elixirs for the infirmary. The missing tonics are at Go'Shek Farm. Doctor Gregory Victor tends Hammerfall’s wounded and ailing in the medical ward. The nearby Forsaken apothecary usually supplies the infirmary with remedies, antidotes, and elixirs. When those deliveries stop, Victor turns to capable travelers to keep the clinic stocked. Apothecary Jorell works in a cramped shack at Go'Shek Farm, south and west of Hammerfall. Doctor Victor says Jorell is often absent. The eccentric Forsaken chemist may neglect his duties or succumb to his own noxious concoctions. Couriers sent for the packaged tonics should find the medicine waiting, whether Jorell is there or not.

quest:92528.text: Among the Faithful. At Falaath Village, you pass among the Faithful of Al'Akir in the Shen'dar Highlands. Their growing ranks and storm magic draw close scrutiny, while their leaders gather with plans that threaten nearby settlements and outposts. You enter Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands as an eager recruit among the Faithful of Al'Akir. The cultists boast that their ranks are growing. They claim their devotion gives the storm its shape and fury. New arrivals are usually sent to Skypriest Aanders for scrutiny, but an unexpected meeting at the village inn interrupts that routine.

quest:92529.text: Falaath Village. At Falaath Village, marked recruits gather to seek the Windlord's favor. They come from Shen'dar Village to report to Missionary Jasaan and join the faithful. In Shen'dar Village, Sania Silverstream says her people grew prideful and took the bounty of the air for granted. The wind spirits abandoned them, and stagnation followed. Now penitent recruits receive the Mark of Akir and travel to Falaath Village. There, they join others who hope their acts of contrition will restore the wind's favor. At Falaath Village, Missionary Jasaan welcomes initiates bearing the Mark of Akir. Jasaan sees each new acolyte as a blessing from the four winds. Those who arrive may seek the elemental grace of Al'Akir.

quest:92550.text: Havoc in the Highlands. In the highlands, Shen'dar Village moves against Al'Aketh forces at Falaath Village. Its defenders mean to stop an assault before it begins and protect their home. Zealous cultists are preparing to assault Shen'dar Village. So its leaders send you into the ruins of Falaath Village to strike first, before the Al'Aketh forces can begin their attack. Al'Aketh zealots gather at Falaath Village and wield chaotic elemental power. You break their ranks by defeating Al'Aketh Stormcallers and shattering Living Lightning. Then you find Commander Cyclas and behead him.

quest:92551.text: Stolen Supplies. Caravans bound for the Shen'dar Highlands are under attack, and their stolen goods gather in Falaath Village. Food and windstones grow scarce in the highland settlements, leaving some skyborne close to starvation. For months, raiders have attacked caravans on the road between the lowlands and the Shen'dar Highlands. Their wagons carry food and windstones that highland settlements depend on. As fewer deliveries arrive, townsfolk struggle to get by, and some draw close to starvation. The Al'Aketh blame common bandits for the attacks. Yet the missing supplies keep turning up in Falaath Village, where the Al'Aketh store the stolen packs. The recovered goods go to the local authorities and constable, who send them straight to the skyborne in greatest need.

quest:92553.text: Restocking the Larders. In the Shen'dar Highlands of Zephras, a village cook needs help keeping the food stores full. Danger keeps the villagers from foraging, so the cook turns to you for eggs and strider meat. Rising dangers make life harder in the Shen'dar Highlands. Villagers can no longer safely enter the wilderness to forage or hunt, and the communal stores are nearly empty. So local cooks rely on travelers willing to brave the wild trails and help keep the settlement fed. The cook asks you to find strider meat and fresh small eggs among the highlands' wildlife. In return, the cook shares knowledge of local game and its recipes. Small eggs fried in ursera tallow offer comfort, with dried peacebloom for a quiet pipe.

quest:92579.text: To Valanaar. Aonda sends an urgent report across the island to Valanaar, where the peacekeepers prepare for a growing threat. Their leader, Valennia Stormfist, must ready her people as conflict with the cult draws near. After you help defend Shen'dar and its pylon, Aonda entrusts you with urgent word for Valennia Stormfist. Valanaar lies at the island's southeastern edge, where the peacekeepers keep their headquarters under Valennia's command. Aonda warns that the peaceful days are ending. Valennia must prepare her people for an inevitable clash with the aggressive, expanding cult.

quest:92595.text: The Windshapers. Among the wind spirits, The Windshapers seek a way to keep Zephras and the Shen'dorei alive. Illaya Amberwind welcomes new recruits to their work, as dangers gather in Skywall. Illaya Amberwind welcomes new recruits into the Windshapers, who commune with the wind spirits and protect the Shen'dorei. The order seeks those born with spiritual perception. They hope to mend the growing rift between their people and the elemental forces that sustain their aerial realm. Every Windshaper bears that burden. The Al'Aketh bring turmoil within Skywall, and the elemental plane holds dangers of its own. The Windshapers believe Zephras can endure and the Shen'dorei can weather the storm only if they restore their bond with the spirits of the winds.

quest:92596.text: The High Order. On Zephras, Rathiril Sunlance tells newcomers why the shen'dorei must now stand alone. Their elemental benefactors are gone, so these Highborne descendants of Eldre'Thalas turn to ancient arcane magic to protect their people. The shen'dorei on Zephras are working to reclaim their strength and choose their own path. For a long time, elemental benefactors protected them. Now those patrons are gone, leaving the people exposed to strife within and dangers around them. Rathiril Sunlance seeks those gifted in arcane magic to help preserve their people and build their strength on their own. The shen'dorei carry the legacy of Eldre'Thalas and an innate wellspring of arcane energy. Even those never formally trained in wizardry share that power. The High Order sees it as the destiny of Highborne descendants to wield these ancient gifts. With them, the shen'dorei hope to resist the Al'Aketh within and face the many threats to their home on Zephras.

quest:92640.text: Desperate Times. Valennia Stormfist waits in Valanaar with a plan to strike the cult at its shrine. Lorthuna must be stopped there, but the Windshapers and the High Order must first set aside their deep tensions. The cult cannot be safely faced in the open, so the defenders need a bolder plan. They will strike at the cult's shrine instead of fighting a long battle on unfavorable ground. If they eliminate Lorthuna before she completes her part in the cult's grand scheme, they can cripple the threat at its source. In Valanaar, Valennia Stormfist has spent time planning an assault on the shrine. The attack needs substantial reinforcements and strength united across the factions. Yet the Windshapers and the High Order remain divided by severe political tensions, putting their alliance at risk.

quest:92642.text: Disrupting Logistics. At the Gustberry Lowlands, Al'Aketh cultists are pressing a full-scale assault. Their healers keep the brawlers fighting, and the defenders need help before their lines give way. A fierce assault is bearing down on the defenders above the Gustberry Lowlands. Enemy forces are gathering, and the local lines are near breaking. The commanders expected substantial reinforcements from Valennia, but they must rely on whatever capable hands arrive. Strikes against the enemy's support may be the only way to hold the defense together. Al'Aketh brawlers press forward in ranks, sustained by healers who mend their wounds. In the Gustberry Lowlands, taking out those healers can break the cultists' push. That gives the defenders a chance to rally and drive back the invasion.

quest:92643.text: The Turncoat. A cultist of the Al'Aketh offers to defect and reveal what the cult intends for the island. You are sent to bring him from a secluded highland retreat northwest of Valanaar, where the meeting may be a trap. A cultist within the Al'Aketh ranks claims to know the cult's true intentions for the island. He offers to defect, but demands firm assurances of protection. The cult guards its plans closely, so reaching out may be worth the danger. The defector waits alone in a secluded residence in the highlands northwest of Valanaar. You must reach him with care. The meeting may be an Al'Aketh ambush meant to draw out those who pry into the cult's affairs.

quest:92644.text: Unfortunate News. You find the turncoat dead before they can speak. A damaged blue crystal remains beneath the body, and you carry it to High Elder Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. You reach the rendezvous and find the defecting cultist already slain. Their body is still warm. Beneath it lies a small, glowing blue crystal, damaged but still humming. You carry it to High Elder Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

quest:92645.text:
Breaking the Breaker. In the Gustberry Lowlands, cultists press the defenders hard. Commander Belguilos leads the assault from her hillside villa, and striking her there may be the defenders’ only chance to survive. Cultists assault the Gustberry Lowlands, driving the local defenders to the brink. Repelling them seems nearly impossible while Commander Belguilos directs the attack. All fear her as “the Breaker.”

Her villa is the operation’s base. Slaying her there is perilous, near-suicidal, yet passivity leaves the defenders doomed. Before she commanded the cultists, Belguilos kept order as a peacekeeper. Even then, those around her found something deeply unsettling in her manner. When the cult’s influence spread beyond control, she embraced its extremism. Now she commands the cultists and is a terror.

quest:92646.text: Confront Lorthuna. Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger pursue High Priestess Lorthuna through a portal into the Rohashi Spires above Zephras. They call for your aid before she can escape justice or strengthen her power. High Priestess Lorthuna flees through a mystic gateway into the Rohashi Spires above Zephras. An injured ally remains behind at the portal's threshold. Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger follow her into the heights and call for your help before she escapes justice or strengthens her power.

quest:92679.text: Blood Tithe. In Valanaar, Alvarion Windfield seeks aid for the orchard that sustains his family. Pain keeps the Skyborne farmer from his work, so he sends travelers west to his wife, Aamelia, who tends their lowland farm. Alvarion Windfield has come from his homestead to Valanaar in search of capable fighters. Pain leaves him visibly injured, and he fears for the livelihood his farm provides. He asks you to travel west into the lowlands, where his wife Aamelia tends their family orchard. The Windfield Orchard lies in the lowlands west of Valanaar. Alvarion is too ill to tend the farm, so Aamelia Windfield bears its burdens alone. Reach the western valley, learn what threatens the orchard, and lend the family your strength.

quest:92682.text: Make Yourself Useful. At Windfield Orchard, Ferauu's bandits are taking stormapples before their share is due. Some hungry outlaws have broken ranks to pick the trees early. Drive them off, and the orchard keeper will respect you. Windfield Orchard gives Ferauu's bandits a regular share of its fruit harvest. Ferauu leads the crew, but some outlaws cannot wait for his scheduled visit. They slip into the orchard early to pick stormapples for themselves. The orchard caretaker puts ambitious newcomers to work before Ferauu arrives. The keeper asks you to secure the ripe stormapples and drive off hungry bandits trespassing among the trees. They have gone behind Ferauu's back to take his share. The keeper says Ferauu would likely execute them for it.

quest:92683.text: Flutterfly Dust. In the Gustberry Lowlands, Flutterfly Dust draws a homesteader's interest. Travelers gather it from giant flutterflies while bandits threaten anyone who ventures alone into the fields. Giant flutterflies drift through the outer fields and orchards of the Gustberry Lowlands. Their wings shed fine dust, and you can gather it in bulk. Nearby homesteaders want the powder for practical household needs. Yet the insects remain wild. A Flutterfly Swatter brings dust down with a blunt strike. Most flutterflies panic, take to the air, and shake loose piles of powder. Some turn and strike back when provoked. Usually, they are docile. The dust is messy to gather and clings to clothing and gear for weeks. The homesteader eagerly awaits its delivery, since bandits make solo trips into the fields too dangerous. Ask what the powder is for, and the resident offers only vague words about general stuff and things.

quest:92684.text: Ornery Ornery Galestriders. In the Gustberry Lowlands, an orchard farmer's poor harvest is under threat from galestriders raiding the stormapples. Drive off the boldest birds to save the remaining fruit and bring home tenderloins for dinner. A poor harvest has left Gustberry Lowlands farmers with little to spare. Now wild galestriders strip ripe stormapples from orchard branches and threaten what fruit remains. The farmer needs the boldest birds driven off or culled before the crop is gone. Lowlands galestriders are larger and more bad-tempered than their highland kin. Take care near these towering birds, traveler; one powerful kick can badly hurt or kill a fighter. Their tenderloins give hungry locals a rare, substantial meal.

quest:92685.text: The Hills Have Eyes. Aamelia faces a bandit assault in the Gustberry Lowlands, and Ferauu’s raid draws near. She sends travelers to strike a camp in the northern hills before the bandits gather. Aamelia faces an approaching attack in the Gustberry Lowlands. Ferauu leads the outlaws threatening her farm. She asks you to strike their camp in the hills to the north. Thin the highwaymen’s ranks before they gather, and Aamelia hopes to weaken their attack and gain time before they arrive.

quest:92693.text: Standing Our Ground. Aamelia Windfield gives you one last chance to retreat to Valanaar before the bandits close in. You have helped the local defenders prepare, yet the coming fight still seems doomed. Aamelia Windfield gives you one last chance to return safely to Valanaar. You have helped the local defenders prepare for the bandits, but the fight ahead looks grim. Will you stand with them, or leave before the clash?

quest:92698.text: What Is My Purpose?. In the orchard fields, a Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct wanders without purpose. Its broken speech has repeated for decades, since the wind elementals departed. Aamelia Windfield knows what locals remember of its past. A Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct paces through the fields, caught in a broken loop. Muffled fragments come from beneath its armor, repeating errors and questions about its purpose. Decades alone have left its old instructions corrupted or forgotten. It looks imposing, but threatens no one who passes. Its broken voice carries over the soil as it wanders without purpose. Aamelia Windfield says the construct has roamed the fields for decades, apparently since the wind elementals departed. Alvarion guessed it once hauled harvests to distant markets or tended livestock, centuries ago, before the land became an orchard. The Windshapers built and maintained cyclone constructs in earlier ages. Orchard workers have talked of asking them to repair the machine, but the matter has never seemed urgent. So it continues to roam, largely ignored.

quest:92699.text: The Supreme Magister. In Valanaar, Elaadrin Evengale draws new arrivals toward the High Order. From a lodge in the settlement’s southeast, the order seeks allies as it faces hostile Windshapers and a nearby cult. New arrivals of promise in Valanaar are directed to the High Order. Supreme Magister Elaadrin Evengale leads it from a lodge in the settlement’s far southeast. He watches newcomers closely, seeking the strength, resolve, and arcane aura to face the dangers threatening their home. Peace in Valanaar is fragile. The High Order and the Windshapers are bitter enemies, so newcomers are warned to keep their distance from the Windshapers lest violence break out in the streets. A dangerous cult lurks nearby. With threats outside the town, its leaders cannot afford bloodshed within.

quest:92700.text: The Grand Skyseer. In Valanaar, the Windshapers seek travelers gifted with spiritual sight. They send you to Ayessa Dawnsinger at their lodge, while rivalries and a threatening cult strain the settlement. You arrive in Valanaar and are sent to the central lodge. There, the Windshapers gather beneath Grand Skyseer Ayessa Dawnsinger. Elder Amberwind has heard of your deeds in Shen'dar Village and welcomes you among those attuned to the spirits. Dangers press from beyond the town and within it, so tread carefully through its fragile politics. Peace in Valanaar hangs by a thread. The Windshapers and the High Order openly oppose one another, and street skirmishes threaten the settlement. A shadowy cult also menaces the region. Local leaders have ordered both factions to keep their distance and face this shared danger instead of fighting over territory. Grand Skyseer Ayessa Dawnsinger says skysight is growing rare among the people of Zephras. Those who arrive with a strong aura and harmony with the spirits are vital allies. The Windshapers need them as they guide their land through hard times.

quest:92701.text: To Valanaar. At Valanaar, Valennia Stormfist must face the cult's growing threat. Aonda sends urgent news from Shen'dar, where the village and its pylon were defended. After Shen'dar and its pylon were defended, Aonda sends a trusted messenger across the island. The message is bound for Valanaar on the island's southeastern edge. There, the commander of the peacekeepers must hear how quickly the cult is advancing. Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have long tried to avoid open conflict with the cult spreading across the island. Yet the events at Shen'dar mark a change. The cult's influence is growing, and Valennia can no longer hold back from a clash. Her dwindling force must ready Valanaar for an assault.

quest:92703.text: Deliver the News. At the Windfield orchard, Aamelia sends word that her family is safe. Alvarion waits in Valanaar, where he went to seek help. Aamelia thanks you for saving the Windfield family orchard. Her home is safe, but Alvarion Windfield has gone to Valanaar to plead for help. He needs to know his family and home are out of danger. Alvarion Windfield is overcome with emotion when you tell him his family and home are safe. He went to Valanaar believing his search for help was a desperate, nearly vain hope. Your success recalls the legendary heroes his people remembered from before they arrived in Skywall. The Windfield family welcomes you into their home for good.

quest:92706.text: WANTED: Bruuz. Bruuz threatens the ships that keep Ratchet busy. Gazlowe has posted a bounty for the huge shark prowling the docks and disrupting coastal trade. Ratchet is Kalimdor's main neutral gateway to the Eastern Kingdoms. Its trade depends on merchant ships. Lately, a huge shark named Bruuz has prowled the bay. Dockworkers gave it that name after it began attacking small skiffs, sailors, and cargo unloaded near the docks. The shark disrupts the port and puts the ships that supply Ratchet at risk. Gazlowe has posted a public bounty so ships will not avoid his port for fear of the shark. The notice calls on anglers and promises a hefty reward. To claim it, you need to slay Bruuz and bring back the shark's dorsal fin as proof.

quest:92708.text: A Grand Adventure. On Zephras Isle, Ayessa Dawnsinger and the Windshapers seek a way to save their home. The isle lies in Skywall, where wind spirits have vanished without explanation. Wind spirits have vanished from Zephras Isle, and the trouble keeps growing. The Windshapers have investigated the disturbances and uncovered truths about their missing kin and the fate of their elemental home. Ayessa Dawnsinger asks you to heed what they have learned and prepare for an undertaking unlike any before.

quest:92709.text: A Grand Adventure. In Valanaar, Elaadrin Evengale asks you to hear the High Order’s plans. Their search for ancient magic may shape Zephras Isle’s future. Elaadrin speaks of your Highborne lineage and the young people who may help save their home. The High Order seeks the ancient magic of its forebears, and what has been lost over many millennia.

quest:92727.text: The Missing Scholar. Fillion Flamebreeze is missing after setting out to study atmospheric magic on Zephras. The High Order sent the scholar toward the Shen'dar Highlands, and concern grows as the road from Valanaar yields no word of his return. The High Order gathers and preserves knowledge across Zephras. Yet field research on the island has grown perilous. Fillion Flamebreeze set out for the Shen'dar Highlands to study atmospheric arcane phenomena, but never reported back. His peers now fear the dangers along the frontier roads have claimed him.

quest:92741.text: Unwelcome Visitors. In Shadowgale Forest, shrieklings are pressing toward the woods' edge. Iaadaria Bitterwind in Valanaar asks travelers to gather their talons for the High Order. Shadowgale Forest is a dangerous woodland that ordinary adventurers are forbidden to enter. Now its shrieklings have multiplied in numbers never seen before. They are pressing toward the forest's edge and extending their hunting grounds beyond the canopy. If they keep spreading, settled lands and travel routes will face a growing danger. In Valanaar, Iaadaria Bitterwind of the High Order sees both danger and opportunity in the shrieklings' growing numbers. The Order usually leaves pest control and trapping to others. Yet shriekling talons have rare alchemical properties, making an exception worthwhile. Travelers are asked to enter Shadowgale Forest and bring back eight talons. The High Order can then help protect the region and study the reagents.

quest:92834.text: Avenged Tenfold. Elaadrin turns from diplomacy to retribution after the Al'Aketh cult answers his appeal with violence. The High Order scholar had sent his dear friend Belathaan Brightwish to seek peace at the Shrine of Akir, north of Valanaar. The Al'Aketh cult's violence brought armed posturing from factions like the Peacekeepers and Windshapers. Elaadrin spoke for the High Order and saw such displays as a foolish escalation. His order prizes pragmatism and avoids conflict, so he still believed reasoned dialogue could work. He sent his close friend, Belathaan Brightwish, to the Shrine of Akir to negotiate peace. The High Order puts logic before sentiment and holds that avoiding bloodshed is usually the prudent path. Yet Elaadrin shows how cold logic cuts both ways when foes mistake restraint for helplessness. Crackling arcane energy gathers around him. The High Order favors peace, but those who butcher its emissaries face overwhelming retribution.

quest:92840.text: Catching Wind. At the Overlook Standing Stones, the High Order seeks readings that may help save Zephras. Its expedition faces fierce opposition from the Windshapers in the Shen'dar Highlands. The High Order studies the wild elemental flows of the Shen'dar Highlands in hopes of saving Zephras. At the Overlook Standing Stones, its researchers use an Index Esoteria, a tool made to draw data from the great windstone formations. The Windshapers see these probes as profane trespass against the wind. The High Order's expedition and the Windshapers soon clash at the stones. The Windshapers call the study and taking of elemental energy a desecration of their sacred ways. The High Order sees them as narrow in their beliefs, much like the violent Al'Aketh. It will not let their resistance halt its work to save the realm.

quest:92849.text: The Missing Scholar. You follow the trail of Fillion Flamebreeze, missing after an assignment at the Overlook Standing Stones. The search leads north to a cave, where he was dragged by a winged beast. You find signs of trouble along the trail Fillion Flamebreeze took on his travels. They point to foul play. Following them leads north to a dark cave. The missing scholar may still be alive inside, waiting for help.

quest:92850.text: The Missing Scholar. Fillion Flamebreeze is stranded near a dangerous den, and Valanaar needs the threat ended. Once he can travel, he asks you to slay the Shriekling Matriarch nearby. After his ordeal, Fillion Flamebreeze can travel back toward the safety of Valanaar. Yet a brood of shrieklings has nested close to the settlement. Fillion asks you to enter the Shriekling Den and slay the Shriekling Matriarch before the beasts threaten the town.

quest:92860.text: In Service of Zephras. The High Order now offers Valanaar its full military and diplomatic support against the Al'Aketh cult. Hostile movements across the island have ended its policy of avoiding direct confrontation. The High Order once tried to avoid open conflict with the secretive Al'Aketh cult. Reports of large troop movements and clear hostility have ended that effort. The cultists are mobilizing, and every settlement on the island faces a threat to its peace and safety. So the High Order has chosen to act. It sends an emissary to join with local defenders before the Al'Aketh strike.

quest:92871.text: In Service of Zephras. Across Zephras, the Al'Aketh cult is gathering for a wider conflict. The Windshapers send an emissary to assure Valennia Stormfist that they will aid her peacekeepers. Reports of Al'Aketh activity are spreading across Zephras. Valennia Stormfist's peacekeepers have guarded the island for a long while, but the cult now seems to be preparing for a larger conflict. So the Windshapers pledge to stand with Valanaar's forces if open fighting begins. You are sent to Valennia Stormfist to assure her that the Windshapers are ready to aid her peacekeepers. Valennia welcomes their swift pledge. She is ready to speak with you about the cult's worsening threat.

quest:92880.text: Return to Valanaar. Yorna's report brings word to Valanaar that the eastern watchtower has held. Its perimeter is stable, and the remaining attackers are being cleared away. After the attack on the outpost, Yorna sends word to Valanaar. The attackers have been broken, and the defenders are clearing away those who remain. You carry Yorna's Report to ease the leaders waiting in town for news. You bring the eastern watchtower's report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar. The tower has held, and its perimeter is stable. Valennia gives thanks to the winds, relieved that the frontier remains secure.

quest:92881.text: The High Elder's Request. In Valanaar, High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong calls for help after coordinated assaults strike the region's watchtowers. Reports from the western watchtower point to a hostile cult targeting the local anchor pylons. Coordinated assaults on the western and eastern watchtowers reveal a troubling pattern. What seemed like scattered skirmishes now points to a planned attack on the local anchor pylons. A report from the western watchtower tells how a skypriest revealed the cult's interest in these structures. Now the towers' defense is an urgent concern. The threat to the anchor pylons is growing, so leaders send you to speak with High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. He has a promising lead on the cult's movements and seeks experienced allies to track the enemy. The cult may be preparing a ritual or sabotage.

quest:92909.text: Harvesting the Harvesters. At Saldean's Farm in Westfall, Ozwin Ironsprocket is trapped by haywire harvest golems. The visiting gnome tinkerer needs salvaged parts to build a way out. Ozwin Ironsprocket came south from Ironforge when its workshops heard of haywire harvesters in Westfall. The gnomish engineer believed he could diagnose and recalibrate the farm machines. He hoped to bring peace to the region's farmlands, already troubled by outlaws and now overrun by rampaging harvesters. Near Saldean's Farm, Ozwin found the harvest golems far more violent than his schematics suggested. Their sharp blades and erratic swings drove him into a nearby stable. Trapped there, he cannot safely return to the fields. He needs daring travelers to salvage isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the machines so he can build a device to escape.

quest:92947.text: Making Our Move. At the Shrine of Akir, a strike force moves against the Al'Aketh and their High Priestess. A frontal charge will draw the defenders while the main force approaches from the flank. At the Shrine of Akir, the assault depends on timing and divided forces. A small band of elite fighters charges the front gates to raise the alarm and draw out the defenders. Meanwhile, the commander leads the main strike team in from the flank. Their push divides the defenders' attention and opens a path toward the shrine's leadership. The Al'Aketh defend the Shrine of Akir with armored Guardians, mystical Spiritcallers and martial Blademasters. The strike force must break through their front lines to reach the inner sanctum, where the High Priestess directs her followers. Once the outer defenders are beaten, you meet the force's second-in-command, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, at the shrine steps.

quest:93.text: Dusky Crab Cakes. In Darkshire, Dusky Crab Cakes are a favorite snack with no crab in them. Chef Grual sends you to gather spider legs for Jitters, who is hungry and nervous. Chef Grual cooks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. Isolation, dark magic, and severed supply routes have left Duskwood short of food, so locals have changed what they eat. Grual says the cakes get their tangy flavor from the gooey legs of local giant spiders, not seafood from distant shores. Chef Grual sends you north to the foothills and riverbanks, where Venom Web Spiders spin their snares. Undead and feral beasts make the gloomy forest dangerous, but fresh spider meat is one of the few ready sources of protein in the blighted woods. Grual fries the seasoned limbs on a hot skillet until crisp.

quest:93036.text: Infiltrating the Cult. In Shen'dar Village, Sania Silverstream draws followers as its uneasy peace begins to fray. The village asks a newcomer to approach her and learn what the Order of the Al'Aketh intends for the settlement. In Shen'dar Village, an uneasy truce with the Order of the Al'Aketh is starting to unravel. Local authorities have long tolerated Sania Silverstream, a self-proclaimed missionary living among them. The Order claims to be a peaceful religious movement and sends gentle recruiters to draw in unsuspecting followers. Village leaders let Sania recruit to keep the cult from open conflict. Now that fragile peace is wearing thin.

quest:93065.text: Prepare for Battle. The Peacekeepers are gathering in town to march into the surrounding territory. You are called to make your final preparations and meet Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands before the company departs. The Peacekeepers, the local defense forces, have called their troops and volunteers to arms as tensions rise. Secure your equipment, ready your weapons, and join the company as it forms for an organized march into the surrounding territory. The company gathers along the eastern road leading north out of town into the Gustberry Lowlands. There, organizer Valennia Stormfist inspects the fighters and calls the roll. Then the company marches into danger.

quest:93089.text: What Comes Next. On Zephras Isle, the High Order seeks your blessing before departing with its Kirin Tor allies. Their expedition depends on finding an arcane answer to the island’s instability. High Elder Shadowsong has blessed the expedition, and its preparations are ready. Ansirem has worked to establish skycutter travel between Dalaran and Zephras Isle. Now the vanguard is preparing to depart. Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are ready to leave the island.

quest:93090.text: What Comes Next. On Zephras Isle, the expedition prepares to cross the skies for Kalimdor. The local cult is defeated, and High Elder Shadowsong has given his blessing. Skycutters now carry travelers between the island and Mulgore. High Elder Shadowsong has blessed the expedition's onward journey from Zephras Isle, where the local cult has been defeated and safety restored. The expedition now looks beyond the island, with its focus set on travel across the open skies toward Kalimdor. Ayessa Dawnsinger coordinates the final departure for those ready to leave. Muln worked to secure steady skycutter travel between Zephras Isle and Mulgore. Test voyages succeeded, and an advance party has already crossed over. They wait on the other side to make contact with the shaman of the Earthen Ring.

quest:93159.text: The Strange Hermit. In Shadowgale Forest, a hooded hermit keeps to himself beneath the trees. Though years alone have made him shy, he shares something of his handmade life and the forest spirits who sing to him. Deep beneath Shadowgale Forest's canopy, you find a hooded recluse far from towns and trade routes. He is known simply as the Strange Hermit. Years without ordinary company have left him nervous and awkward in conversation. Even a greeting seems strange to him. The hermit says he has the company and provisions he needs. He once lived elsewhere, then chose a life here among handmade trinkets and the local forest spirits. They often sing to him, though their songs cannot answer him as another person can.

quest:93160.text: The Forest's Bounty. In Shadowgale Forest, a forager needs help gathering fallen acorns. Raptor-like predators prowl the deeper woods, and the harvest can be roasted into a forest meal. A cautious forager in Shadowgale Forest has gathered the acorns near safety. Fierce, raptor-like creatures prowl among the trees and keep the forager from reaching the wilder groves. So passing travelers are needed to gather what lies deeper in the woods, and help ensure neither goes hungry. Shadowgale Acorns make hearty food when prepared with care. Raw, they can be bitter or tough, but roasting them over a fire turns the wild harvest into a rich treat. To gather them, you must brave the timber where predatory birds prowl.

quest:93165.text: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears. In the wilds around Shadowgale Forest, the Nightclaw survivors seek vengeance against the Al'Aketh. After a terrible tragedy at the cultists' hands, they offer coin and a promise of access to their hidden lore for trophies taken from slain enemies. Their feud now reaches across Shadowgale Forest and the surrounding territories. The Nightclaw enclave and the Al'Aketh cultists are locked in a bitter feud. A terrible tragedy has left the survivors with no hope of peace. They seek vengeance for their fallen kin and turn to wandering adventurers and mercenaries for help. The enclave offers coin and the promise of deeper trust to those who kill cultists and bring back their ears as proof. The Al'Aketh spread their influence through the Gustberry Lowlands, Shadowgale Forest, and the ancient Shrine of Akir. Their dark practices and fanatical ways have earned the hatred of local inhabitants. Striking the cult's camps across these lands can weaken its reach and earn favor with the secretive Nightclaw. The enclave keeps its mysteries close until an outsider proves their loyalty.

quest:93172.text: Free the Hollows. In Shadowgale Forest, the wind hollows’ sorrowful song carries through ancient ruins. An old tragedy binds these ghost-like spirits, and travelers seek to give them peace. Elves across the island have long feared Shadowgale Forest as a haunted grove. In its northeastern woods, old stone ruins lie beneath the overgrowth. Ghost-like wind hollows drift there without rest, but they show no malice. Their sorrow points to a disaster that befell the ruins ages ago. On quiet nights, travelers near the ruins hear strange singing on the breeze. No mortal song sounds like it, and its deep melancholy unsettles those who hear it. Compassionate travelers believe the shades suffer in their endless lament. They seek the wind hollows to break their spectral bonds and grant them peace.

quest:93317.text: Crab Season. On Zephras, foragers hurry to gather Windsong crawlers before the brief season ends. Cultists have made the shores perilous, so locals call for help. For a few weeks each year, Windsong crawlers appear along Windsong Lake’s freshwater shores and the rivers that feed it. Their meat is a rare harvest, but the season soon passes. Cultists patrol the wilderness around Zephras, putting local foragers in danger. The journey to Windsong Lake is too hazardous for gatherers alone. Unless you brave the shores and the ill-tempered crabs, this brief harvest may be lost.

quest:93318.text: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable. In the Shen'dar Highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable terrorizes travelers and nearby settlements. Constable Aonda has called for a Peacekeeper bounty, with Vulgara's head to be brought to Danarii Bellowveil. Constable Aonda has named Vulgara the Insatiable an immediate danger to the highlands. The massive winged vuldren roosts southwest of Shen'dar Village, where she terrorizes travelers and local settlements. The Peacekeepers call on bounty hunters to end the threat. Bandits and a shadowy cult trouble the Peacekeepers across the region. Slaying Vulgara would ease the danger to local people and keep the skies over Shen'dar safe. Then the defenders could focus on civil defense.

quest:93319.text: Pilfered Windstones. On Zephras, stolen windstones have left emergency stores short. The Highlands Bandits took them while Aonda's few peacekeepers guard against growing cultist numbers at Falaath Village. Windstones keep daily life moving on Zephras. Each settlement keeps emergency stores for times of crisis, but village supplies began to run short. Then captured bandits from the northern Shen'dar Highlands were found carrying the stones. For months, the Highlands Bandits had slipped into local stockpiles, taking what they could while security was thin. Aonda is responsible for village defense, and has refused to approve a raid on the northern cave. The settlement has too few peacekeepers to spare. To the south, cultists are multiplying at Falaath Village, so the guards must hold their posts against that threat. With the peacekeepers pinned down, independent adventurers must face the bandits and recover the stolen windstones.

quest:93320.text: Tower Defense. At the fortified position, Tower Defense holds against overwhelming numbers. The defenders have kept the line for now, but exhaustion threatens to break it. The garrison holds back the first assault at a fortified position. Yet the attackers outnumber them and keep pressing forward. The surviving fighters are growing tired, and the line between survival and defeat grows thin. The garrison keeps its perimeter, but time favors the attackers. Prolonged skirmishes against superior numbers drain the defenders’ strength. They need a decisive move to break the stalemate before their lines buckle.

quest:93461.text: Welcome to Shen'dar Village. In Shen'dar Village, newcomers with Highborne blood are welcomed under a fragile truce. The High Order and Windshapers keep peace within the settlement, while old rivalries simmer beyond its borders. Newcomers with traces of Highborne blood go to the main lodge to pay respects to Rathiril Sunlance, elder of the High Order. They also seek a room from Coriella Calmbreeze, the local innkeeper. Different elven factions share this haven, but their truce remains tense. Daily life brings rooms and odd jobs, yet friction persists between the High Order and the Windshapers. In the village square, both groups observe civility. Beyond the settlement, away from prying eyes, old rivalries go unchecked.

quest:93680.text:
Key to the City. Wordeen seeks a way into Dalaran, now rebuilt on the Dark Lady’s doorstep. In Tarren Mill, Magus Wordeen Voidglare wants to learn more about the Kirin Tor. Their city, Dalaran, fell to the demonic Burning Legion in a single stroke from the arch demon Archimonde. The surviving mages became dispossessed vagabonds. Now they have rebuilt Dalaran on the Dark Lady’s very doorstep.

Wordeen sends you to search their camps. He hopes you will find an ancient tome, a secret relic, or something else that can get the Horde into the city unnoticed. What you bring back is a grimy Dalaran sewer key.

quest:93735.text: The Broken Construct. In Valanaar, a damaged construct threatens one of the island’s last working relics. Riaani Nightwind has gone to the city’s western edge to examine it. The old machines carry a history reaching back to the spirits of the wind. Long ago, the spirits of the wind gave the island’s people magical instruments, devices, and animated constructs. Across generations, the Windshapers cared for these gifts. Then the spirits departed, and their patronage ended. Most creations fell into disrepair. Only a handful still work. One of Valanaar’s last working constructs has been damaged. Its loss would further diminish the island’s dwindling heritage. Artisan Riaani Nightwind was sent to the city’s western edge to examine the machine and try to repair it. These ancient devices are fragile, and she needs aid.

quest:93736.text: Unwelcome Spirits. The Windshapers seek the spirits of the wind, gone from their reach. Now hollows appear in Shadowgale Forest, and the order gathers their essences to learn what drove the true spirits away. The Windshapers have lost communion with the spirits of the wind. They seek to learn why the spirits left and what might bring them back. Their departure has left a void in the local elemental atmosphere. After the wind spirits departed, strange sprites called hollows appeared in Shadowgale Forest to the north. The Windshapers had not known of them before the spirits vanished. The hollows seem tied to the spirits’ absence, and their essences may help reveal what they are.

quest:93737.text: The Broken Construct. Ayessa has sent you to help Riaani Nightwind with a disabled construct. Hear his plans and learn what he needs done to set the machine right. Ayessa sends you to help Riaani Nightwind with a damaged construct. He is deep among its inner parts, searching for the cause of the trouble. Surprised by your arrival, Riaani doubts an untrained traveler can manage delicate mechanical work. Once he climbs out, he agrees to explain what needs doing. A construct depends on precise assembly and careful calibration. When it breaks down, its engineer faces serious work. Riaani Nightwind is shoulder-deep in mechanical parts and needs another pair of hands to gather materials or test the machine in the field. Listen to his briefing to learn how you can help bring the inert construct back to working order.

quest:93738.text: The Broken Construct. A Windshaper asks you to tell Ayessa Dawnsinger what you learned about the broken construct. The High Order’s work with wind spirit magic has drawn concern. Take what you learned to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar. The High Order has tested the Windshapers’ patience with its experiments in wind spirit magic. It has also touched knowledge under Windshaper purview. Ayessa can decide what should happen next.

quest:93739.text: Exploring the Horde. From Grommash Hold, you travel to meet the leaders who guide the Horde. The journey carries you from Orgrimmar to the Darkspear trolls, the tauren and the Forsaken. Nazgrel sends you from Grommash Hold into the wider Horde lands. The fortress stands at the heart of Orgrimmar, where Nazgrel and the Warchief's council oversee military affairs. You leave Durotar's red canyons behind to learn how far the peoples beneath the red banner are joined. You meet the leaders of the Horde's allied peoples: Shadow Hunter Vol'jin of the Darkspear trolls, High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof of the tauren, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, queen of the Forsaken. Speaking with each in person lets you see the ties between Kalimdor and Lordaeron, across the Great Sea, where plague has scarred the land.

quest:93740.text: Blood for Blood. Several Windshaper novices lie dead in the Highlands, and the Windshapers suspect the Al'Aketh. Ayessa sends you north to the Gustberry Lowlands to answer the killings and bring back the fallen cultists' windstone prayer charms. Several Windshaper novices have been found slain in the Highlands. Proof is scarce, yet the Windshapers suspect the Al'Aketh cultists. Their zealotry makes them the chief suspects. The Windshapers' creed demands an eye for an eye, so they will not let the killings go unanswered. Ayessa calls for you to strike at any Al'Aketh you find north in the Gustberry Lowlands. She asks you to bring back the windstone prayer charms carried by the fallen cultists, as proof of their deaths. The Windshapers see this strike as an answer to the cultists' long fanaticism.

quest:93791.text: Speak with Belann. In Valanaar, aspiring spellcasters are sent to meet Belann Windwood. The High Order honors the making of a personal spell focus as a long-held tradition. As students grow in command of magic, the High Order turns to an ancient custom to test and strengthen their talents. Making a spell focus of their own, whether a wand or staff, is one of the order’s most enduring traditions. It is for students who wish to bind their growing power to an implement they have made themselves. In Valanaar, initiates seek Belann Windwood for help with this craft. He has spent more than a century forging staves and wands for the High Order. A trusted mentor, Belann welcomes dedicated students and guides them through the craft and history of their magical tools.

quest:93797.text: Boughs in the Wind. In Valanaar, Belann Windwood guides apprentices through the old rite of shaping a spell focus. They seek a wind-touched branch near Falaath Village, as fewer people in Zephras are born with a gift for magic. Young spellcasters in Zephras begin this old rite when they show a gift for magic. In Valanaar, Belann Windwood guides apprentices as they gather a fallen branch from the region’s oldest trees. The boughs keep traces of wind, making them fit to channel spells. The strongest boughs lie near the wind shrine just south of Falaath Village, where elemental currents gather. Tradition says a branch may choose its spellcaster, and some say it sings softly to those able to wield its power. For elders like Belann, each apprentice who completes the rite helps carry their culture forward. Fewer people in Zephras are born with a gift for magic each passing year.

quest:93835.text: Confront Lorthuna. An injured mage needs you to follow Ayessa Dawnsinger and Elaadrin Evengale through a portal to the Rohashi Spires. There, they face High Priestess Lorthuna and need your help. Lorthuna fled through a portal to the spires above. Ayessa Dawnsinger and Elaadrin Evengale followed moments ago, but their companion is too badly hurt to go with them. Join the two mages through the portal as they face the High Priestess.

quest:93836.text: The Fate of Zephras. After Lorthuna falls, word of danger reaches Valanaar. Zephras Isle's wards have failed, and Ayessa proposes a journey to Azeroth. High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong must hear what has happened. Lorthuna has fallen after the battle above the Shrine of Akir. Yet Zephras Isle has paid dearly for the victory. Its ancient wards, which hid it from Al'Akir, have collapsed. The floating sanctuary now lies exposed in the Windlord's domain. A messenger crosses the isle with word for Valanaar.

quest:93926.text: The Western Watch. At the outpost southwest of the settlement, cultists press the defenders, and local leaders call them back. They judge the tower too costly to hold and turn to protecting the village. The western watchtower guards the frontier southwest of the settlement. Cultists have renewed their assault, and local leaders decide the isolated post costs too many lives to defend. So they prepare orders recalling the peacekeepers. They hope to spare more lives and gather every defender to protect the village and its people.

quest:93927.text: A Last Request. On Zephras, a fallen peacekeeper carries a message that may reveal his final moments. His bloodstained note points to the duty he left unfinished. You find a dead peacekeeper in the field with a bloodstained note in his hands. When you examine him, the note slips free. On Zephras, peacekeepers risk their lives to keep order. His last words may tell what happened to him. The bloodied parchment holds the peacekeeper's final plea or instructions. Whoever killed him left his duty unfinished. Read the clues and complete his final mission. The note points the way to answer his dying call.
