Arbal sends defenders there to cut down their numbers before that happens.

quest:98021.text: Journey to Sentinel Hill. At Sentinel Hill, Journey to Sentinel Hill brings Alliance travelers into Westfall’s troubled farmlands. The local commanders have pleaded with Stormwind for months without answer, and now put any willing traveler to work. In Westfall, you arrive at Sentinel Hill, the outpost guarding the surrounding farmlands. Its garrison is short of soldiers and overlooked by the royal court. When travelers offer help, the local commander asks little about their standing. Any willing hands are welcome. For months, Sentinel Hill’s leaders have asked Stormwind for soldiers to defend Westfall from threats drawing near. With no reinforcements, local commanders accept whoever arrives. One commander expected an army and got a skinny elf instead. In Westfall, beggars cannot be choosers.

quest:98024.text: Journey to the Crossroads. A newly arrived traveler from the elemental plane is sent to the Crossroads in the Barrens. There, Thork calls for aid as the Horde faces the dangers of Kalimdor's frontier. You have come to Azeroth from the elemental plane. Mortal conflicts may seem small beside what you have known, but the Horde faces dangers of its own. Service on the frontier gives you a chance to grow formidable while aiding the realm. The Barrens lie southwest, and the Crossroads stands among its broad, sun-baked plains. This Horde outpost is a vital junction, though dangers press its defenders from every side. Report to Thork and join the settlement's defense.

quest:98025.text: WANTED: Jai'vhanel. Near Auberdine, Jai'vhanel ambushes travelers on the coastal roads. The Auberdine Village Council has set a bounty for her death near the ruins of Ameth'Aran, with proof to be brought to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea. On Darkshore's coastal roads near Auberdine, travelers face danger from a mad owl. Jai'vhanel, known locally as Swordfeather, has turned on those who pass. She ambushes travelers and couriers near the settlement, leaving the roads unsafe. The Auberdine Village Council offers a bounty to make the roads safer. Jai'vhanel hunts north of the ruins of Ameth'Aran, along the mountain base. Bring one of her black feathers to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine as proof of the kill and to claim the reward.

quest:98042.text: It's All Fun and Games Until.... Thundris hears a troubled report and examines the discovery brought before him. Its mark sends the relic to Darnassus for study. You bring a troubling discovery to Thundris and seek his counsel. He listens to your report and examines what you have brought. Then he falls quiet, for the signs before him are too dark to dismiss.

quest:98046.text: Crown of the Earth. In Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm turns from a failed rite and sends its vessel away. He asks you to carry it to Priestess Lariia at the Temple of the Moon for disposal. Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm guides the night elves while Malfurion Stormrage is absent. Seeking answers, he performs an incantation with sacred water held in a phial. The rite brings no answer, and Fandral's temper rises. Certain the water is useless, he dismisses you with sharp words and sends you south to the Temple of the Moon, where the priestesses can dispose of the vessel.

quest:98065.text: Crown of the Earth. Within Darnassus, purified Moonwell Remnants are brought to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. The meeting takes place in the Temple of the Moon, where the waters’ sacred meaning meets the strain between Tyrande and Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm. Once the sacred Moonwell Remnants are collected, you pour the blessed water into a ceremonial vessel and carry it to Tyrande Whisperwind. The High Priestess of Elune keeps audience high within the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She watches over the city and offers her goddess’s light to all who enter. To place sacred water in her care is an honor and an act of devotion to Elune.

quest:98067.text: Eyes of the Sentinels. In Darnassus, Sentinel Dalia Sunblade sets owls to watch as unease grows across Teldrassil. Their posts guard the city and leave the Sentinels time to pray to Elune. At the Temple of the Moon, Sentinel Dalia Sunblade watches over Darnassus. General Shandris Feathermoon has decreed that every warrior must balance skill in battle with devotion to Elune. So Dalia arranges for sentinel owls to watch key places in the city. Their daily duties leave the Sentinels time for prayer and reflection before the Moon Goddess, while Darnassus remains guarded. Unease spreads across Teldrassil, and the Sentinels grow more watchful. Sentinel owls take posts at the northern entrance to the depths beneath Cenarion Hold, the bank in the town square, the inn in Craftsman's Terrace, and the main city gates. Local city guards help place them. From these posts, the owls watch over those who walk the streets of the Great Tree.

quest:98069.text: Stolen Freewind Supplies. At Freewind Post, Jandia needs the harpies' stolen supplies back. The post has enough for now, but it will soon run short without another shipment. The harpies struck the last caravan bound for Freewind Post. Jandia says the post can manage for now, though its stores will not last without more supplies. The harpies' lair lies west of the post, along the cliff base and in a cave above.

quest:98070.text: Stop the Screeching. In Screeching Canyon, harpies ambush supply caravans bound for Freewind Post. Their attacks may keep those caravans from traveling there. A supplier fears the harpy attacks will stop caravans from traveling to Freewind Post. You are asked to slay Screeching Harpies, Screeching Roguefeather Harpies, and Screeching Windcallers. Until then, caravans that brave the canyon remain in danger.

quest:98071.text: Brewer's Trade. In Hillsbrad, you carry Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok, where the brew-kin trade for Homebrew Hops. They miss the Fallrook family's vineyards, and cases of wine remain in the cellars. Fallrook wine still waits in the cellars, though most of the family's best bottled years are long gone. The brew-kin at Dun Garok miss those vineyards, so a trade has been arranged. You carry a case southeast to Dun Garok. The brew-kin gather beside the fireplace at the base of their fort. In return, you bring back a sack of their Homebrew Hops.

quest:98072.text: Crocs of the Sky. James asks if you have the scales, then praises your skill. He offers you work if you leave adventuring behind. James calls you a natural talent and invites you back if you take a break from adventuring. He jokes that you may be older by then.

quest:98094.text: Scout Support. South of Tarren Mill, you carry new orders from High Executor Darthalia to Deathstalker Masoj. The Forsaken press on with their plan to take control of these lands. High Executor Darthalia trusts you with word for the forward spies. She gives you updated orders for Deathstalker Masoj, who waits on high ground north of Nethander Stead and outside Dun Garok. The Forsaken plan to take control of these lands continues, and Masoj is waiting for your delivery.

quest:98095.text: Valuable Vantages. Around Hillsbrad Foothills, Deathstalker Masoj needs you to restore three signaling marks. Bat riders use those points to guide strategic troops to their drop-off sites. You carry Apothecary Vials to three high places: the hills beside Dun Garok, the plateau above Dunholde Keep, and the Headland ridge above Hillsbrad. Their vapors draw bats back to the marks. Then Masoj's high command can guide its troops through the foothills. Masoj asks you to search for crushed, empty vials and renew the marks at all three places. He says this work serves plans advancing under the Deathstalkers' banner.

quest:981.text: The Tower of Althalaxx. Beneath the tower's shadow, the Cult of the Dark Strand has been broken. Word of victory travels south to Delgren the Purifier in Ashenvale, closing the campaign against the cult in Darkshore. For weeks, the Cult of the Dark Strand held the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. Tracking its movements, gathering intelligence, and meeting it in violent skirmishes dismantled its work. The cult's sorcerers are slain, and its dark rituals are broken. The immediate danger of demonic infiltration in Darkshore has ended. After the cult leader's death, Balthule Shadowstrike sends you south to Maestra's Post beneath the Ashenvale canopy. Delgren the Purifier waits there. A devoted warrior of the Holy Light, he oversaw the fight against the tower's wicked occupants. Your report of the cult's collapse eases the regional defenders' minds. Delgren gives you his lasting blessing and gratitude.

quest:98155.text: Pristine Pesterhide Pelts. In Thousand Needles, Kristy Grant hopes to send Pesterhide pelts to her sisters in Stormwind. They can make the hides into garments and goods, while Kristy relies on travelers to gather them. As Kristy Grant crosses the canyon floor of Thousand Needles, the Pesterhide hyenas catch her eye. Their pelts are little known in the Eastern Kingdoms, and she hopes to send some home to her sisters in Stormwind. Skilled hands in her family can turn the hides into fine garments and goods. Kristy Grant knows craft and trade, but she has no combat experience. Pesterhide hyenas roam beneath the mesas in vicious packs, so gathering their hides alone is dangerous. She relies on seasoned travelers to bring her five undamaged pelts for her sisters to work with back home.

quest:98189.text: Return the Statuette. A statuette's delivery to Menethil Harbor was interrupted by tragedy. You are asked to bring it to Captain Stoutfist at Menethil Keep. The statuette was meant for Menethil Harbor, where Captain Stoutfist at Menethil Keep was expected to sign for it. Now you are asked to finish the delivery.

quest:98190.text: A Friend of the Family. In Menethil Harbor, leaders fear their relics will fall into enemy hands. They send the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep for safekeeping. Menethil Harbor links the northern Eastern Kingdoms with the south. It bears the name of the late King Terenas Menethil II of Lordaeron. Yet treacherous marshes and enemies surround the port. With danger growing, its leaders fear the outpost cannot guard relics from the fallen northern kingdom. Dragonmaw orcs still infest the Wetlands. Their clan has a dark past and favors ruthless advantage. Harbor defenders fear the orcs will seize the Menethil Statuette for conquest. They might defile it or turn it to their own ends. The courier takes the relic straight to Stormwind Keep, past the usual military and bureaucratic channels. There, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon receives it as regent to the young King Anduin Wrynn. The capital's leaders are trusted to guard a piece of Lordaeron's heritage.

quest:98191.text: A Friend of the Family. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon sends a rare likeness of King Terenas to the Cathedral of Light. Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker will keep the Menethil Statuette safe. King Terenas Menethil II helped shape the Grand Alliance during the Second War. He lived with deep personal devotion, yet held great standing among humanity's kingdoms. Humble by nature, he disliked monuments made in his honor. Few likenesses were commissioned, and fewer survived Lordaeron's ruin and the Scourge's devastation. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon sees more than fine carving in the surviving Menethil Statuette. The Holy Light has begun to gather within it, lending the figure a quiet spiritual presence. Bolvar decides Stormwind Keep is no place for so sacred a piece. He sends it across the city to the Cathedral of Light, into the care of Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker, who trains paladins.

quest:98197.text: Spoils of War. As the Dragonmaw move, Valstag Ironjaw seeks timber and iron from Menethil Harbor. He needs them to strengthen the town’s defenses. Menethil Harbor once served the Old Horde as a staging ground for an invasion of Hillsbrad. The fleet built there drew on resources stolen from Khaz Modan. Some supplies remain in the harbor, and Valstag asks you to bring him the timber and iron for the town’s defenses.

quest:98208.text: Bloom of the Heavens. Sylessa Duskwhisper searches the waters south of Menethil Harbor for Bloom of the Heavens. The sacred flower Nord'el was lost when the night elf vessel Flying Osprey wrecked alongside ships of the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Murlocs now occupy the wreck, where Nord'el lies among the ruins. Sylessa Duskwhisper has come from Auberdine to Menethil Harbor to recover Nord'el. The flower was gathered beneath a full moon atop Mount Hyjal, and holds deep meaning for the night elves. Those who now live in Teldrassil treasure relics from their ancestral mountain as reminders of their heritage. Many moons ago, the night elf vessel Flying Osprey wrecked on the rocky coast south of Menethil Harbor while sailing with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Its ruined hull rests in the shallows. Fierce murloc raiders have made the wreck their home and defend it from anyone seeking the night elf cargo.

quest:98209.text: Bloom of the Heavens. Across the Great Sea, Nord'el is bound for Auberdine after its recovery in the Wetlands. For night elves still grieving the loss of their immortality, the flower carries the grace of Elune. In the Wetlands, Sylessa recovers Nord'el, the legendary flower, despite an attack by local murlocs. Worn out by her escape, she entrusts the plant to you for its voyage across the Great Sea to Auberdine. From Menethil Harbor, a boat sails directly to Darkshore, linking the Eastern Kingdoms with northern Kalimdor. When Nord'el reaches Auberdine, Elder Thundris Windweaver is astonished. He believed the sacred bloom had vanished forever. Night elves still bear the cost of surrendering their immortality after the Battle of Mount Hyjal, and Nord'el's survival feels like a blessing from Elune. Thundris prepares to send the delicate plant to Darnassus, where it can be cultivated and preserved for future generations.

quest:98245.text: Razormaw Needling. In the Wetlands, Howin Kindfeather seeks Razormaw teeth for dragon whelp armor. He plans to make awls that can stitch the scales together against dragonfire. Howin Kindfeather means to strike back at the foes who have plagued the Wetlands: the Dark Iron dwarves, the Dragonmaw orcs, and the drakes they brought into battle. He is making armor from dragon whelp scales to guard against dragonfire. Their hides are too tough for ordinary tools to sew. Howin needs sharp, sturdy tools to pierce the whelp hide. He looks to the Razormaw raptors that stalk Raptor Ridge in the northeast and Saltspray Glen in the northwest. Their needle-sharp incisors make strong awls. These can pierce dragon scales without shattering under pressure.

quest:98246.text: Trying Times. Before Howin Kindfeather can fly through the Wetlands, Bassbeak needs a meal. He seeks a dozen intact eggs from the fierce Razormaw raptors. Howin Kindfeather tends Bassbeak in the Wetlands. The dwarf will not fly with his gryphon until her hunger is eased. A hungry gryphon can be stubborn and unpredictable. She may lash out, so a proper meal must come before any flight through the marshes. Howin seeks food for Bassbeak among the Razormaw raptors. Their nests lie at Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest. Razormaw eggs have yolks as large as a gnome's head. Howin wants those substantial meals to satisfy Bassbeak before she faces the dangers of the Wetlands.

quest:98248.text: Shipping Label. A torn manifest points couriers toward Durotar Supply and Logistics in the Barrens. The company depends on travelers to recover lost crates and return paperwork to its post west of the Crossroads, keeping supplies and trade moving across central Kalimdor. A torn manifest is fixed to a freshly restocked cargo crate. Its recipient's name has worn away, but the heading names Durotar Supply and Logistics, a freight company in Horde territory. Beside the writing, a rough map points couriers toward the company's staging grounds in the central plains. The notice welcomes travelers bringing stray containers, damaged goods, or proof of salvage to the trade outpost west of the Crossroads. Durotar Supply and Logistics depends on independent haulers to recover scattered freight across the Barrens. Those who help keep regional supplies moving receive compensation.

quest:98283.text: Carnage. In the Wetlands, Rethiel the Greenwarden asks you to draw Carnage from its lair. The Razormaw alpha's plague-driven frenzy has thrown the marshes out of balance. The Razormaw raptors once kept wild growth in check across the Wetlands. Now a bloodthirsty alpha named Carnage rules the pack. It slaughters without restraint and terrorizes its own kind. The marshes are in turmoil. Rethiel the Greenwarden watches over the Green Belt and believes corruption has taken hold of Carnage. Diseased Rotclaw bears came down from Loch Modan. You gather their malignant entrails and place the foul meat in Carnage's cave below Raptor Ridge. The frenzied alpha attacks, and its suffering can end.

quest:98286.text: Camping 101: Enchanting. At Shen'dar Village, skilled enchanters can learn to make an Enchanted Lute for the campfire. Nasalanna Windsinger teaches them how it entertains and bolsters companions. On the open road, sharpened blades and rations are not enough. Travelers need rest and good spirits to endure long expeditions. Enchanters bring magical comforts to camps across Azeroth, helping weary travelers recover their strength and spirits before they return to perilous trails. Aspiring enchanters seeking to learn campsite magic travel to Shen'dar Village. There, Nasalanna Windsinger teaches capable spell-weavers to make an Enchanted Lute. First, they must prove their dedication and skill in enchanting. Then Nasalanna shares how to fashion an instrument whose melodies restore spirits beneath the stars.

quest:98291.text: Death to the Dragonmaw. At Dragonmaw Retreat, Howin Kindfeather asks you to thin the Dragonmaw ranks. He hopes to reach Grim Batol and reclaim it for the Wildhammers, or learn more about it. Dragonmaw orcs have gathered along the retreat, where red dragons routed them before. Howin needs their numbers reduced before he can approach Grim Batol. He points you east along the road to find them.

quest:98293.text: Forced Disarmament. At Dragonmaw Retreat, you seize thirty bundles of weapons from hostile orcs for Captain Stoutfist. Their loss keeps the clan from arming more soldiers for future raids. You carry the gear to Captain Stoutfist at Menethil Keep, helping protect the region’s vital harbor. In the Wetlands, the Dragonmaw clan has stored a troubling number of weapons at Dragonmaw Retreat. Left there, they could arm fresh bands of warriors for raids on nearby settlements. Taking the weapons weakens the orcs’ preparations before their warbands can take the field. Menethil Harbor links Khaz Modan and Stormwind to the sea, making it a vital port. Nearby military buildup puts it in danger. Captain Stoutfist directs the harbor’s defenses from Menethil Keep and watches hostile clans and beasts draw near. Recovering thirty sets of Dragonmaw armaments deprives the orcs of weapons and gives the dwarven garrison a measure of their readiness.

quest:98297.text: Stopping the Cycle. At the Dragonmaw Gates, warlocks are trying to enslave a red dragonspawn. Howin Kindfeather returns from a test flight with troubling news, and the Wildhammer will not let it happen again. Howin Kindfeather asks you to face the subdued dragonspawn at the Dragonmaw Gates. First, kill the warlocks holding it down. That should free it. Then put the dragonspawn out of its misery. Howin expects you to bring friends, for the Wildhammer will not let the Dragonmaw stand in their way.

quest:98298.text: Arugal's Folly. At the Sepulcher, Dalar Dawnweaver seeks the truth behind the worgen near the Greymane Wall. He hopes their remains will prove that Archmage Arugal bound the beasts but did not bring their curse into being. At the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, Forsaken mage Dalar Dawnweaver means to strip away the mystery around his rival, Archmage Arugal. Enchanted shackles show that Arugal lacked the power to summon or create the worgen packs terrorizing the region. His magic could only hold the beasts for a time. How the affliction began remains unknown. Dalar sends you south to the Greymane Wall for proof. Feral worgen attack and infect nearby human populations in the wilderness around its imposing fortifications. You can bring Dalar physical evidence by killing the beasts and gathering pieces of their bodies. He needs those samples to study the affliction's nature.

quest:98299.text: Stop the Spread. At Silverpine Forest's southern border, refugees gather by the Greymane Wall as Arugal's worgen spread. Researchers seek a way to halt the affliction, while orders aim to keep the living refugees from becoming his servants. In Silverpine Forest, worgen spread under renegade Archmage Arugal's hand. Researchers do not yet know exactly how the feral affliction passes from one victim to another. Its danger to the territory is plain. They study the magic while trying to keep Arugal from gathering an overwhelming host of savage followers.

quest:98310.text: Gleaning Our Future. Prospector Whelgar sees a way to learn more from the Goaz Stone. Four larger golems bear names that match its missing pieces. You've found missing pieces of the Goaz Stone. Prospector Whelgar points to four larger golems named Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru. He asks you to use the stone near each one, then bring their hearts back. He hopes they will reveal more of its markings.

quest:98313.text: For Further Study. Historian Karnik awaits a package in Ironforge, tied to something epic. What has been seen so far makes further study worthwhile. You are carrying the Whelgar Relic Package to Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers. He is usually in the library, reading at the back.

quest:98319.text: Secure the Mountain. You face a growing danger in Dun Morogh: wendigos have overrun the Grizzled Den, and Whitebeard's report is missing. Cornelius entered the cavern while his partner waited outside. Wendigos are multiplying across the cold mountain slopes and crowding into the Grizzled Den to the north. Dwarven scouts already contend with Frostmane trolls. Now savage beasts make the crags perilous for patrols and couriers. Cornelius charged into the Grizzled Den to secure Whitebeard's vital report. His partner waits outside, seeking help to find the scout and thin the ferocious wendigos in the cave.

quest:98321.text: Flintfire's Shipment. Kharanos forges need ore from the Grizzled Den, where savage wendigos have driven miners out. The miners left crates behind, and Tognus Flintfire needs the ore to keep local forges supplied. Tognus Flintfire's forge in Kharanos is short of ore. Savage wendigos invaded the Grizzled Den, the region's most productive and dependable source. The miners fled for their lives, leaving their posts and freshly packed crates scattered across the cavern floor. The Grizzled Den lies west of Kharanos. Tognus is grateful that every miner escaped the wendigos in one piece, yet the work stoppage threatens to halt local blacksmithing. Rather than wait for an armed expedition to clear the cave, he seeks daring travelers to slip into the wendigo lair, gather the stranded crates, and bring the ore back to his forge.

quest:98322.text: Secure the Mountain. Senir Whitebeard needs news from Mountaineer Gretchen, west of Kharanos. The scouts he sent to investigate aggressive wendigos have not reported back. Senir Whitebeard gathers military reports for Ironforge. A team of mountaineers went to study the wendigos nearby, but they have not returned with news. Whitebeard will not enter the icy caves himself. So he asks you to travel just west of town and learn what became of the scouts.

quest:98323.text: Secure the Mountain. Mountaineer Gretchen sends a grim report from Dun Morogh to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos. Scouts have found a nearby cave overrun, and she will risk no more lives in its tunnels. Ironforge must still guard the mountain frontier from rising threats. Mountaineer Gretchen watches Dun Morogh's high passes from her post in the freezing peaks. A recent venture into a nearby cavern showed her how dangerous the wilderness remains. Hostile mongrels overrun its tunnels, and she judges the cave a death trap. Gretchen will risk no more lives there. She holds the line on the slopes and sends an emissary with her written assessment. From Kharanos, Senir Whitebeard tracks dangers to the dwarven heartland. Gretchen's report brings little surprise: the cavern is overrun. He adds her letter to his growing stack of field reports. Each account helps Ironforge record and manage the dangers along its frontier.

quest:98326.text: Frosthowl. In Dun Morogh, Frosthowl's attack leaves a dwarven fisher without her catch. The wendigo fled into the Grizzled Den with the sack of fish. A dwarven fisher and her husband, Paxton, spent days fishing on Dun Morogh’s frozen lake. Through biting winds, they gathered a single sack of fish to bring home. Then Frosthowl ambushed their camp and carried off the catch into the snowy wilderness. Frosthowl’s booming roars rattle the ice and frighten the lake’s sparse fish. After stealing the fisher’s sack, the beast fled deep into the Grizzled Den, southeast of the lake. Now the fishers are stranded without their catch. They need someone to confront Frosthowl and recover the stolen fish.

quest:98341.text: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit. In Moonglade, the Avatar of Saeyleenan guides young shen'dorei druids through a spiritual trial. The spirit comes from Zephras and helps them embody the windborne feline form of their homeland. South of Moonglade's twin bridges, a spirit from distant Zephras has appeared in the sacred sanctuary. Calling itself the Avatar of Saeyleenan, this windborne cat spirit has crossed into Azeroth to guide young shen'dorei druids ready to unlock their feline form. Druids seek wisdom in the feline form, but those from Zephras follow a different tradition from Azeroth's native peoples. The shen'dorei embody the windborne predator of their homeland instead of an Azerothian wildcat. So Saeyleenan oversees their trial in Moonglade, to teach them the spirit's nature.

quest:98362.text: To Thunder Bluff. Back in Thunder Bluff, a young tauren druid returns in triumph after communion in Moonglade. The Great Cat Spirit has favored the initiate, who now seeks Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise to master feline shapeshifting. You return to Mulgore after meeting dendrite starblaze and the great cat spirit in Moonglade's sacred groves. The communion joins ancient night elven teachings with the tauren's earthen heritage. It marks a pivotal milestone in a druid's training. Turak Runetotem awaits you atop the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. dendrite starblaze guided your communion with the great cat spirit, and Turak now teaches the physical change. With the spirit's blessing acknowledged, the elder trainer shows you how to take the cat's swift, predatory shape.

quest:98372.text: An Unfortunate End. In Duskwood, a Night Watchman lies dead in the gloom. A beast mauled him, and the unlit brand in his hand may help you see what the darkness hides. A Night Watch patrolman lies dead on Duskwood's dark soil. Deep gashes and cuts mark his body. A great beast caught him before he could escape. An unlit torch remains in the fallen guard's rigid hand. Take it, and its light can reveal what hides in Duskwood's gloom and along other dark paths.

quest:98387.text: Blackrock Blockade. Marshal Marris presses the Blackrock Blockade east of Lake Everstill. Lakeshire's guard means to starve out the Blackrock orcs and seize their weapons. Blackrock raiders in Redridge have driven the Alliance forces to their limits. Their forward parties are cut off from regular supply trains and live off the hills. Marshal Marris knows even fierce orcs cannot fight for long without food and steel. South of Stonewatch Keep, Blackrock camps mark the clan's advance. Lakeshire's defenders strike those camps for supplies and stolen weapons. Each seizure weakens the orcs' strength and morale.

quest:98391.text: The Sisterhood of Elune. In Darnassus, the Sisterhood of Elune needs help with urgent troubles in night elf lands. Sister Aquinne receives those who come to aid the priestesses. You are sent to Darnassus to meet Sister Aquinne. When urgent matters threaten their people and sacred lands, the priestesses of Elune call on trusted champions for aid. Sister Aquinne welcomes you in Darnassus, relieved by your prompt arrival. The priestesses face growing demands, so they seek help beyond their cloistered ranks.

quest:98392.text: Darkness in the Glade. Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak investigates tainted harpy belts in the Oracle Glade. Their amulets may show what is spreading through Teldrassil. Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak finds something wrong among the harpies of the Oracle Glade. Their leather belts carry an unnatural taint woven through the fibers. She suspects demonic corruption, not ordinary aggression. Before she warns Darnassus, she needs proof.

quest:98393.text: The Great Cat Spirit. In Nighthaven, druids gather at Dendrite Starblaze's call to learn the cat's ways. They have mastered the bear and now turn to another aspect of the wild under Father Cenarius's blessing. Druids who have mastered the enduring bear are summoned to Moonglade again. Elder Dendrite Starblaze calls them to Nighthaven, where they can deepen their communion with nature. Their spiritual gifts carry them across the distance to this haven of Cenarion wisdom. When you reach Nighthaven, Dendrite Starblaze invokes Father Cenarius and greets you with a faint aura of power. He says it is time to embrace the cat's perspective: swift, agile, and predatory. As before, Dendrite opens the path to understanding, while the work of embodying and spreading the feline spirit rests with you.

quest:98397.text: To Darnassus. In Darnassus, you return to the Cenarion Enclave after your trial with the Great Cat Spirit. Having proved yourself to Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade, you come to Mathrengyl Bearwalker to learn cat form. You return to Teldrassil after meeting the Great Cat Spirit under Dendrite Starblaze's guidance in Moonglade. Starblaze has seen you prove yourself as a worthy student. So he sends you to your primary instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker. He waits beneath the boughs of the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. In Darnassus, Mathrengyl Bearwalker sees the wisdom you gained from the Great Cat Spirit. Each generation of druids faces a trial shaped by this ancient spirit, playful yet deadly. Your bond is made, and your spirit is ready. Mathrengyl teaches you the final rites for taking cat form.

quest:98398.text: The Oracle Tree. A fallen piece of bark draws travelers to the Oracle Tree, where an ancient voice reaches the mind. Its message calls those who have finished their first duties toward greater work. The Oracle Tree watches its surroundings and guides travelers who have proved their mettle. When it needs an agent in the world, it deliberately sheds a piece of bark nearby. Those who notice are called to step forward, for their first duties are finished and greater responsibilities await. The Oracle Tree reaches the mind through its fallen bark rather than speaking aloud. Examine the piece, and its calm presence washes over you. Its thoughts and desires come like a soft breeze through a canopy of leaves.

quest:98403.text: Twisted Hatred. In Teldrassil, Xethorr the Wicked’s schemes draw you to the Cleft northwest of Dolanaar. There you face the satyr and cull his corrupted spiders before their venom serves his demonic plots. Lord Melenas had a master in Xethorr the Wicked. The satyr held an entrenched presence in Teldrassil’s wilderness, pulling strings from the forest shadows to trouble the World Tree’s quiet boughs.

quest:98404.text:
The Great Windborne Cat Spirit. At the Avatar of Saeyleenan, young druids face a trial of cunning and stealth. They enter the nearby Stormrage Barrow Den to recover three relics while avoiding enraged spirits. Passing the rite earns them the blessing to wield cat form. A seeker must show the nature of a predator before drawing upon the Great Windborne Cat Spirit. The cat calls for cunning and patience, then fierce action when cornered. The spirit tests those who seek its power, asking them to think, move, and strike like wild feline hunters. Only then may an initiate earn the right to take the cat's shape. The trial leads into the Stormrage Barrow Den, just east of the spirit's avatar. Three sacred tokens lie in its halls: the Relic of the Fang, the Relic of the Claw, and the Relic of the Silent Shadow.

Enraged spirits have overrun the den and attack intruders on sight. A seeker cannot rely on brute force alone, but must tread carefully through the darkness to reach the relics. The Avatar of Saeyleenan is the physical manifestation through which the Great Windborne Cat Spirit speaks to young initiates. Untutored seekers lack a seasoned predator's stealth, so a statue at the barrow den's entrance grants them temporary concealment.

Those who slip past the frenzied spirits and return all three relics show they have learned the predator's ways. The Avatar recognizes their worthiness and grants the blessing to wield cat form.

quest:98423.text: The Treaty of Understanding. After the War of the Three Hammers, The Treaty of Understanding marks a peace between two dwarf clans. Its ancient words record the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer agreement, while the Dark Iron clan remains apart. You find a stone tablet deep in an ancient vault. Its words record a formal end to hostilities between dwarf clans. The treaty belongs to the troubled years after the War of the Three Hammers, when the Bronzebeards secured control of Ironforge mountain. Then came peace between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer clans. King Magni Bronzebeard knows the tablet as the work of his ancestor, Madoran Bronzebeard, the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge. The Bronzebeard and Wildhammer leaders signed the document. The Dark Iron clan left no mark, and their absence tells of the lasting rift between them and their mountain kin.

quest:98424.text: Fizsprocket's Notes. In the Venture Co. mine, Morin Cloudstalker seeks the notebook pages still missing. They hold important information about the company's schemes in the region. Morin Cloudstalker waits at Bloodhoof Village for the pages still missing from Fizsprocket’s notebook. You have found folded pages in Fizsprocket’s pocket, and the remaining notes lie in the Venture Co. mine. Their information can guide what comes next.

quest:98427.text: Ceasing Operations. Morin Cloudstalker calls on you to stop the shredder before it fells another tree. He asks you to gather allies, return to the mine in the northeast, and stop it from cutting more trees. One of Fizsprocket's pages speaks of a shredder, and Morin has seen such machines on his travels. They can bring down a forest far faster than axes and muscle. Groves that sheltered the children of the Earth Mother for ages can vanish in days. Morin will not let that happen so close to where the young ones take their first steps. Bring the Clearcutter Key back to him outside Bloodhoof Village.

quest:98430.text: The Longwalkers. At Palemane Rock, Perith Stormhoof is trapped after a peace effort with the gnolls turned violent. Cairne Bloodhoof sent the scout, and his safe return matters to the Tauren people. Cairne Bloodhoof sent Perith Stormhoof to meet the gnolls settled here. Perith is one of Cairne’s Longwalkers, so he cannot speak of the full mission. The attempt at peace turned violent, and he fears the gnolls will eat him if he stays through the night. You are asked to help him escape Palemane Rock and report his safety to Cairne in Thunder Bluff.

quest:98435.text: Thunderhorn's Report. Mull Thunderhorn sends you to carry his report to Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. The elders need to hear what your help has accomplished. Mull Thunderhorn’s report concerns the springs of Mulgore. Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem is on the Elder Rise in eastern Thunder Bluff, where those waters sustain the tauren and the animals they rely on for food, clothing, and companionship.

quest:98459.text: A Lack of Virtue. Tom Half-fish sends a parcel across the sea to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor. Their old quarrel over cards and the Maiden's Virtue now reaches a traveler carrying it. Tom Half-fish asks you to carry a parcel across the water to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor. The delivery is meant to sting his former companion. Tom says Bart is no true sea dog, but an actor who cheated at cards to buy his command.

quest:98461.text: Unrequited Love. In Auberdine, Hollee sends a personal note across the sea to Tarrel Rockweaver, the classmate she still loves. Hollee watches travelers board ships in Auberdine, the port town on Darkshore’s coast. She hopes one bound for the Eastern Kingdoms will carry her message to Tarrel Rockweaver. They studied excavation together for years. Then graduation sent them to opposite continents. Hollee recalls Tarrel’s sharp mind and skill with excavation, but falters when she speaks of his wife, Merrin. Though Tarrel is married and far away, Hollee entrusts you with a personal letter. She asks you to find him near Menethil Harbor and make sure he is safe.

quest:98463.text: Talk of the Town. Travelers seeking livelier company are directed toward Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale. For wilder gatherings, they are sent to Nixxrax Fillamug at the Salty Sailor Tavern. A friendly bartender sends travelers toward Booty Bay, where the port draws those who seek wilder spectacles. Drink servers pass the word to patrons, and it travels beyond the counter. The Salty Sailor Tavern stands in Booty Bay, amid Stranglethorn Vale. Goblins run the lively tavern, where Nixxrax Fillamug keeps the cups filled for all who enter.

quest:98512.text: Al'Aketh Assassins. A scout asks you to end the Al'Aketh Assassins' deadly threat. Your survival and aid will be recorded for Valanaar. Scouts in the field call the Al'Aketh assassins stone-cold killers. They move together with ruthless purpose, putting nearby scouts and travelers in grave danger. You face a perilous fight before they can strike their targets. After the Al'Aketh force is defeated, the scout is relieved to find you alive. Your timely aid will go into an official report for Valanaar.

quest:98545.text: Leonid's Letter. In Undercity, a sealed message from Leonid's Letter awaits delivery to Glix Xizzix. Leonid keeps away because of his strained past with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, and entrusts the message to a neutral traveler bound for his old goblin acquaintance in the Trade Quarter. Leonid asks you to carry a sealed letter to an acquaintance in Undercity. Past friction with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner keeps him from entering the Forsaken capital himself. So he trusts a neutral traveler to pass the city's guards without raising alarm. Glix Xizzix does business in Undercity's Trade Quarter. The message recalls the time he and Leonid survived together beneath the Scourge citadel Naxxramas. Leonid promised compensation, to Glix's surprise and annoyance. So the goblin reluctantly pays with lost-and-found items left behind by careless undead customers.

quest:98574.text: Hallowed Memorandum. At Anvilmar, young gnome priests are summoned to study the Holy Light through the Hallowed Memorandum. It sends them to Branstock Khalder in Coldridge Valley, where curiosity and intellect meet a faith to ponder. While you aid allies in Coldridge Valley, promising gnome novices receive the Hallowed Memorandum. It directs them to Branstock Khalder inside Anvilmar, where their formal spiritual study begins in Dun Morogh. Branstock Khalder welcomes each novice who brings the memorandum. He teaches that the Holy Light is a deep riddle, not a rigid craft. It calls for curiosity, keen thought, and harmony between intellect and feeling. Through contemplation and practice, students learn to channel its mysteries into healing and holy retribution.

quest:98575.text: Tainted Tablet. In the Valley of Trials, Tainted Tablet calls new practitioners to Nartok inside the Den. He teaches warlocks to command the Nether and shape their own fate, though its powers must be kept guarded. A stone message passes through uneasy camp caretakers to newly arrived practitioners in the Valley of Trials. Nartok, a warlock trainer who makes his home inside the Den, calls them to him. He invites you to leave ordinary tribal duties and study deeper, forbidden magic. Nartok speaks plainly about the troubled history between orcs and the Nether. He says the strong should command these volatile powers instead of rejecting them from shame or fear. Where ordinary chieftains falter, he believes those who cunningly master Nether entities can rise to prominence. Yet fearful minds strike at what they cannot understand, so these powers must be guarded closely.

quest:98581.text: Archaic Rune. In Coldridge Valley, young dwarf Shamans begin learning the elements through an ancient rune. It leads them to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar for instruction in earth, air, fire, and water. Near Anvilmar, you find the Archaic Rune after aiding local allies in Coldridge Valley. Its markings follow the Wildhammer style, and elemental power courses through the stone. The inscription tests whether you can sense the primordial spirits. Read it, and the rune directs you to proper instruction at the nearby dwarven outpost. In Anvilmar’s great hall, Teo Hammerstorm receives the inscribed stone. For generations, the Wildhammer kept the spiritual arts of the elements largely within their clan among the windswept peaks. Now these traditions are taking root among the Bronzebeard dwarves of Ironforge and Dun Morogh. Teo bridges the two dwarven cultures, welcoming young initiates called to commune with the elements and teaching them earth, air, fire, and water.

quest:986.text: A Lost Master. In Auberdine, Terenthis prepares a way to search for Volcor, missing in Darkshore. He can weave a cloak of camouflage, but first needs pelts from the coast's fiercest moonstalkers. In Auberdine, Terenthis fears for Volcor and his companion Grimclaw as danger closes around Darkshore's coast. Aggressive predators and corrupted wildlife roam the southern wilds. Terenthis will not send an unprotected scout into that danger, so he plans a cloak woven with wild illusions. Ordinary hides cannot fool Darkshore's beasts. Terenthis needs fine pelts from mature moonstalker sires or matriarchs. The great cats roam the woodlands south of Auberdine, near the Wildbend River and toward Ashenvale's forested border. Moonstalker fur and nature enchantments let the wearer pass through hostile territory while searching for Volcor. Terenthis warns that the illusion is delicate. Strenuous activity or combat breaks the enchantment and leaves the searcher exposed.

quest:98738.text: Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit. After meeting the Great Cat Spirit of Zephras, an initiate returns to Dendrite with a newly awakened aura. The blessing brings the wild cat's stealth, speed, and ferocity, and Dendrite prepares the initiate for further instruction. An initiate returns to Dendrite after seeking the Great Cat Spirit of Zephras and earning its favor. The communion has awakened the wild cat's cunning, predatory stealth, and ferocity within them. Dendrite reads the initiate's newly awakened aura with subtle gestures. Sensing feline instincts woven into their spirit, he sees that the initiate is ready to focus their mind and call upon the true aspect of the cat.

quest:98815.text: Highland Hides. In the Highlands, Thicket Raptors offer tough hides for James Halloran’s leatherwork. The tanner in Menethil Harbor trades crafted goods for their skins. From his workshop in Menethil Harbor, James Halloran seeks rare materials for his craft. Word reaches him of an expedition exploring forgotten ruins in the Highlands. He turns his attention to the beasts roaming the mountain marshes. Their hides suit his work, so he hires travelers to bring back fine pelts from the misty peaks. Thicket Raptors prowl the rugged marshes of the Highlands. Their tough, textured skins suit specialized leatherwork. Halloran asks travelers to hunt these predators and return with four intact hides. He uses them for fine details and decorative trim in his workshop’s creations.

quest:98824.text: Prehistoric Prism. In the Wetlands, Prospector Whelgar has found a relic marked by the keepers. He sends you to Ironforge so the Explorers' League can study the titans' legacy. Prospector Whelgar finds a remarkable artifact while surveying the Wetlands. Keeper inscriptions cover its many facets, and he authenticates the titan-like markings. He asks you to carry it to Ironforge, where scholars can study it. Whelgar hopes the discovery enters the official catalogue, with credit given to you for recovering it and to him for authenticating it. High Explorer Magellas receives the relic for the Explorers' League in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. The maker marks confirm its authenticity. Magellas says light through its polished facets recalls wonders from his first excavation in Uldaman. Your donation preserves the artifact for study and adds to the League's records of the titans' legacy.

quest:98895.text: Darkspear Islands Clash. Across the Darkspear Islands, Alliance forces are hard pressed. Without help at the front, they risk losing the whole archipelago to the fierce Darkspear Raiders. Open war now rages across the Darkspear Islands between the Alliance and the aggressive Darkspear Raiders. Alliance commanders fear their foothold in the archipelago will be overwhelmed without urgent reinforcements. So they call capable champions to the front to stem the attack. Alliance commanders need proven fighters willing to serve on the front lines. Warriors bring back Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor as proof of their service. The marks uphold discipline and honor those whose courage turns the battle.

quest:98896.text: Darkspear Islands Clash. Fighting rages across the Darkspear Islands Clash as Darkspear Raiders contest the archipelago. Fighters are called to rally their companions and stop enemy incursions across the islands. Darkspear Raiders skirmish across the beaches and interior of the islands. Forces sent there are urged to hold their ground as the campaign to secure a foothold in the archipelago continues. Commanders on the front line call for fighters to gather against the resilient raiders. Survival and victory depend on rallying nearby allies into a force that can withstand counterattacks. Together, they can rout fortified raiding bands and break their hold on the disputed island strongholds.

quest:99046.text: The Lost Runner. In Teldrassil, a courier from the Oracle Tree is overdue on the road to Darnassus. The elders rely on its messages for guidance. The Council of the Forest keeps Sentinels at the Oracle Tree in Teldrassil. The ancient tree sends sacred messages to the night elf elders, and runners carry them along the forest roads to Darnassus. Their safe arrival guides the kaldorei and helps govern them. Silence from the Oracle Tree has lasted unusually long, and a courier has not arrived. Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow, an initiate still in training, was the latest runner sent out. Her superiors fear she has met misfortune on the trail, so they direct travelers west toward the Oracle Glade to search for her.

quest:99047.text: Not Dead Yet. In Teldrassil, Eralya needs word carried to Dolanaar. Mortally wounded after a patrol toward the Oracle Tree was overwhelmed by harpies, she asks travelers to tell Byancie what became of her sisters. Eralya lies wounded in the wilderness of Teldrassil. Her patrol was ambushed while she and her sisters traveled toward the Oracle Tree. Harpies attacked and cut down the patrol. With her strength fading and no help coming, she entrusts passing travelers with carrying word back to safety. Eralya asks you to bring her report to Byancie in Dolanaar. Harpies in Teldrassil's great boughs have grown bolder and more aggressive. They threaten lone messengers and sentinels on the forest paths. Byancie's village needs to hear of the ambush at the Oracle Tree before more lives are lost.

quest:99048.text: A Missing Hand. In Durotar, reports from Tiragarde Keep have fallen silent around Heglan Shadeeye. The Shattered Hand scout watched the human garrison occupying the keep, and now an investigator seeks her post. Heglan Shadeeye's reports from Tiragarde Keep have stopped. A Shattered Hand scout, she watched the hostile human garrison occupying the keep from a post in Durotar. Her superiors doubt the soldiers detected and captured her. They fear something more dangerous may have intervened, and send you north of the keep to find her post and learn what happened.

quest:99049.text: Threat from Below. Along Durotar’s eastern shore, Threat from Below begins with an ambush on scout Heglan Shadeeye. The Horde searches her ruined post for clues to the attackers and what they find puts Razor Hill’s defenses at risk. Heglan Shadeeye’s post on the Durotar coast lies shattered after a fierce skirmish. A Shattered Hand scout, she was keeping watch when an unseen enemy ambushed her. The wreckage shows she fought back and wounded her attackers. With hostile forces moving along the eastern shore, the Horde needs to learn who struck her. You search the campsite and nearby ground for clues.

quest:99050.text: The Great Tree Provides. Byancie works in Dolanaar to save Eralya from a dangerous affliction. Dewy lasher fronds from Teldrassil's lakes and a few simple supplies can make a salve to keep the illness at bay. Byancie tends to the night elves of Dolanaar. When she learns that Eralya has fallen ill in the wilds of Teldrassil, she begins preparing an urgent treatment. Without a salve to slow the affliction, Eralya may not survive the journey back to Dolanaar for proper care. Byancie seeks a remedy in Teldrassil's living bounty. Dewy lasher fronds grow near Lake Al'Ameth to the south and Wellspring Lake to the northwest. Blended with clean spring water in a glass vial, the leaves make medicine that can hold the affliction at bay.

quest:99051.text: Threat from Below. Naga scouts are raising camps nearby, and Threat from Below sends you against them. Horde defenders hope to drive the invaders north and keep the area safe. Naga raiders have begun raising camps nearby. Local defenders send you to strike before the intruders gain a foothold. You are to slay the scouts and bring back naga spinefins as proof that their camp has been crushed. The serpentfolk have troubled the area before, and local command will not abide their presence. After you strike the scout camps, surviving naga are expected to flee north. Horde grunts will watch for stragglers and sudden ambushes.

quest:99052.text: Threat from Below. Along Durotar's northern coast, Threat from Below puts travelers and the nearby waters in danger. A sea giant prowls the shore, and defeating it earns the respect of Durotar's warriors. A sea giant prowls Durotar's northern coast, where the Great Sea meets jagged sand and rocky shores. Scavengers and crabs usually roam there. Now the giant moves through the shallows, threatening coastal travelers and those who secure the waters beside the Horde's new homeland. Sea giants can shatter longboats and crush warriors beneath their fists. Bringing one down is a hard fight for young adventurers. Those who succeed earn deep respect among the orcs. Their cry of “blood and thunder” rings across Durotar's dry red bluffs.

quest:99053.text: Escaping Ban'ethil. Beneath Teldrassil, Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom is trapped in Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Gnarlpine furbolg seized her while she carried a message to the slumbering druids. She needs to reach the surface so Dolanaar can hear she is safe. Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom entered Ban'ethil Barrow Den on the Oracle Tree's orders. She carried a message to the druids resting there. But aggressive Gnarlpine furbolg had overrun the tunnels and ambushed her before she could retreat. They took her prisoner, and Lynessa feared the tribe would kill her. Now you can fight your way with her back to the surface. For the kaldorei Sentinels, the gloom of a barrow den is hard to endure. It leaves them far from Elune's starlight and Teldrassil's open air. After her rescue, Lynessa makes her way back toward civilization, while word of her survival reaches Dolanaar. Sentinel Kyra Starsong, Lynessa's friend, receives the news with relief. Those who help Lynessa defend the kaldorei people earn Kyra's thanks.

quest:99073.text: Easing Suffering. Near the Oracle Tree, Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow lies stricken by a spreading rot. You carry Lashwater Salve to ease her pain and calm her failing breath. Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow lies on the road to the Oracle Tree, stricken by a rot spreading fast. To ease her agony, you bring her freshly made Lashwater Salve before the affliction takes firmer hold.

quest:99079.text: Longwalker Malah. In Mulgore, Bloodhoof Village awaits Longwalker Malah’s return from the eastern borderlands. Sent to survey the frontier, she has been missing for three days, and the village needs to know she is safe. Across the plains, the Longwalkers serve as the shu'halo's eyes and ears. Pledged to High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, these elite scouts travel vast territories to gather intelligence and carry vital messages. Their loyalty belongs to the High Chieftain alone. Young Baine Bloodhoof sometimes asks for their help protecting Bloodhoof Village and its surrounding pastures. Longwalker Malah Longwind was sent to watch Mulgore's eastern border on a three-day reconnaissance. She has not returned to Bloodhoof Village on schedule, and the village leadership is concerned. Longwalkers carry vital intelligence, while dangers line Mulgore's frontier cliffs. Scouts and willing travelers are called to follow Malah's trail and make sure she is safe. Her ceremonial headband and feathered staff mark her as one of the Longwalkers.

quest:99080.text: Drive Them Out. Baine Bloodhoof asks you to clear the Galak centaurs from the village’s path. Their defeat could give the children a measure of safety. Six Galak centaurs and four Galak outrunners must fall, and Herak the Pillager’s head must come back to Baine. The village’s safety is at stake.

quest:99081.text: Grim Tidings. Malah’s report carries word of a new centaur camp in Mulgore. Brave Wildrunner needs to know what happened to her, who killed her, and why the camp points to a small raiding party entering the land. You bring Malah’s report to Brave Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village. He needs to know what happened to Malah and who killed her. Her report brings troubling news, and Baine must hear it at once.

quest:99082.text: The High Chieftain. Cairne Bloodhoof’s son sends you to Thunder Bluff to seek his father’s audience. Your defense of your people has earned recognition. Cairne Bloodhoof and the young Warchief Thrall led the effort to reclaim these plains from the centaurs. As High Chieftain, Cairne can recognize your part in defending your people.

quest:99101.text: Our Ancient Enemy. Malah's report has reached Baine Bloodhoof, and his answer is grim. The matter will not go unanswered.

quest:99108.text: Sparring Match. At Tang Stonehoof's arena, newcomers face a trial of strength. Whatever their class or background, they can meet three novices or willing duelists and show their skill in combat. Tang Stonehoof welcomes travelers of every path into his sparring ring. He takes special notice of those who follow a tradition beyond the warrior's, yet believes martial discipline and direct combat teach lessons to all who travel through a dangerous world. In Tang Stonehoof's arena, lineage and weapon matter little. You may wield a sword, bow, or magic, but you must defeat three willing opponents. They may be Novice Warriors in training or fellow adventurers who agree to duel. Victory earns Tang's respect and bandages for wounds suffered in honest combat.

quest:99123.text: Lost in the Shadows. Pal'juh is lost in dangerous country after setting out alone. Her rescue shows why a hunter needs courage and patience. Pal'juh went into hostile territory alone because she would not wait for help. A talented hunter, she soon found herself in over her head. Someone had to bring her safely back. After Pal'juh is rescued, her overseers see promise in her as a scout and tracker. Yet she charges like a raptor instead of stalking with a tiger's patience. The wilderness offers little mercy.

quest:99127.text: A Net Disaster. At Crystal Lake, A Net Disaster starts with fishermen finding no fish on their hooks and no minnows in the shallows. They set traps overnight to protect their stock. Fishermen at Crystal Lake in Elwynn Forest come up empty. Hooks bring in no fish, and even the minnows have vanished from the shallows. So they set traps overnight, hoping to catch enough to keep their stock.

quest:99128.text: Slimy Menace. At Crystal Lake in Elwynn Forest, murlocs threaten the fish and people along the shore. Their growing numbers endanger the lake's supply and nearby locals. Aggressive murlocs have settled along Crystal Lake's eastern shore. Sharp teeth and fierce tempers make the water dangerous for anyone who fishes or comes near. Local residents depend on the lake for their livelihoods, and the murlocs threaten them at the water's edge. If their numbers grow unchecked, murlocs may devour every fish in the lake. Thinning them gives the waters respite, though their eerie, echoing warbles warn that they persist. Even when scattered, they replenish their ranks swiftly, so the shoreline needs constant watch.

quest:99129.text: A Man About a Murloc. Jason's fishing is in danger, and he turns to Remy "Two Times" for help. Remy shares his hatred of murlocs and has plans of his own. Jason is a local fisherman, and murlocs keep raiding his catches. He knows Remy "Two Times" hates them as much as he does. So Jason sends you to ask whether Remy has found a way to drive the creatures from the waters. Remy says the local guards have ignored his repeated warnings about the murloc threat. He will not wait for their help. Instead, he prepares to strike back and asks you to aid his plans.

quest:99130.text: An Enticing Offer. Remy asks you to gather duskweed for bait against nearby murlocs. Clearing it may also help local farmers. Remy has a plan for two local troubles. You gather duskweed from nearby fields, where it troubles the growers, then use it to make bait meant to keep murlocs from settled lands. The plan is to teach the murlocs to avoid the weed. Duskweed is both the heart of the bait and a persistent weed in nearby farm plots. Its petals harm most beasts when gathered in substantial quantities. Gathering it from troubled farmers clears an aggressive plant from their fields and supplies the base for bait meant to steer murloc packs away. Duskweed makes the bait hazardous to handle because its toxins harm other creatures too. Keep domestic animals and pets away from the mixture. Remy also warns you to make sure Jason does not mistake the pungent bait for a meal.

quest:99131.text: Baited for Success. Jason Mathers asks Remy for help as murlocs disrupt his fishing waters. He hopes poisoned bait will drive them off without harming the fish he sells. Aggressive murlocs disrupt the waters where Jason Mathers fishes. He asks how to clear them so he can sell his catch again. Remy prepares poisoned bait meant to target the murlocs and let ordinary fishing resume.

quest:99143.text: Bottles and Baubles. An angler wants to try a curious theory with murloc trinkets. Their shine may draw fish to the hook. An eccentric angler has a theory about murlocs and fish. Murlocs look like fish, so the angler reasons that their minds work alike. Whatever catches a murloc's eye may tempt a hungry fish on a hook. You search a nearby murloc camp, sifting through its hoards for shiny discarded junk to test the idea. Along coasts and riverbanks, murlocs gather bright stones, shells, polished glass, and metal scraps in messy piles around their huts. Sifting through the muddy heaps turns up glittering refuse that an angler can shape into crude lures and flashers. The finds satisfy the angler enough to earn you starter fishing supplies.

quest:99144.text: Seeking Refuge. At Crusader's Outpost, Bareth Dawnstone waits far from the meeting in Brill he was sent to reach. His safe return matters to the young order at Bandarion Keep, where followers of the Holy Light face prejudice from local zealots. Bareth Dawnstone left Bandarion Keep to speak with Shari Stilwell in Brill. Zealous warriors seized him at Crusader's Outpost before he could reach her. They despise him for being undead, yet Bareth remains devoted to the Light. He seeks a way out of their hands and a chance to deliver his message. At Crusader's Outpost, zealots wield the Holy Light with rigid conviction and vengeance. They see Bareth's existence as an offense. He meditates on the Light as a source of protection and inner purity. His captors' cruelty grieves him, for it twists the sacred teachings he cherishes. In Brill, Shari Stilwell learns that Bareth has escaped and is safe. Their monastic order is still taking root on the bluffs northwest of Solliden Farmstead. Losing a promising practitioner like Bareth would have hurt the young fellowship. Its doors are open to travelers seeking sincere guidance in the Light.

quest:99152.text: As Above, So Below. At Bandarion Keep, Hilda the Breaker sends you to investigate the hidden Scourge beneath Shadowvale. Bones still humming with reanimation magic may reveal how the undead gathered beneath the town unseen. Hilda the Breaker prepares defenders at Bandarion Keep for the dangers around them. To the southwest, Shadowvale faces regular unrest from the Tarnished, a hostile faction. Yet beneath the town, the Scourge gathers strength in hidden cellars. If left unchecked, it may erupt in a sudden assault on the keep.

quest:99153.text: The One That Got Away. Near Naxxramas's remnants, Ephram Barbaro seeks the cultist who escaped with a dangerous crystal fragment. The fugitive fled beneath Shadowvale, and its power may raise or strengthen the dead. After the clash with cultists near the Naxxramas battle remnants, word spreads among the ranks. Ephram Barbaro hears that one cultist slipped past the perimeter with an active piece of a Scourge focusing crystal. He seeks capable adventurers to find the fugitive. The escaped cultist fled into passages beneath Shadowvale. The fragment still holds necromantic power, and may raise the dead or strengthen hostile forces underground. Ephram Barbaro sends you to track it down and secure it before that power brings greater harm.

quest:99158.text: Dawn in the Mountains. At Misty Pine Refuge, Father Gavin tends travelers with the Light's healing and comfort. He needs holy candles to keep his mountain sanctuary supplied. Father Gavin follows the Light's gentler calling within the Argent Dawn. Many in the order take up arms against unholy horrors across Azeroth, but he heals the afflicted and tends the weary. He restored an abandoned structure in the rugged mountain wilderness and made it Misty Pine Refuge, a safe stop for travelers facing the high passes. An isolated mountain refuge needs steady care. Father Gavin depends on charity from distant allies to sustain his ministry and keep the lamps and altars burning. A delivery of consecrated candles replenishes the sanctuary's supply, keeping it a beacon of light, warmth, and hope in the wilderness.

quest:99159.text: Finding Warmth. A hearth waits for firewood, while its keeper tends to other duties. Gathered logs keep the fire ready to warm anyone who seeks comfort. The hearth welcomes travelers who seek warmth. Its keeper has other duties and cannot gather fuel. Bring firewood to keep the flames alive for those who need shelter and comfort. Some gathered wood is too damp to burn at once. The keeper sets wet pieces aside to dry and feeds seasoned wood to the fire. With the hearth tended, the keeper turns to other pressing matters.

quest:99160.text: Rime's Wrath. Minor ice elementals roam the area, and no peaceful way to calm them is known. You are asked to destroy them before they can harm anyone. Minor ice elementals have gathered nearby, and their biting cold puts passersby at risk. You are asked to contain the danger before the spirits can harm anyone. Those who hoped to calm the frost spirits do not know how. As the elementals grow more dangerous, you are asked to destroy them and protect the surrounding territory.

quest:99161.text: Rime's Wrath. After a rockslide, Avala makes the mountain pass dangerous. An observer asks you to hunt the great elemental and bring back its core, so the slopes may grow safer for travelers. A rockslide has unsettled the mountain pass, and elementals have appeared. One is far larger and stronger than the others. The observer watching the pass named it Avala. Its power brings sudden weather shifts and shakes the cliffs. Loose stone and bitter winter chills now make the pass perilous for travelers. Avala's influence makes the pass more dangerous. The observer calls on you to stop it before more collapses claim lives. You face the elemental amid the harsh conditions it stirs, then bring back its core as proof of its death. With Avala gone, the violent weather shifts ease, and the mountain passes grow safer for travelers.

quest:99162.text: Treacherous Cold. In Dun Morogh, snow and ice slides bury Ironforge mountaineers in the high passes. You search for their inscribed rifles so their families can learn who fell. In Dun Morogh, sudden avalanches and falling ice threaten travelers and soldiers. Even Ironforge's hardened mountaineers can be overwhelmed. When winter strikes without warning, novice recruits may pay with their lives. Mountain slides can bury patrols, and each search through the hazardous terrain races against time. Elemental activity across the region has grown more intense, making rescue parties perilous to send out. Scouts ask you to search the drifts for fallen mountaineers and recover their inscribed rifles before snow hides them forever. Ironforge mountaineers carve their names into their rifle stocks. Recovering those weapons from the drifts helps identify the fallen, so their families in Ironforge can learn of their service.

quest:99191.text: A Donation of Wool. The High Order is taking wool cloth from those who seek its full recognition. Sixty pieces meet its current need. The High Order is accepting wool cloth, and sixty pieces meet its current needs. The giver can take your donation now. In return, the order grants you full recognition.

quest:99196.text: A Donation of Wool. The Windshapers are taking wool cloth donations, and sixty pieces will earn their full recognition. The Windshapers accept wool cloth from you. When you are ready to give, their representative can take sixty pieces.

quest:99260.text: Fillion's Mission. Fillion lies wounded after his survey at the Overlook Standing Stones. The readings meant to guide skycutters between Skywall and Azeroth are presumed lost. Fillion went to the Overlook Standing Stones to measure elemental currents. Those readings are needed to calculate safe courses for skycutter vessels between Skywall and Azeroth. After an ordeal that required his rescue, he is too wounded to finish the work. The vital data is presumed lost, so he sends his rescuer to report to the Supreme Magister.

quest:993.text: A Lost Master. In Darkshore, you follow Grimclaw’s trail to find the missing scout Volcor. Terenthis has made an Enchanted Moonstalker Cloak from fine moonstalker pelts for the search. Terenthis waits in Auberdine with the Enchanted Moonstalker Cloak he has woven. South of the settlement, Grimclaw waits on the road for help sent by Terenthis. The loyal bear belongs to the missing night elf scout Volcor. Give Grimclaw a familiar greeting, and he leads you from the road toward the cave where Volcor is hiding.

quest:994.text: Escape Through Force. In Darkshore, Volcor fights through the wild to reach safety. He finds Grimclaw by the road, and you bring word of his escape to Terenthis in Auberdine. Volcor is stranded in Darkshore’s perilous wilderness, with danger closing around him. He chooses to fight the hostile creatures instead of slipping away unseen. His skill clears a path to the main road and safety.

quest:99411.text:
Kyle's Gone Missing!. In Bloodhoof Village, Ahab Wheathoof asks you to find his missing dog, Kyle the Frenzied. A cut of tender strider meat calms the hungry pup and guides him safely home. Ahab Wheathoof is an elder in Bloodhoof Village, and he worries over his wayward pet, Kyle the Frenzied. To outsiders, Kyle's name sounds alarming, but to Ahab he is a prized puppy. He has slipped away onto Mulgore's grassy plains.

Ahab asks travelers passing through the settlement to track down his unruly companion. A hearty meal may calm Kyle's wild spirits. Kyle needs a cut of tender strider meat from the swift plainstriders roaming Mulgore. The treat satisfies the hungry pup and soothes his frenzied mood. Then it nudges him back toward Bloodhoof Village and his grateful owner.

quest:995.text: Escape Through Stealth. In Darkshore, Volcor needs your help escaping a furbolg den. Guide the trapped night elf scout past hostile beasts, then report to Terenthis in Auberdine. Volcor, a night elf scout, was sent to investigate Darkshore's growing threats. Now he is trapped inside a furbolg cave, cut off from the main roads and outnumbered. He needs your help to escape before the furbolgs discover him. Volcor takes a careful path through the cave instead of charging its corrupted denizens. Once outside, he runs ahead on foot. He asks you to meet him in Auberdine, where he can travel faster alone. Back in Auberdine, you bring news of Volcor's rescue to Terenthis, a night elf leader who works to protect the troubled coast. Volcor's safe return shows that discipline and teamwork can resist the darkness spreading through Darkshore and the wilderness beyond.
